-- UTILITY MODULE (FIX #7, #8)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local Utils = {}

function Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Train, workspace.Zombies}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(position, Vector3.new(0, -100, 0), params)
    return result and result.Position or position
end

function Utils.IsPositionSafe(position, radius)
    local params = OverlapParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Map}
    
    local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(position), Vector3.new(radius*2, radius*2, radius*2), params)
    return #parts < 3 -- Less than 3 obstructions
end

function Utils.ValidatePosition(player, newPosition)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character.PrimaryPart then return false end
    
    local oldPos = character.PrimaryPart.Position
    local distance = (newPosition - oldPos).Magnitude
    local timeDelta = 0.1 -- Assume 100ms
    local maxSpeed = Config.Security.MaxPositionDelta * timeDelta
    
    return distance <= maxSpeed
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- SPATIAL HASH (FIX #9)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local SpatialHash = {}
SpatialHash.CellSize = 50
SpatialHash.Grid = {}

function SpatialHash:GetCell(position)
    local x = math.floor(position.X / self.CellSize)
    local z = math.floor(position.Z / self.CellSize)
    return x .. "_" .. z
end

function SpatialHash:Insert(entity, position)
    local cell = self:GetCell(position)
    if not self.Grid[cell] then
        self.Grid[cell] = {}
    end
    table.insert(self.Grid[cell], entity)
end

function SpatialHash:GetNearby(position, radius)
    local nearby = {}
    local cellRadius = math.ceil(radius / self.CellSize)
    local centerX = math.floor(position.X / self.CellSize)
    local centerZ = math.floor(position.Z / self.CellSize)
    
    for x = centerX - cellRadius, centerX + cellRadius do
        for z = centerZ - cellRadius, centerZ + cellRadius do
            local cell = x .. "_" .. z
            if self.Grid[cell] then
                for _, entity in ipairs(self.Grid[cell]) do
                    table.insert(nearby, entity)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearby
end

function SpatialHash:Clear()
    self.Grid = {}
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- OBJECT POOL (FIX #41)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local ObjectPool = {}
ObjectPool.Zombies = {}
ObjectPool.MaxPoolSize = 30

function ObjectPool:GetZombie()
    if #self.Zombies > 0 then
        local zombie = table.remove(self.Zombies)
        zombie.Parent = workspace
        return zombie
    end
    return nil -- Need to create new
end

function ObjectPool:ReturnZombie(zombie)
    if #self.Zombies < self.MaxPoolSize then
        zombie.Parent = nil
        table.insert(self.Zombies, zombie)
    else
        zombie:Destroy()
    end
end

-- TRAIN MODULE (FIX #5, #17, #20)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local Train = {}
Train.Wagons = {}
Train.Health = Config.Train.MaxHealth
Train.MaxHealth = Config.Train.MaxHealth
Train.IsActive = true
Train.PlayerPlatforms = {} -- Track player attachments

function Train:Initialize()
    local trainFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    trainFolder.Name = "Train"
    trainFolder.Parent = workspace
    
    for i = 1, Config.Train.WagonCount do
        local wagon = Instance.new("Part")
        wagon.Size = Vector3.new(10, 6, 10)
        wagon.Position = Vector3.new(i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing, 10, 0)
        wagon.Anchored = false -- Use velocity instead (FIX #5)
        wagon.Name = "Wagon_" .. i
        wagon.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        wagon.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
        wagon.Parent = trainFolder
        
        -- Set collision group
        PhysicsService:SetPartCollisionGroup(wagon, "Train")
        
        -- Add BodyVelocity for consistent movement (FIX #5)
        local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(Config.Train.Speed, 0, 0)
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bodyVelocity.Parent = wagon
        
        -- Platform for players
        local platform = Instance.new("Part")
        platform.Size = Vector3.new(9, 1, 9)
        platform.Position = wagon.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
        platform.Anchored = false
        platform.Name = "Platform"
        platform.CanCollide = true
        platform.Parent = wagon
        
        -- Weld platform to wagon
        local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld.Part0 = wagon
        weld.Part1 = platform
        weld.Parent = platform
        
        -- Platform attachment for player AlignPosition (FIX #20)
        local platformAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
        platformAtt.Name = "PlatformAttachment"
        platformAtt.Parent = platform
        
        table.insert(self.Wagons, {
            Part = wagon,
            Platform = platform,
            BodyVelocity = bodyVelocity,
            Offset = i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing
        })
    end
    
    -- Connect wagons with RigidConstraints (FIX #17)
    for i = 2, #self.Wagons do
        local att0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att0.Position = Vector3.new(5, 0, 0) -- Front of wagon
        att0.Parent = self.Wagons[i-1].Part
        
        local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att1.Position = Vector3.new(-5, 0, 0) -- Back of wagon
        att1.Parent = self.Wagons[i].Part
        
        local rigid = Instance.new("RigidConstraint")
        rigid.Attachment0 = att0
        rigid.Attachment1 = att1
        rigid.Parent = self.Wagons[i].Part
    end
    
    self.Folder = trainFolder
    print("🚂 Train Initialized with " .. #self.Wagons .. " wagons (using BodyVelocity)")
end

function Train:Update(deltaTime)
    if not self.IsActive then return end
    
    -- Update velocity instead of CFrame (FIX #5)
    for _, wagon in ipairs(self.Wagons) do
        wagon.BodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(Config.Train.Speed, 0, 0)
    end
    
    -- Health regeneration (FIX #157)
    self.Health = math.min(self.MaxHealth, self.Health + Config.Train.HealthRegen * deltaTime)
end

function Train:AttachPlayer(character)
    -- Use AlignPosition to keep player on platform (FIX #20)
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    
    local rootAtt = hrp:FindFirstChild("RootAttachment")
    if not rootAtt then
        rootAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
        rootAtt.Name = "RootAttachment"
        rootAtt.Parent = hrp
    end
    
    local platformAtt = self.Wagons[1].Platform:FindFirstChild("PlatformAttachment")
    
    local alignPos = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
    alignPos.Attachment0 = rootAtt
    alignPos.Attachment1 = platformAtt
    alignPos.MaxForce = 5000
    alignPos.Responsiveness = 25
    alignPos.RigidityEnabled = false
    alignPos.Parent = hrp
    
    self.PlayerPlatforms[character] = alignPos
end

function Train:DetachPlayer(character)
    if self.PlayerPlatforms[character] then
        self.PlayerPlatforms[character]:Destroy()
        self.PlayerPlatforms[character] = nil
    end
end

function Train:TakeDamage(amount)
    self.Health = math.max(0, self.Health - amount)
    
    -- Sync to clients
    SyncEvent:FireAllClients({
        Type = "TrainHealth",
        Health = self.Health,
        MaxHealth = self.MaxHealth
    })
    
    if self.Health <= 0 then
        self:Destroy()
    end
end

function Train:Destroy()
    self.IsActive = false
    if self.Folder then
        self.Folder:Destroy()
    end
    print("❌ Train Destroyed - Game Over")
    
    -- Notify all players
    SyncEvent:FireAllClients({Type = "GameOver", Reason = "TrainDestroyed"})
end

-- ZOMBIE MODULE (FIX #11, #18, #19, #42, #43)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local ZombieModule = {}
ZombieModule.ActiveZombies = {}
ZombieModule.LastSpawnTime = 0
ZombieModule.CurrentDay = 1
ZombieModule.UpdateIndex = 1 -- For staggered updates (FIX #59)

function ZombieModule:CreateZombieRig()
    -- Try to get from pool first (FIX #41)
    local zombie = ObjectPool:GetZombie()
    if zombie then
        -- Reset pooled zombie
        local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
        end
        return zombie
    end
    
    -- Create new zombie (simplified 2-part rig for performance FIX #58)
    zombie = Instance.new("Model")
    zombie.Name = "Zombie"
    
    local torso = Instance.new("Part")
    torso.Name = "Torso"
    torso.Size = Vector3.new(2, 3, 1)
    torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    torso.Material = Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal
    torso.Parent = zombie
    
    local head = Instance.new("Part")
    head.Name = "Head"
    head.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
    head.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    head.Position = torso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
    head.Parent = zombie
    
    -- Weld head
    local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    weld.Part0 = torso
    weld.Part1 = head
    weld.Parent = head
    
    -- Humanoid with scaled health
    local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Name = "Humanoid"
    humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Zombie.BaseHealth * (Config.Gameplay.DifficultyScale ^ (self.CurrentDay - 1))
    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
    
    -- Apply speed variation (FIX #78)
    local speedMod = 1 + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * Config.Zombie.SpeedVariation
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Zombie.BaseSpeed * speedMod
    humanoid.Parent = zombie
    
    zombie.PrimaryPart = torso
    
    -- Set collision group
    PhysicsService:SetPartCollisionGroup(torso, "Zombies")
    PhysicsService:SetPartCollisionGroup(head, "Zombies")
    
    return zombie
end

function ZombieModule:SpawnZombie(position)
    if #self.ActiveZombies >= Config.Zombie.MaxCount then return end
    
    local groundPos = Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    if not Utils.IsPositionSafe(groundPos, 3) then return end
    
    local zombie = self:CreateZombieRig()
    zombie:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(groundPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
    zombie.Parent = workspace
    
    local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    
    -- Hallucination effect with unique behavior (FIX #18)
    local isHallucination = math.random() < Config.Zombie.HallucinationChance
    if isHallucination then
        for _, part in pairs(zombie:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
                part.Transparency = 0.3
                part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end
        
        -- Add particle effect
        local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 0, 0))
        particles.Rate = 20
        particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
        particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(2)
        particles.Parent = zombie.PrimaryPart
    end
    
    local zombieData = {
        Model = zombie,
        Humanoid = humanoid,
        IsHallucination = isHallucination,
        IgnoreTrain = isHallucination, -- Hallucinations ignore train (FIX #18)
        DamageMultiplier = isHallucination and 0 or 1, -- No real damage (FIX #18)
        LastPathUpdate = 0,
        CurrentPath = nil,
        Target = nil,
        SpawnTime = tick(),
        LastAttackTime = 0,
        IsActive = true -- For LOD (FIX #43)
    }
    
    table.insert(self.ActiveZombies, zombieData)
    
    -- Insert into spatial hash (FIX #9)
    SpatialHash:Insert(zombieData, zombie.PrimaryPart.Position)
    
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    end)
    
    return zombieData
end

function ZombieModule:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    local zombie = zombieData.Model
    if not zombie or not zombie.Parent then
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
        return
    end
    
    local humanoid = zombieData.Humanoid
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    local zombiePos = zombie.PrimaryPart.Position
    local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local distanceToTrain = (zombiePos - trainPos).Magnitude
    
    -- Despawn if too far
    if distanceToTrain > Config.Zombie.DespawnRadius then
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
        return
    end
    
    -- LOD: Deactivate if too far (FIX #43)
    if distanceToTrain > Config.Zombie.ActivationRadius then
        zombieData.IsActive = false
        humanoid:MoveTo(zombiePos) -- Stop moving
        return
    else
        zombieData.IsActive = true
    end
    
    -- Pathfinding update (throttled FIX #42)
    if tick() - zombieData.LastPathUpdate > Config.Zombie.PathUpdateInterval then
        zombieData.LastPathUpdate = tick()
        
        local target = self:FindNearestTarget(zombiePos, zombieData.IgnoreTrain)
        if target then
            zombieData.Target = target
            
            local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                AgentRadius = 2,
                AgentHeight = 5,
                AgentCanJump = true,
                Costs = {
                    Water = math.huge, -- Avoid water
                    Danger = 5
                }
            })
            
            local success = pcall(function()
                path:ComputeAsync(zombiePos, target.Position)
            end)
            
            if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                zombieData.CurrentPath = path
                local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                
                if #waypoints > 1 then
                    humanoid:MoveTo(waypoints[2].Position)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Attack logic
    if zombieData.Target then
        local distance = (zombiePos - zombieData.Target.Position).Magnitude
        if distance < Config.Combat.MeleeRange then
            self:AttackTarget(zombieData, zombieData.Target)
        end
    end
end

function ZombieModule:FindNearestTarget(position, ignoreTrain)
    local nearest = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    
    -- Use spatial hash for optimization (FIX #9)
    local nearbyPlayers = SpatialHash:GetNearby(position, Config.Zombie.ActivationRadius)
    
    -- Check players
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (hrp.Position - position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDist then
                minDist = dist
                nearest = hrp
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Check train if not ignoring (FIX #18)
    if not ignoreTrain and minDist > 50 and Train.Wagons[1] then
        local dist = (Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position - position).Magnitude
        if dist < minDist then
            minDist = dist
            nearest = Train.Wagons[1].Part
        end
    end
    
    return nearest
end

function ZombieModule:AttackTarget(zombieData, target)
    local now = tick()
    if now - zombieData.LastAttackTime < Config.Combat.MeleeCooldown then return end
    
    zombieData.LastAttackTime = now
    
    local damage = Config.Zombie.BaseDamage * zombieData.DamageMultiplier
    
    if target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        target.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
    elseif target.Name:match("Wagon") and not zombieData.IgnoreTrain then
        Train:TakeDamage(damage)
    end
end

function ZombieModule:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    -- Remove from active list
    for i, zd in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        if zd == zombieData then
            table.remove(self.ActiveZombies, i)
            break
        end
    end
    
    -- Return to pool or destroy (FIX #41)
    if zombieData.Model then
        ObjectPool:ReturnZombie(zombieData.Model)
    end
end

function ZombieModule:UpdateAll(deltaTime)
    -- Stagger updates across frames (FIX #59)
    local updatesThisFrame = 0
    local startIndex = self.UpdateIndex
    
    while updatesThisFrame < Config.Performance.MaxZombiesPerFrame and #self.ActiveZombies > 0 do
        local zombieData = self.ActiveZombies[self.UpdateIndex]
        if zombieData then
            self:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
        end
        
        updatesThisFrame = updatesThisFrame + 1
        self.UpdateIndex = (self.UpdateIndex % #self.ActiveZombies) + 1
        
        -- Prevent infinite loop
        if self.UpdateIndex == startIndex then break end
    end
    
    -- Spawn new zombies (only if no boss FIX #19)
    if not CampaignState.CurrentBoss and tick() - self.LastSpawnTime > Config.Zombie.SpawnInterval then
        self.LastSpawnTime = tick()
        
        local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local distance = Config.Zombie.SpawnRadius
        local spawnPos = trainPos + Vector3.new(
            math.cos(angle) * distance,
            0,
            math.sin(angle) * distance
        )
        
        self:SpawnZombie(spawnPos)
    end
end

function ZombieModule:ClearAll()
    -- Clear all zombies (FIX #19)
    for _, zombieData in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        if zombieData.Model then
            ObjectPool:ReturnZombie(zombieData.Model)
        end
    end
    self.ActiveZombies = {}
    print("🧹 All zombies cleared")
end

-- BOSS MODULE (FIX #10, #15, #16)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local BossModule = {}
BossModule.ActiveBoss = nil

local BossStates = {
    SPAWNING = "Spawning",
    IDLE = "Idle",
    CHASE = "Chase",
    ATTACK = "Attack",
    SPECIAL = "Special",
    DYING = "Dying"
}

function BossModule:SpawnBoss(bossName, chapterIndex)
    print("👹 Spawning Boss:", bossName)
    
    local chapter = Config.Chapters[chapterIndex]
    local spawnPos = chapter.BossSpawn or Vector3.new(150, 5, 0) -- (FIX #15)
    
    local bossModel = Instance.new("Model")
    bossModel.Name = bossName
    
    local torso = Instance.new("Part")
    torso.Size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)
    torso.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPos)
    torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
    torso.Anchored = false
    torso.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    torso.Parent = bossModel
    
    -- Set collision group
    PhysicsService:SetPartCollisionGroup(torso, "Bosses")
    
    -- Scaled health (FIX #10)
    local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Boss.BaseHealth * (Config.Boss.HealthScale ^ (chapterIndex - 1))
    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 10 * (Config.Boss.SpeedScale ^ (chapterIndex - 1))
    humanoid.Parent = bossModel
    
    bossModel.PrimaryPart = torso
    bossModel.Parent = workspace
    
    local bossData = {
        Model = bossModel,
        Humanoid = humanoid,
        State = BossStates.IDLE,
        Target = nil,
        LastAttackTime = 0,
        AttackCooldown = 3,
        ChapterIndex = chapterIndex,
        DamageScale = Config.Boss.DamageScale ^ (chapterIndex - 1)
    }
    
    self.ActiveBoss = bossData
    CampaignState.CurrentBoss = bossModel
    
    -- Death event
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        self:DefeatBoss()
    end)
    
    return bossData
end

function BossModule:UpdateBossAI(deltaTime)
    if not self.ActiveBoss then return end
    
    local boss = self.ActiveBoss
    local bossModel = boss.Model
    local humanoid = boss.Humanoid
    
    if not bossModel.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    -- Simple state machine (FIX #16)
    if boss.State == BossStates.IDLE then
        -- Find target
        boss.Target = self:FindBestTarget(bossModel.PrimaryPart.Position)
        if boss.Target then
            boss.State = BossStates.CHASE
        end
        
    elseif boss.State == BossStates.CHASE then
        if boss.Target and boss.Target.Parent then
            local distance = (bossModel.PrimaryPart.Position - boss.Target.Position).Magnitude
            
            if distance < 15 then
                boss.State = BossStates.ATTACK
            else
                humanoid:MoveTo(boss.Target.Position)
            end
        else
            boss.State = BossStates.IDLE
        end
        
    elseif boss.State == BossStates.ATTACK then
        local now = tick()
        if now - boss.LastAttackTime > boss.AttackCooldown then
            boss.LastAttackTime = now
            self:ExecuteAttack(boss)
        end
        
        -- Return to chase if target moved away
        if boss.Target then
            local distance = (bossModel.PrimaryPart.Position - boss.Target.Position).Magnitude
            if distance > 20 then
                boss.State = BossStates.CHASE
            end
        end
    end
end

function BossModule:FindBestTarget(position)
    -- Prefer train over players for boss
    if Train.Wagons[1] then
        return Train.Wagons[1].Part
    end
    
    -- Fallback to nearest player
    local nearest = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (hrp.Position - position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDist then
                minDist = dist
                nearest = hrp
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearest
end

function BossModule:ExecuteAttack(bossData)
    local damage = 50 * bossData.DamageScale
    local target = bossData.Target
    
    if target and target.Parent then
        if target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            target.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        elseif target.Name:match("Wagon") then
            Train:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
        
        print("💥 Boss attacked for " .. damage .. " damage")
    end
end

function BossModule:DefeatBoss()
    if not self.ActiveBoss then return end
    
    print("💀 Boss defeated:", self.ActiveBoss.Model.Name)
    
    if self.ActiveBoss.Model then
        Debris:AddItem(self.ActiveBoss.Model, 3)
    end
    
    self.ActiveBoss = nil
    CampaignState.CurrentBoss = nil
    
    -- Advance chapter
    CompleteChapter()
end

function PlayerManager:SetupPlayer(player)
    CampaignState.PlayersInGame[player.UserId] = player
    self.RateLimits[player.UserId] = {
        LastDamage = 0,
        DamageCount = 0
    }
    
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)

        repeat task.wait() until Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Platform
        
        -- Spawn on platform
        hrp.CFrame = Train.Wagons[1].Platform.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        
        -- Attach to platform (FIX #20)
        Train:AttachPlayer(character)
        
        -- Set collision group
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                PhysicsService:SetPartCollisionGroup(part, "Players")
            end

        sword.Parent = player.Backpack
    end)
    
    player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)

    end)
end

-- DAMAGE VALIDATION (FIX #4, #32, #38)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DamageEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, target, damage)
    -- Rate limiting (FIX #23, #32)
    local limits = PlayerManager.RateLimits[player.UserId]
    if not limits then return end
    
    local now = tick()
    if now - limits.LastDamage < 1 then
        limits.DamageCount = limits.DamageCount + 1
        if limits.DamageCount > Config.Security.DamageRateLimit then
            warn("Player " .. player.Name .. " exceeded damage rate limit")
            return
        end
    else
        limits.DamageCount = 0
    end
    limits.LastDamage = now
    
    -- Validate distance (FIX #38)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character.PrimaryPart then return end
    
    if not target or not target:IsA("Model") then return end
    local targetPart = target.PrimaryPart
    if not targetPart then return end
    
    local distance = (character.PrimaryPart.Position - targetPart.Position).Magnitude
    if distance > Config.Combat.MaxDamageDistance then
        warn("Player " .. player.Name .. " attempted damage from invalid distance")
        return
    end
    
    -- Apply damage
    local humanoid = target:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
    end
end)

-- SERVICES
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- SECURE CONFIGURATION (ServerStorage only)
local Config = {
    Train = {
        Speed = 16,
        WagonCount = 3,
        WagonSpacing = 12,
        MaxHealth = 1000
    },
    Zombie = {
        SpawnInterval = 8,
        MaxCount = 20,
        SpawnRadius = 50,
        DespawnRadius = 200,
        BaseHealth = 100,
        BaseDamage = 10,
        BaseSpeed = 12,
        HallucinationChance = 0.3
    },
    Gameplay = {
        MaxDays = 99,
        DayDuration = 300, -- seconds
        DifficultyScale = 1.1 -- per day multiplier
    },
    Performance = {
        TickRate = 1/30, -- AI update rate
        CleanupInterval = 10
    }
}

-- UTILITY FUNCTIONS
local Utils = {}

function Utils.CreateWeld(part0, part1, offset)
    local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    weld.Part0 = part0
    weld.Part1 = part1
    weld.Parent = part0
    return weld
end

function Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    local ray = Ray.new(position, Vector3.new(0, -100, 0))
    local hit, hitPosition = workspace:FindPartOnRay(ray, nil, false, true)
    return hitPosition or position
end

function Utils.IsPositionSafe(position, radius)
    local region = Region3.new(position - Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius), 
                               position + Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius))
    region.ExpandToGrid(4)
    local parts = workspace:FindPartsInRegion3(region, nil, 100)
    return #parts < 5 -- Simple obstruction check
end

-- TRAIN MODULE (Fixed)
local Train = {}
Train.Wagons = {}
Train.Health = Config.Train.MaxHealth
Train.IsActive = true

function Train:Initialize()
    -- Create container for organization
    local trainFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    trainFolder.Name = "Train"
    trainFolder.Parent = workspace
    
    local previousWagon = nil
    
    for i = 1, Config.Train.WagonCount do
        local wagon = Instance.new("Part")
        wagon.Size = Vector3.new(10, 6, 10)
        wagon.Position = Vector3.new(i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing, 10, 0)
        wagon.Anchored = true -- Keep anchored, move via CFrame
        wagon.Name = "Wagon_" .. i
        wagon.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        wagon.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
        wagon.Parent = trainFolder
        
        -- Add health tracking
        local healthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
        healthValue.Name = "Health"
        healthValue.Value = Config.Train.MaxHealth
        healthValue.Parent = wagon
        
        -- Visual platform for players
        local platform = Instance.new("Part")
        platform.Size = Vector3.new(9, 1, 9)
        platform.Position = wagon.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
        platform.Anchored = true
        platform.Name = "Platform"
        platform.Parent = wagon
        
        table.insert(self.Wagons, {
            Part = wagon,
            Platform = platform,
            Offset = i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing
        })
        
        previousWagon = wagon
    end
    
    self.Folder = trainFolder
end

function Train:Update(deltaTime)
    if not self.IsActive then return end
    
    -- Move train along path (simple forward movement)
    for i, wagon in ipairs(self.Wagons) do
        local currentCF = wagon.Part.CFrame
        local movement = Vector3.new(Config.Train.Speed * deltaTime, 0, 0)
        
        wagon.Part.CFrame = currentCF + movement
        wagon.Platform.CFrame = wagon.Part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
    end
end

function Train:TakeDamage(amount)
    self.Health = math.max(0, self.Health - amount)
    if self.Health <= 0 then
        self:Destroy()
    end
end

function Train:Destroy()
    self.IsActive = false
    if self.Folder then
        self.Folder:Destroy()
    end
    -- Trigger game over
    print("❌ Train Destroyed - Game Over")
end

-- ZOMBIE MODULE (Fixed with proper AI)
local ZombieModule = {}
ZombieModule.ActiveZombies = {}
ZombieModule.ZombiePool = {} -- Object pooling
ZombieModule.LastSpawnTime = 0
ZombieModule.CurrentDay = 1

function ZombieModule:CreateZombieRig()
    -- Create proper R6-style rig with Humanoid
    local zombie = Instance.new("Model")
    zombie.Name = "Zombie"
    
    local torso = Instance.new("Part")
    torso.Name = "Torso"
    torso.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
    torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    torso.Parent = zombie
    
    local head = Instance.new("Part")
    head.Name = "Head"
    head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
    head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    head.Position = torso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
    head.Parent = zombie
    
    -- Humanoid for pathfinding
    local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Name = "Humanoid"
    humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Zombie.BaseHealth * (Config.Gameplay.DifficultyScale ^ (self.CurrentDay - 1))
    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Zombie.BaseSpeed
    humanoid.Parent = zombie
    
    -- Neck weld
    local neck = Instance.new("Weld")
    neck.Part0 = torso
    neck.Part1 = head
    neck.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1, 0)
    neck.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
    neck.Parent = torso
    
    zombie.PrimaryPart = torso
    
    return zombie
end

function ZombieModule:SpawnZombie(position)
    if #self.ActiveZombies >= Config.Zombie.MaxCount then return end
    
    -- Validate spawn position
    local groundPos = Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    if not Utils.IsPositionSafe(groundPos, 3) then return end
    
    local zombie = self:CreateZombieRig()
    zombie:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(groundPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
    zombie.Parent = workspace
    
    local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    
    -- Apply hallucination effect
    local isHallucination = math.random() < Config.Zombie.HallucinationChance
    if isHallucination then
        for _, part in pairs(zombie:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
                part.Transparency = 0.3
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Store zombie data
    local zombieData = {
        Model = zombie,
        Humanoid = humanoid,
        IsHallucination = isHallucination,
        LastPathUpdate = 0,
        CurrentPath = nil,
        Target = nil,
        SpawnTime = tick()
    }
    
    table.insert(self.ActiveZombies, zombieData)
    
    -- Damage connection
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    end)
    
    return zombieData
end

function ZombieModule:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    local zombie = zombieData.Model
    if not zombie or not zombie.Parent then
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
        return
    end
    
    local humanoid = zombieData.Humanoid
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    -- Despawn if too far from train
    local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local distanceToTrain = (zombie.PrimaryPart.Position - trainPos).Magnitude
    
    if distanceToTrain > Config.Zombie.DespawnRadius then
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
        return
    end
    
    -- Update pathfinding periodically
    if tick() - zombieData.LastPathUpdate > 2 then
        zombieData.LastPathUpdate = tick()
        
        -- Find nearest player or train
        local target = self:FindNearestTarget(zombie.PrimaryPart.Position)
        if target then
            zombieData.Target = target
            
            -- Create path
            local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                AgentRadius = 2,
                AgentHeight = 5,
                AgentCanJump = true
            })
            
            local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
                path:ComputeAsync(zombie.PrimaryPart.Position, target.Position)
            end)
            
            if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                zombieData.CurrentPath = path
                local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                
                -- Move to first waypoint
                if #waypoints > 1 then
                    humanoid:MoveTo(waypoints[2].Position)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Attack if close to target
    if zombieData.Target then
        local distance = (zombie.PrimaryPart.Position - zombieData.Target.Position).Magnitude
        if distance < 5 then
            self:AttackTarget(zombieData, zombieData.Target)
        end
    end
end

function ZombieModule:FindNearestTarget(position)
    local nearest = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    
    -- Check players
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (hrp.Position - position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDist then
                minDist = dist
                nearest = hrp
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Check train if no players nearby
    if minDist > 50 and Train.Wagons[1] then
        nearest = Train.Wagons[1].Part
    end
    
    return nearest
end

function ZombieModule:AttackTarget(zombieData, target)
    -- Simple damage application with cooldown
    if not zombieData.LastAttackTime or tick() - zombieData.LastAttackTime > 1 then
        zombieData.LastAttackTime = tick()
        
        if target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            -- Damage player
            target.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(Config.Zombie.BaseDamage)
        elseif target.Name:match("Wagon") then
            -- Damage train
            Train:TakeDamage(Config.Zombie.BaseDamage)
        end
    end
end

function ZombieModule:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    for i, zd in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        if zd == zombieData then
            table.remove(self.ActiveZombies, i)
            break
        end
    end
    
    if zombieData.Model then
        -- Create corpse with ragdoll
        Debris:AddItem(zombieData.Model, 5)
    end
end

function ZombieModule:UpdateAll(deltaTime)
    -- Update all zombies (throttled)
    for _, zombieData in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        self:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    end
    
    -- Spawn new zombies
    if tick() - self.LastSpawnTime > Config.Zombie.SpawnInterval then
        self.LastSpawnTime = tick()
        
        -- Spawn around train
        local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local distance = Config.Zombie.SpawnRadius
        local spawnPos = trainPos + Vector3.new(
            math.cos(angle) * distance,
            0,
            math.sin(angle) * distance
        )
        
        self:SpawnZombie(spawnPos)
    end
end

        SpawnInterval = 8,
        MaxCount = 20,
        SpawnRadius = 50,
        DespawnRadius = 200,
        BaseHealth = 100,
        BaseDamage = 10,
        BaseSpeed = 12,
        HallucinationChance = 0.3
    },
    Gameplay = {
        MaxDays = 99,
        DayDuration = 300, -- seconds
        DifficultyScale = 1.1 -- per day multiplier
    },
    Performance = {
        TickRate = 1/30, -- AI update rate
        CleanupInterval = 10
    }
}

-- UTILITY FUNCTIONS
local Utils = {}

function Utils.CreateWeld(part0, part1, offset)
    local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    weld.Part0 = part0
    weld.Part1 = part1
    weld.Parent = part0
    return weld
end

function Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    local ray = Ray.new(position, Vector3.new(0, -100, 0))
    local hit, hitPosition = workspace:FindPartOnRay(ray, nil, false, true)
    return hitPosition or position
end

function Utils.IsPositionSafe(position, radius)
    local region = Region3.new(position - Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius), 
                               position + Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius))
    region.ExpandToGrid(4)
    local parts = workspace:FindPartsInRegion3(region, nil, 100)
    return #parts < 5 -- Simple obstruction check
end

-- TRAIN MODULE (Fixed)
local Train = {}
Train.Wagons = {}
Train.Health = Config.Train.MaxHealth
Train.IsActive = true

function Train:Initialize()
    -- Create container for organization
    local trainFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    trainFolder.Name = "Train"
    trainFolder.Parent = workspace
    
    local previousWagon = nil
    
    for i = 1, Config.Train.WagonCount do
        local wagon = Instance.new("Part")
        wagon.Size = Vector3.new(10, 6, 10)
        wagon.Position = Vector3.new(i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing, 10, 0)
        wagon.Anchored = true -- Keep anchored, move via CFrame
        wagon.Name = "Wagon_" .. i
        wagon.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        wagon.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
        wagon.Parent = trainFolder
        
        -- Add health tracking
        local healthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
        healthValue.Name = "Health"
        healthValue.Value = Config.Train.MaxHealth
        healthValue.Parent = wagon
        
        -- Visual platform for players
        local platform = Instance.new("Part")
        platform.Size = Vector3.new(9, 1, 9)
        platform.Position = wagon.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
        platform.Anchored = true
        platform.Name = "Platform"
        platform.Parent = wagon
        
        table.insert(self.Wagons, {
            Part = wagon,
            Platform = platform,
            Offset = i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing
        })
        
        previousWagon = wagon
    end
    
    self.Folder = trainFolder
end

function Train:Update(deltaTime)
    if not self.IsActive then return end
    
    -- Move train along path (simple forward movement)
    for i, wagon in ipairs(self.Wagons) do
        local currentCF = wagon.Part.CFrame
        local movement = Vector3.new(Config.Train.Speed * deltaTime, 0, 0)
        
        wagon.Part.CFrame = currentCF + movement
        wagon.Platform.CFrame = wagon.Part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
    end
end

function Train:TakeDamage(amount)
    self.Health = math.max(0, self.Health - amount)
    if self.Health <= 0 then
        self:Destroy()
    end
end

function Train:Destroy()
    self.IsActive = false
    if self.Folder then
        self.Folder:Destroy()
    end
    -- Trigger game over
    print("❌ Train Destroyed - Game Over")
end

-- ZOMBIE MODULE (Fixed with proper AI)
local ZombieModule = {}
ZombieModule.ActiveZombies = {}
ZombieModule.ZombiePool = {} -- Object pooling
ZombieModule.LastSpawnTime = 0
ZombieModule.CurrentDay = 1

function ZombieModule:CreateZombieRig()
    -- Create proper R6-style rig with Humanoid
    local zombie = Instance.new("Model")
    zombie.Name = "Zombie"
    
    local torso = Instance.new("Part")
    torso.Name = "Torso"
    torso.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
    torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    torso.Parent = zombie
    
    local head = Instance.new("Part")
    head.Name = "Head"
    head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
    head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    head.Position = torso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
    head.Parent = zombie
    
    -- Humanoid for pathfinding
    local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Name = "Humanoid"
    humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Zombie.BaseHealth * (Config.Gameplay.DifficultyScale ^ (self.CurrentDay - 1))
    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Zombie.BaseSpeed
    humanoid.Parent = zombie
    
    -- Neck weld
    local neck = Instance.new("Weld")
    neck.Part0 = torso
    neck.Part1 = head
    neck.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1, 0)
    neck.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
    neck.Parent = torso
    
    zombie.PrimaryPart = torso
    
    return zombie
end

function ZombieModule:SpawnZombie(position)
    if #self.ActiveZombies >= Config.Zombie.MaxCount then return end
    
    -- Validate spawn position
    local groundPos = Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    if not Utils.IsPositionSafe(groundPos, 3) then return end
    
    local zombie = self:CreateZombieRig()
    zombie:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(groundPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
    zombie.Parent = workspace
    
    local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    
    -- Apply hallucination effect
    local isHallucination = math.random() < Config.Zombie.HallucinationChance
    if isHallucination then
        for _, part in pairs(zombie:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
                part.Transparency = 0.3
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Store zombie data
    local zombieData = {
        Model = zombie,
        Humanoid = humanoid,
        IsHallucination = isHallucination,
        LastPathUpdate = 0,
        CurrentPath = nil,
        Target = nil,
        SpawnTime = tick()
    }
    
    table.insert(self.ActiveZombies, zombieData)
    
    -- Damage connection
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    end)
    
    return zombieData
end

function ZombieModule:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    local zombie = zombieData.Model
    if not zombie or not zombie.Parent then
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
        return
    end
    
    local humanoid = zombieData.Humanoid
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    -- Despawn if too far from train
    local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local distanceToTrain = (zombie.PrimaryPart.Position - trainPos).Magnitude
    
    if distanceToTrain > Config.Zombie.DespawnRadius then
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
        return
    end
    
    -- Update pathfinding periodically
    if tick() - zombieData.LastPathUpdate > 2 then
        zombieData.LastPathUpdate = tick()
        
        -- Find nearest player or train
        local target = self:FindNearestTarget(zombie.PrimaryPart.Position)
        if target then
            zombieData.Target = target
            
            -- Create path
            local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                AgentRadius = 2,
                AgentHeight = 5,
                AgentCanJump = true
            })
            
            local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
                path:ComputeAsync(zombie.PrimaryPart.Position, target.Position)
            end)
            
            if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                zombieData.CurrentPath = path
                local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                
                -- Move to first waypoint
                if #waypoints > 1 then
                    humanoid:MoveTo(waypoints[2].Position)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Attack if close to target
    if zombieData.Target then
        local distance = (zombie.PrimaryPart.Position - zombieData.Target.Position).Magnitude
        if distance < 5 then
            self:AttackTarget(zombieData, zombieData.Target)
        end
    end
end

function ZombieModule:FindNearestTarget(position)
    local nearest = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    
    -- Check players
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (hrp.Position - position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDist then
                minDist = dist
                nearest = hrp
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Check train if no players nearby
    if minDist > 50 and Train.Wagons[1] then
        nearest = Train.Wagons[1].Part
    end
    
    return nearest
end

function ZombieModule:AttackTarget(zombieData, target)
    -- Simple damage application with cooldown
    if not zombieData.LastAttackTime or tick() - zombieData.LastAttackTime > 1 then
        zombieData.LastAttackTime = tick()
        
        if target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            -- Damage player
            target.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(Config.Zombie.BaseDamage)
        elseif target.Name:match("Wagon") then
            -- Damage train
            Train:TakeDamage(Config.Zombie.BaseDamage)
        end
    end
end

function ZombieModule:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    for i, zd in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        if zd == zombieData then
            table.remove(self.ActiveZombies, i)
            break
        end
    end
    
    if zombieData.Model then
        -- Create corpse with ragdoll
        Debris:AddItem(zombieData.Model, 5)
    end
end

function ZombieModule:UpdateAll(deltaTime)
    -- Update all zombies (throttled)
    for _, zombieData in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        self:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    end
    
    -- Spawn new zombies
    if tick() - self.LastSpawnTime > Config.Zombie.SpawnInterval then
        self.LastSpawnTime = tick()
        
        -- Spawn around train
        local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local distance = Config.Zombie.SpawnRadius
        local spawnPos = trainPos + Vector3.new(
            math.cos(angle) * distance,
            0,
            math.sin(angle) * distance
        )
        
        self:SpawnZombie(spawnPos)
    end
end

-- PLAYER MANAGEMENT (Fixed)
local PlayerManager = {}

function PlayerManager:SetupPlayer(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        -- Spawn on train platform
        if Train.Wagons[1] then
            hrp.CFrame = Train.Wagons[1].Platform.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        end
        
        -- Give basic weapon (proper tool setup needed in separate script)
        local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
        sword.Name = "Sword"
        sword.RequiresHandle = false
        sword.Parent = player.Backpack
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    PlayerManager:SetupPlayer(player)
end)

-- MAIN GAME LOOP (Fixed with proper delta time)
Train:Initialize()

local lastUpdate = tick()
local accumulator = 0

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local currentTime = tick()
    local deltaTime = currentTime - lastUpdate
    lastUpdate = currentTime
    
    accumulator = accumulator + deltaTime
    
    -- Fixed timestep for physics
    while accumulator >= Config.Performance.TickRate do
        Train:Update(Config.Performance.TickRate)
        ZombieModule:UpdateAll(Config.Performance.TickRate)
        accumulator = accumulator - Config.Performance.TickRate
    end
end)

-- Cleanup on shutdown
game:BindToClose(function()
    Train:Destroy()
    for _, zombieData in ipairs(ZombieModule.ActiveZombies) do
        ZombieModule:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    end
end)

print("✅ Survive a Brainrot - Production Server Initialized")
print("📊 Config: " .. Config.Zombie.MaxCount .. " max zombies, " .. Config.Train.WagonCount .. " wagons")

        <div class="logo-sub">Natural English Training</div>

### Solution 1: API Input Sanitization
```javascript
// File: middleware/sanitizer.js
const sanitizeInput = (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    // Sanitize query parameters
    if (req.query.msg) {
      req.query.msg = req.query.msg
        .toString()
        .trim()
        .replace(/[<>\"\']/g, '') // Remove HTML/script tags
        .substring(0, 1000); // Limit length
    }
    if (req.query.agent) {
      req.query.agent = req.query.agent
        .toString()
        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '')
        .substring(0, 50);
    }
    
    // Sanitize URL path to prevent directory traversal
    if (req.params.file) {
      req.params.file = req.params.file.replace(/\.\./g, '');
    }
    
    next();
  } catch (error) {
    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid input parameters' }));
  }
};

// In server.js - Apply globally
const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  // Create fake request context for middleware
  const reqContext = { query: {}, params: {} };
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:4200`);
  url.searchParams.forEach((value, key) => {
    reqContext.query[key] = value;
  });
  
  sanitizeInput(reqContext, res, () => {
    req.query = reqContext.query;
    // Continue with normal request handling
  });
});
```

```powershell
# File: PHOENIX_V39_Setup.ps1
function Invoke-RestMethodWithRetry {
    param(
        [string]$Uri,
        [int]$TimeoutSec = 5,
        [int]$MaxRetries = 3
    )
    
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $MaxRetries; $i++) {
        try {
            $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $Uri `
                -TimeoutSec $TimeoutSec `
                -ErrorAction Stop
            return $response
        } catch {
            Write-Host "[!] Attempt $i/$MaxRetries failed: $_"
            if ($i -eq $MaxRetries) {
                throw "Failed to connect after $MaxRetries attempts"
            }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        }
    }
}

# Usage
```

### Solution 7: CORS Origin Validation
```javascript
// File: middleware/cors.js
const allowedOrigins = [
  'http://localhost:4200',
  'http://127.0.0.1:4200',
  'file://', // For local HTML files
  'null' // For file:// protocol
];

function setCorsHeaders(req, res) {
  const origin = req.headers.origin || req.headers.referer || 'null';
  
  // Check if origin is allowed
  const isAllowed = allowedOrigins.some(allowed => {
    if (allowed === 'file://' && origin.startsWith('file://')) return true;
    return origin === allowed || origin.startsWith(allowed);
  });
  
  if (isAllowed) {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);
  } else {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', 'null');
  }
  
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');
  
  // Handle preflight
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.writeHead(204);
    res.end();
    return true; // Indicates preflight handled
  }
  
  return false;
}

// In server.js
const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  if (setCorsHeaders(req, res)) return; // Preflight handled
  // ... rest of request handling
});
```

```powershell
}
```

```javascript
// File: utils/hash-verifier.js
const fs = require('fs');
const { execSync } = require('child_process');

function verifyHashFile(hashFile) {
  const signatureFile = `${hashFile}.asc`;
  
  if (!fs.existsSync(signatureFile)) {
    throw new Error(`Signature file not found: ${signatureFile}`);
  }
  
  try {
    execSync(`gpg --verify ${signatureFile} ${hashFile}`, {
      stdio: 'pipe'
    });
    console.log('✅ Hash file signature valid');
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Hash file signature INVALID or GPG not installed');
    throw new Error('Hash verification failed');
  }
}

module.exports = { verifyHashFile };
```

### Solution 11: Smart Health Check Loop
```powershell
# File: PHOENIX_V39_Setup.ps1
function Wait-ForServerReady {
    param(
        [string]$Url,
        [int]$MaxAttempts = 30,
        [int]$DelaySeconds = 1
    )
    
    Write-Host "[*] Waiting for server at $Url..."
    
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $MaxAttempts; $i++) {
        try {
            $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $Url -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop
            if ($response.success -or $response.status -eq "ok") {
                Write-Host "✅ Server is ready! (Attempt $i)"
                return $true
            }
        } catch {
            Write-Host "." -NoNewline
        }
        Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds
    }
    
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "❌ Server did not respond after $MaxAttempts attempts"
    return $false
}

# Usage
if (Wait-ForServerReady -Url "http://localhost:$PORT/health_check") {
    Write-Host "[*] Proceeding with operations..."
} else {
    throw "Server failed to start"
}
```

### Solution 12: Incremental Backup Strategy
```powershell
# File: scripts/smart-backup.ps1
param(
    [string]$SourceDir = ".",
    [string]$BackupRoot = "C:\Backups\PHOENIX",
    [switch]$Incremental
)

$timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd_HHmmss"
$BackupDir = Join-Path $BackupRoot "Backup_$timestamp"

# Ensure backup directory exists
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null

# Excluded patterns
$excludePatterns = @(
    "node_modules",
    "*.log",
    "*.pid",
    ".git",
    "Backups",
    "db.json"
)

Write-Host "[*] Creating backup: $BackupDir"

if ($Incremental) {
    # Find the last backup
    $lastBackup = Get-ChildItem -Path $BackupRoot -Directory | 
        Sort-Object Name -Descending | 
        Select-Object -First 1
    
    if ($lastBackup) {
        Write-Host "[*] Incremental backup from: $($lastBackup.Name)"
        
        # Use Robocopy for incremental backup (much faster)
        $excludeArgs = $excludePatterns | ForEach-Object { "/XD $_" }
        robocopy $SourceDir $BackupDir /MIR /XO /R:2 /W:1 $excludeArgs /LOG:"$BackupDir\backup.log"
    }
} else {
    # Full backup
    Get-ChildItem -Path $SourceDir -Recurse | ForEach-Object {
        $shouldExclude = $false
        foreach ($pattern in $excludePatterns) {
            if ($_.FullName -like "*$pattern*") {
                $shouldExclude = $true
                break
            }
        }
        
        if (-not $shouldExclude) {
            $relativePath = $_.FullName.Substring($SourceDir.Length)
            $destPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath
            
            if ($_.PSIsContainer) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destPath -Force | Out-Null
            } else {
                Copy-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $destPath -Force
            }
        }
    }
}

Write-Host "✅ Backup complete: $BackupDir"

# Clean up old backups (keep last 10)
$allBackups = Get-ChildItem -Path $BackupRoot -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending
if ($allBackups.Count -gt 10) {
    $allBackups | Select-Object -Skip 10 | ForEach-Object {
        Write-Host "[*] Removing old backup: $($_.Name)"
        Remove-Item -Path $_.FullName -Recurse -Force
    }
}
```

### Solution 13: Persistent Chat History with LowDB
```javascript
// File: db/chatHistory.js
// npm install lowdb@3.0.0

const { Low } = require('lowdb');
const { JSONFile } = require('lowdb/node');
const path = require('path');

class ChatHistoryDB {
  constructor(dbPath = './data/chatHistory.json') {
    this.dbPath = dbPath;
    this.db = null;
  }
  
  async init() {
    // Ensure data directory exists
    const dir = path.dirname(this.dbPath);
    const fs = require('fs');
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    }
    
    const adapter = new JSONFile(this.dbPath);
    this.db = new Low(adapter, { chatHistory: {} });
    
    await this.db.read();
    
    // Initialize structure if empty
    this.db.data = this.db.data || { chatHistory: {} };
    
    console.log(`[DB] Chat history loaded from ${this.dbPath}`);
  }
  
  async addMessage(agent, role, content) {
    if (!this.db.data.chatHistory[agent]) {
      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = [];
    }
    
    this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].push({
      role,
      content,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    
    // Limit history per agent to 100 messages
    if (this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].length > 100) {
      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].slice(-100);
    }
    
    await this.db.write();
  }
  
  async getHistory(agent, limit = null) {
    const history = this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] || [];
    return limit ? history.slice(-limit) : history;
  }
  
  async clearHistory(agent) {
    if (agent) {
      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = [];
    } else {
      this.db.data.chatHistory = {};
    }
    await this.db.write();
  }
  
  async getAllAgents() {
    return Object.keys(this.db.data.chatHistory);
  }
}

module.exports = ChatHistoryDB;

// Usage in server.js
const ChatHistoryDB = require('./db/chatHistory');
const chatDB = new ChatHistoryDB();

(async () => {
  await chatDB.init();
  
  // In API handlers:
  // await chatDB.addMessage('agent1', 'user', 'Hello');
  // const history = await chatDB.getHistory('agent1', 10);
})();
```

```powershell
# File: scripts/verify-hashes.ps1
param(
    [string]$HashFile = "MASTER_HASHES.csv",
    [string]$BatchFolder = ".\MASTER_BATCHES"

Write-Host "[*] Loading hash database..."

# Load all hashes into memory once

    $hashDatabase[$_.FileName] = $_.Hash
}

Write-Host "[*] Verifying $($hashDatabase.Count) files..."

$failures = @()
$verified = 0

Get-ChildItem -Path $BatchFolder -Filter "*.txt" | ForEach-Object {
    $expectedHash = $hashDatabase[$_.Name]
    
    if ($null -eq $expectedHash) {
        $failures += "Missing hash for: $($_.Name)"
        return
    }
    
    $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Path $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    
    if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) {
        $failures += "Hash mismatch: $($_.Name)"
    } else {
        $verified++
    }
}

Write-Host "✅ Verified: $verified files"

if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host "❌ Failures: $($failures.Count)"
    $failures | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "   $_" }
    exit 1
}
```

### Solution 15: Paginated History Endpoint
```javascript
// File: routes/history.js
async function handleHistoryRequest(req, res, chatDB) {
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost`);
  const agent = url.searchParams.get('agent');
  const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit')) || 50;
  const offset = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('offset')) || 0;
  
  if (!agent) {
    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Agent parameter required' }));
    return;
  }
  
  try {
    const fullHistory = await chatDB.getHistory(agent);
    const total = fullHistory.length;
    const paginatedHistory = fullHistory.slice(offset, offset + limit);
    
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({
      agent,
      messages: paginatedHistory,
      pagination: {
        total,
        limit,
        offset,
        hasMore: (offset + limit) < total
      }
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Failed to retrieve history' }));
  }
}

module.exports = { handleHistoryRequest };
```

```javascript
// File: routes/analysis.js
const { Worker } = require('worker_threads');
const path = require('path');

async function runProAnalysis(data) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const worker = new Worker(
      path.join(__dirname, '../workers/pro-analysis-worker.js'),
      { workerData: data }
    );
    
    worker.on('message', resolve);
    worker.on('error', reject);
    worker.on('exit', (code) => {
      if (code !== 0) {
        reject(new Error(`Worker stopped with exit code ${code}`));
      }
    });
    
    // Timeout after 30 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      worker.terminate();
      reject(new Error('Analysis timeout'));
    }, 30000);
  });
}

module.exports = { runProAnalysis };
```

### Solution 19: Cached Asset List
```javascript
// File: cache/assetCache.js
class AssetCache {
  constructor(ttlSeconds = 300) {
    this.cache = null;
    this.lastUpdate = null;
    this.ttl = ttlSeconds * 1000; // Convert to milliseconds
  }
  
  isValid() {
    if (!this.cache || !this.lastUpdate) return false;
    return (Date.now() - this.lastUpdate) < this.ttl;
  }
  
  get(runtime) {
    if (this.isValid()) {
      return this.cache;
    }
    
    // Refresh cache
    this.cache = Object.keys(runtime.getAssetList());
    this.lastUpdate = Date.now();
    console.log(`[CACHE] Asset list refreshed (${this.cache.length} assets)`);
    
    return this.cache;
  }
  
  invalidate() {
    this.cache = null;
    this.lastUpdate = null;
  }
}

module.exports = AssetCache;

// Usage in server.js
const AssetCache = require('./cache/assetCache');
const assetCache = new AssetCache(300); // 5 minute TTL

// In /assets endpoint
if (url.pathname === '/assets') {
  const assets = assetCache.get(cs.runtime);
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  res.end(JSON.stringify({ assets, cached: true }));
  return;
}
```

### Solution 20: Async File Operations
```javascript
// File: utils/asyncFileWriter.js
const fs = require('fs').promises;
const path = require('path');

class AsyncFileWriter {
  constructor(outputDir = './output') {
    this.outputDir = outputDir;
    this.queue = [];
    this.processing = false;
  }
  
  async ensureDir() {
    try {
      await fs.mkdir(this.outputDir, { recursive: true });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[FileWriter] Error creating directory:', error);
    }
  }
  
  async write(filename, data) {
    await this.ensureDir();
    
    const filePath = path.join(this.outputDir, filename);
    
    try {
      const jsonData = typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
      await fs.writeFile(filePath, jsonData, 'utf8');
      console.log(`[FileWriter] ✅ Written: ${filePath}`);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[FileWriter] ❌ Failed to write ${filePath}:`, error);
      return false;
    }
  }
  
  // Queue multiple writes and process them sequentially
  queueWrite(filename, data) {
    this.queue.push({ filename, data });
    if (!this.processing) {
      this.processQueue();
    }
  }
  
  async processQueue() {
    if (this.queue.length === 0) {
      this.processing = false;
      return;
    }
    
    this.processing = true;
    const { filename, data } = this.queue.shift();
    await this.write(filename, data);
    
    // Process next item
    setImmediate(() => this.processQueue());
  }
}

module.exports = AsyncFileWriter;

// Usage in gemini_pro_audit.js
const AsyncFileWriter = require('./utils/asyncFileWriter');
const writer = new AsyncFileWriter('./output');

// Instead of: fs.writeFileSync('FINAL_MAJOR_CONTRIBUTION.json', JSON.stringify(result))
await writer.write('FINAL_MAJOR_CONTRIBUTION.json', result);
```

### Solution 21: Global Error Handler for HTTP Server
```javascript
// File: middleware/errorHandler.js
function wrapAsyncHandler(handler) {
  return async (req, res) => {
    try {
      await handler(req, res);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[ERROR] Unhandled exception in request handler:', error);
      
      if (!res.headersSent) {
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({
          error: 'Internal server error',
          message: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? error.message : undefined,
          requestId: req.id || Date.now()
        }));
      }
    }
  };
}

// File: server.js
const server = http.createServer(wrapAsyncHandler(async (req, res) => {
  // Add request ID for tracking
  req.id = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2);
  
  // All your request handling logic here
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  
  // Route handling...
  if (url.pathname === '/api/chat') {
    await handleChatRequest(req, res);
  }
  // ... etc
}));

// Uncaught exception handler
process.on('uncaughtException', (error) => {
  console.error('[FATAL] Uncaught exception:', error);
  console.error(error.stack);
  // Log to file before exit
  fs.appendFileSync('./logs/crash.log', 
    `[${new Date().toISOString()}] UNCAUGHT: ${error.stack}\n`);
  process.exit(1);
});

// Unhandled promise rejection handler
process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason, promise) => {
  console.error('[FATAL] Unhandled promise rejection:', reason);
  fs.appendFileSync('./logs/crash.log', 
    `[${new Date().toISOString()}] UNHANDLED REJECTION: ${reason}\n`);
});
```

### Solution 23: Robust JSON Parsing
```javascript
// File: utils/safeJsonParser.js
function safeJsonParse(text, fallback = null) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[JSON] Parse error:', error.message);
    console.error('[JSON] Input (first 200 chars):', text.substring(0, 200));
    return fallback;
  }
}

async function requestJSON(url, options = {}) {
  const https = require('https');
  const http = require('http');
  
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const client = url.startsWith('https') ? https : http;
    
    const req = client.get(url, options, (res) => {
      let data = '';
      
      res.on('data', (chunk) => {
        data += chunk;
      });
      
      res.on('end', () => {
        // Check content type
        const contentType = res.headers['content-type'] || '';
        
        if (!contentType.includes('application/json')) {
          reject(new Error(`Expected JSON, got ${contentType}. Response: ${data.substring(0, 200)}`));
          return;
        }
        
        // Check status code
        if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
          reject(new Error(`HTTP ${res.statusCode}: ${data}`));
          return;
        }
        
        const parsed = safeJsonParse(data);
        if (parsed === null) {
          reject(new Error('JSON parse failed'));
        } else {
          resolve(parsed);
        }
      });
    });
    
    req.on('error', reject);
    req.setTimeout(10000, () => {
      req.destroy();
      reject(new Error('Request timeout'));
    });
  });
}

module.exports = { safeJsonParse, requestJSON };
```

### Solution 24: Safe Git Push with Force-With-Lease
```powershell
# File: scripts/safe-git-push.ps1
param(
    [string]$Branch = "master-save",
    [string]$Remote = "origin"
)

Write-Host "[*] Preparing to push to $Remote/$Branch"

# Fetch remote changes first
Write-Host "[*] Fetching remote changes..."
git fetch $Remote

# Check if remote branch exists
$remoteBranch = git rev-parse --verify "$Remote/$Branch" 2>$null

if ($remoteBranch) {
    # Check for divergence
    $ahead = (git rev-list --count "$Remote/$Branch..HEAD")
    $behind = (git rev-list --count "HEAD..$Remote/$Branch")
    
    Write-Host "[*] Local is $ahead commits ahead, $behind commits behind remote"
    
    if ($behind -gt 0) {
        Write-Host "⚠️  WARNING: Remote has $behind commits not in local branch"
        $response = Read-Host "Continue with push? This may overwrite remote changes (y/N)"
        if ($response -ne 'y') {
            Write-Host "❌ Push cancelled"
            exit 0
        }
    }
}

# Use --force-with-lease for safer forced push
Write-Host "[*] Pushing to $Remote/$Branch..."
try {
    git push -u $Remote $Branch --force-with-lease 2>&1 | Tee-Object -Variable gitOutput
    
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Host "❌ Push failed!"
        Write-Host $gitOutput
        exit 1
    }
    
    Write-Host "✅ Push successful"
} catch {
    Write-Host "❌ Push error: $_"
    exit 1
}
```

### Solution 25: Critical Hash Validation
```powershell
# File: scripts/validate-integrity.ps1
param(
    [string]$HashFile = "MASTER_HASHES.csv",
    [string]$BatchFolder = ".\MASTER_BATCHES",
    [switch]$StopOnError
)

$ErrorCount = 0
$hashData = Import-Csv $HashFile

Write-Host "[*] Validating integrity of $($hashData.Count) files..."

foreach ($entry in $hashData) {
    $filePath = Join-Path $BatchFolder $entry.FileName
    
    if (-not (Test-Path $filePath)) {
        Write-Host "❌ MISSING: $($entry.FileName)"
        $ErrorCount++
        if ($StopOnError) { exit 1 }
        continue
    }
    
    $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Path $filePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    
    if ($actualHash -ne $entry.Hash) {
        Write-Host "❌ TAMPERED: $($entry.FileName)"
        Write-Host "   Expected: $($entry.Hash)"
        Write-Host "   Actual:   $actualHash"
        $ErrorCount++
        if ($StopOnError) { exit 1 }
    }
}

if ($ErrorCount -eq 0) {
    Write-Host "✅ All files validated successfully"
    exit 0
} else {
    Write-Host "❌ CRITICAL: $ErrorCount integrity violations detected!"
    exit 1
}
```

```javascript
// File: routes/chat.js
async function handleSendMessage(req, res) {
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost`);
  const msg = url.searchParams.get('msg');
  const agent = url.searchParams.get('agent');
  
  // Validate required parameters
  if (!msg || msg.trim() === '') {
    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({
      error: 'Bad Request',
      message: 'Parameter "msg" is required and cannot be empty'
    }));
    return; // CRITICAL: Return to prevent further execution
  }
  
  if (!agent || agent.trim() === '') {
    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({
      error: 'Bad Request',
      message: 'Parameter "agent" is required'
    }));
    return;
  }
  
  // Process valid request
  try {
    const response = await processMessage(agent, msg);
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(response));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ERROR] Message processing failed:', error);
    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({
      error: 'Internal Server Error',
      message: 'Failed to process message'
    }));
  }
}

module.exports = { handleSendMessage };
```

```powershell
# File: scripts/check-git-environment.ps1
function Test-GitInstallation {
    try {
        $gitVersion = git --version 2>&1
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) {
            Write-Host "✅ Git found: $gitVersion"
            return $true
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Host "❌ Git not found in PATH"
        return $false
    }
    return $false
}

function Get-GitExecutablePath {
    # Common Git installation paths
    $commonPaths = @(
        "C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe",
        "C:\Program Files (x86)\Git\bin\git.exe",
        "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Git\bin\git.exe"
    )
    
    foreach ($path in $commonPaths) {
        if (Test-Path $path) {
            return $path
        }
    }
    
    return $null
}

# Main check
if (-not (Test-GitInstallation)) {
    Write-Host "[!] Attempting to locate Git..."
    $gitPath = Get-GitExecutablePath
    
    if ($gitPath) {
        Write-Host "[*] Found Git at: $gitPath"
        Write-Host "[*] Adding to PATH for this session..."
        $env:Path += ";$(Split-Path $gitPath -Parent)"
        
        if (Test-GitInstallation) {
            Write-Host "✅ Git is now available"
        }
    } else {
        Write-Host "❌ CRITICAL: Git is not installed or not found"
        Write-Host "[*] Install Git from: https://git-scm.com/download/win"
        exit 1
    }
}
```

### Solution 30: Protected Backup Operation
```powershell
# File: scripts/safe-backup.ps1
param(
    [string]$SourceDir = ".",
    [string]$BackupRoot = "C:\Backups\PHOENIX"
)

Write-Host "[*] Starting backup operation..."

try {
    # Validate source directory
    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceDir)) {
        throw "Source directory does not exist: $SourceDir"
    }
    
    # Ensure backup root exists
    if (-not (Test-Path $BackupRoot)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupRoot -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    }
    
    # Check available disk space (require at least 1GB free)
    $drive = (Get-Item $BackupRoot).PSDrive
    $freeSpace = (Get-PSDrive $drive.Name).Free
    $requiredSpace = 1GB
    
    if ($freeSpace -lt $requiredSpace) {
        throw "Insufficient disk space. Available: $([math]::Round($freeSpace/1GB, 2))GB, Required: $([math]::Round($requiredSpace/1GB, 2))GB"
    }
    
    # Create timestamped backup folder
    $timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd_HHmmss"
    $backupDir = Join-Path $BackupRoot "Backup_$timestamp"
    
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $backupDir -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    
    # Perform backup with error handling
    Write-Host "[*] Copying files to: $backupDir"
    
    Copy-Item -Path "$SourceDir\*" `
        -Destination $backupDir `
        -Recurse `
        -Exclude @("node_modules", "*.log", ".git", "Backups") `
        -ErrorAction Stop
    
    Write-Host "✅ Backup completed successfully: $backupDir"
    
} catch {
    Write-Host "❌ Backup failed: $_"
    Write-Host "[*] Stack trace: $($_.ScriptStackTrace)"
    exit 1
}
```

### Solution 31: Structured Logging
```javascript
// File: utils/logger.js
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

class Logger {
  constructor(logDir = './logs') {
    this.logDir = logDir;
    this.ensureLogDir();
  }
  
  ensureLogDir() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.logDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(this.logDir, { recursive: true });
    }
  }
  
  log(level, message, metadata = {}) {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const logEntry = {
      timestamp,
      level: level.toUpperCase(),
      message,
      ...metadata
    };
    
    // Console output with color
    const colors = {
      INFO: '\x1b[36m',
      WARN: '\x1b[33m',
      ERROR: '\x1b[31m',
      DEBUG: '\x1b[90m'
    };
    
    const color = colors[level.toUpperCase()] || '\x1b[0m';
    const reset = '\x1b[0m';
    
    console.log(`${color}[${timestamp}] [${level.toUpperCase()}]${reset} ${message}`, 
      Object.keys(metadata).length > 0 ? metadata : '');
    
    // Write to log file
    const logFile = path.join(this.logDir, `phoenix-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.log`);
    fs.appendFileSync(logFile, JSON.stringify(logEntry) + '\n');
  }
  
  info(message, metadata) {
    this.log('info', message, metadata);
  }
  
  warn(message, metadata) {
    this.log('warn', message, metadata);
  }
  
  error(message, metadata) {
    this.log('error', message, metadata);
  }
  
  debug(message, metadata) {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
      this.log('debug', message, metadata);
    }
  }
}

module.exports = new Logger();

// Usage in server.js
const logger = require('./utils/logger');

logger.info('Server starting', { port: PORT, env: process.env.NODE_ENV });
logger.error('Database connection failed', { error: err.message, code: err.code });
```
