                <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);" class="transition-all hover:bg-[var(--bg-elevated)]">
                  <td class="p-3">Modal System</td>
                  <td class="p-3"><span class="status-pill" style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: var(--warning); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);">Testing</span></td>
                  <td class="p-3 font-bold">95.3</td>
                  <td class="p-3"><span class="tier-badge">ADV3</span></td>
                </tr>
                <tr class="transition-all hover:bg-[var(--bg-elevated)]">
                  <td class="p-3">Data Table</td>
                  <td class="p-3"><span class="status-pill status-online"><div class="pulse-indicator"></div>Active</span></td>
                  <td class="p-3 font-bold">94.5</td>
                  <td class="p-3"><span class="tier-badge">ADV2</span></td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        `,
        code: '<table class="w-full">...</table>'
      },
      'CMP-004': {
        html: `
          <div class="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <div class="flex justify-between mb-2 text-sm">
                <span style="color: var(--text-secondary);">Design Progress</span>
                <span class="font-semibold" style="color: var(--text-primary);">87%</span>
              </div>
              <div class="w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style="background: var(--bg-tertiary);">
                <div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700" style="width: 87%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-glow)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-primary);"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div class="flex justify-between mb-2 text-sm">
                <span style="color: var(--text-secondary);">Development</span>
                <span class="font-semibold" style="color: var(--text-primary);">94%</span>
              </div>
              <div class="w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style="background: var(--bg-tertiary);">
                <div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700" style="width: 94%; background: var(--success); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--success);"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div class="flex justify-between mb-2 text-sm">
                <span style="color: var(--text-secondary);">Testing</span>
                <span class="font-semibold" style="color: var(--text-primary);">62%</span>
              </div>
              <div class="w-full h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style="background: var(--bg-tertiary);">
                <div class="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700" style="width: 62%; background: var(--warning); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--warning);"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        code: '<div class="progress-bar">...</div>'
      },
      'CMP-005': {
        html: `
          <div class="glass-morphism-elevated p-6 max-w-md mx-auto rounded-2xl" style="box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);">
            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold mb-3" style="color: var(--accent-glow);">Confirm Action</h3>
            <p class="mb-6 text-sm" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">This action cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to permanently delete this component from the library?</p>
            <div class="flex gap-3">
              <button class="btn-secondary flex-1">Cancel</button>
              <button class="btn-primary flex-1" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--error), #dc2626);">Delete</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        code: '<div class="modal">...</div>'
      },
      'CMP-006': {
        html: `
          <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
            <span style="color: var(--text-secondary);">Hover for info</span>
            <div class="relative group">
              <div class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold cursor-help" style="background: var(--accent-primary); color: white;">?</div>
              <div class="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs whitespace-nowrap opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none" style="background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--accent-primary); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);">
                This is a helpful tooltip message
                <div class="absolute top-full left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 border-4 border-transparent" style="border-top-color: var(--accent-primary);"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        code: '<div class="tooltip">...</div>'
      },
      'CMP-007': {
        html: `
          <div class="space-y-2">
            <div class="glass-morphism rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
              <button class="w-full p-4 flex justify-between items-center text-left transition-all hover:bg-[var(--bg-elevated)]">
                <span class="font-semibold">Section 1: Getting Started</span>
                <span style="color: var(--accent-primary);">▼</span>
              </button>
              <div class="p-4 text-sm" style="color: var(--text-secondary); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
                Welcome to the component library. This section covers the basics of implementing PHOENIX V30.35 components in your project.
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        code: '<div class="accordion">...</div>'
      },
      'CMP-008': {
        html: `
          <div>
            <div class="flex gap-1 mb-4" style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
              <button class="nav-link nav-link-active">Overview</button>
              <button class="nav-link">Analytics</button>
              <button class="nav-link">Settings</button>
            </div>
            <div class="p-4" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">
              <p>Tab content appears here with smooth transitions and proper accessibility support.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        code: '<div class="tabs">...</div>'
      },
      'CMP-009': {
        html: `
          <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <span class="tier-badge">NEW</span>
            <span class="status-pill status-online"><div class="pulse-indicator"></div>Active</span>
            <span class="status-pill" style="background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--info); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);">Beta</span>
            <span class="status-pill" style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: var(--warning); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);">Deprecated</span>
          </div>
        `,
        code: '<span class="badge">...</span>'
      },
      'CMP-010': {
        html: `
          <div class="space-y-3">
            <div class="glass-morphism p-4 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3" style="border-left: 3px solid var(--success);">
              <span style="color: var(--success); font-size: 1.5rem;">✓</span>
              <div>
                <div class="font-semibold mb-1">Success</div>
                <div class="text-sm" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">Your changes have been saved successfully.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-morphism p-4 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3" style="border-left: 3px solid var(--warning);">
              <span style="color: var(--warning); font-size: 1.5rem;">⚠</span>
              <div>
                <div class="font-semibold mb-1">Warning</div>
                <div class="text-sm" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">This action requires admin privileges.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="glass-morphism p-4 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3" style="border-left: 3px solid var(--error);">
              <span style="color: var(--error); font-size: 1.5rem;">✗</span>
              <div>
                <div class="font-semibold mb-1">Error</div>
                <div class="text-sm" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">Failed to connect to the server. Please try again.</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        code: '<div class="alert">...</div>'
      }
    };
    
    // Chart Initialization
    let chart = null;
    
    const initChart = () => {
      const ctx = document.getElementById('analytics-chart').getContext('2d');
      
      chart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: ['Learning', 'Speed', 'Compliance', 'Complexity', 'Production', 'Efficiency', 'Innovation'],
          datasets: [{
            data: [88, 92, 95, 85, 90, 88, 93],
            backgroundColor: [
              getCSSVar('--accent-primary'),
              getCSSVar('--accent-secondary'),
              getCSSVar('--success'),
              getCSSVar('--info'),
              getCSSVar('--accent-glow'),
              getCSSVar('--warning'),
              getCSSVar('--accent-primary')
            ],
            borderRadius: 8,
            borderSkipped: false
          }]
        },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
              backgroundColor: getCSSVar('--bg-elevated'),
              titleColor: getCSSVar('--text-primary'),
              bodyColor: getCSSVar('--text-secondary'),
              borderColor: getCSSVar('--accent-primary'),
              borderWidth: 1,
              padding: 12,
              displayColors: false,
              callbacks: {
                label: (context) => `Score: ${context.parsed.y.toFixed(1)}`
              }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            y: {
              beginAtZero: false,
              min: 70,
              max: 100,
              grid: {
                color: getCSSVar('--border-subtle'),
                drawBorder: false
              },
              ticks: {
                color: getCSSVar('--text-tertiary'),
                font: { size: 11 }
              }
            },
            x: {
              grid: { display: false },
              ticks: {
                color: getCSSVar('--text-secondary'),
                font: { size: 11, weight: '500' }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });
    };
    
    // Simulation Function
    const runSimulation = async () => {
      const btn = document.getElementById('simulate-btn');
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = '⏳ Simulating...';
      
      logger.log('info', 'Initiating performance simulation...');
      
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 800));
      
      const prng = new PRNG(Date.now());
      const newScores = Array(7).fill(0).map(() => prng.range(75, 98));
      
      chart.data.datasets[0].data = newScores;
      chart.update('active');
      
      const avgScore = newScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / newScores.length;
      document.getElementById('avg-score').textContent = avgScore.toFixed(1);
      document.getElementById('tier-rating').textContent = determineTier(avgScore);
      
      logger.log('success', `Simulation complete. Average score: ${avgScore.toFixed(1)} (${determineTier(avgScore)})`);
      
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.textContent = '▶ Run Simulation';
    };
    
    // Render Component
    let currentComponent = null;
    
    const renderComponent = async (componentId) => {
      if (activeOperations.has(componentId)) {
        logger.log('warning', 'Component already rendering');
        return;
      }
      
      const component = COMPONENTS.find(c => c.id === componentId);
      if (!component) return;
      
      currentComponent = componentId;
      activeOperations.add(componentId);
      updateActiveCount();
      
      const viewer = document.getElementById('live-viewer');
      const loadingBar = document.getElementById('loading-bar');
      
      loadingBar.classList.remove('hidden');
      logger.log('info', `Rendering ${component.name}...`);
      
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600));
      
      const template = TEMPLATES[componentId];
      const sanitized = DOMPurify.sanitize(template.html);
      
      viewer.innerHTML = `<div class="fade-in">${sanitized}</div>`;
      
      // Update active button state
      document.querySelectorAll('.component-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove('component-btn-active');
        if (btn.dataset.id === componentId) {
          btn.classList.add('component-btn-active');
        }
      });
      
      activeOperations.delete(componentId);
      updateActiveCount();
      loadingBar.classList.add('hidden');
      
      logger.log('success', `${component.name} rendered (Score: ${component.score})`);
    };
    
    // Render Component List
    const renderComponentList = (filter = 'ALL', searchTerm = '') => {
      const list = document.getElementById('component-list');
      list.innerHTML = '';
      
      const filtered = COMPONENTS.filter(c => {
        const matchesFilter = filter === 'ALL' || c.pillar === filter;
        const matchesSearch = c.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
        return matchesFilter && matchesSearch;
      });
      
      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        list.innerHTML = '<p class="text-sm text-center py-8" style="color: var(--text-tertiary);">No components found</p>';
        return;
      }
      
      filtered.forEach(component => {
        const btn = document.createElement('button');
        btn.className = 'component-btn';
        btn.dataset.id = component.id;
        
        if (currentComponent === component.id) {
          btn.classList.add('component-btn-active');
        }
        
        btn.innerHTML = `
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>${component.name}</span>
            <span class="text-xs font-bold" style="color: var(--accent-primary);">${component.score.toFixed(1)}</span>
          </div>
        `;
        
        btn.onclick = () => renderComponent(component.id);
        list.appendChild(btn);
      });
    };
    
    // Copy Code Function
    const copyCode = () => {
      if (!currentComponent) {
        logger.log('warning', 'No component selected to copy');
        return;
      }
      
      const template = TEMPLATES[currentComponent];
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(template.code).then(() => {
        logger.log('success', 'Code copied to clipboard');
        
        const btn = document.getElementById('copy-btn');
        const originalText = btn.textContent;
        btn.textContent = '✓ Copied!';
        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.textContent = originalText;
        }, 2000);
      }).catch(() => {
        logger.log('error', 'Failed to copy code');
      });
    };
    
    // Initialize Application
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      logger.log('success', 'PHOENIX V30.35 initialized');
      
      initChart();
      renderComponentList();
      
      // Event Listeners
      document.getElementById('pillar-filter').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        const searchTerm = document.getElementById('search-input').value;
        renderComponentList(e.target.value, searchTerm);
        logger.log('info', `Filter changed to ${e.target.value}`);
      });
      
      document.getElementById('search-input').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        const filter = document.getElementById('pillar-filter').value;
        renderComponentList(filter, e.target.value);
      });
      
      document.getElementById('simulate-btn').addEventListener('click', runSimulation);
      document.getElementById('copy-btn').addEventListener('click', copyCode);
      
      document.getElementById('mobile-menu-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.getElementById('mobile-menu').classList.toggle('hidden');
      });
      
      // Nav link interactions
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(l => l.classList.remove('nav-link-active'));
          link.classList.add('nav-link-active');
          logger.log('info', `Navigated to ${link.dataset.view}`);
        });
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>


<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>PHOENIX V30.35 - MARKET EDITION</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.0.6/dist/purify.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');
    
    :root {
      --bg-primary: #0a0a0f;
      --bg-secondary: #12121a;
      --bg-tertiary: #1a1a26;
      --bg-elevated: #22223a;
      --accent-primary: #a855f7;
      --accent-secondary: #8b5cf6;
      --accent-glow: #c084fc;
      --text-primary: #ffffff;
      --text-secondary: #a1a1aa;
      --text-tertiary: #71717a;
      --border-subtle: #27273a;
      --border-accent: #3f3f5e;
      --success: #22c55e;
      --warning: #f59e0b;
      --error: #ef4444;
      --info: #3b82f6;
    }
    
    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    
    body {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0a0a0f 0%, #12121a 50%, #0a0a0f 100%);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      min-height: 100vh;
      position: relative;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }
    
    .ambient-glow {
      position: fixed;
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      filter: blur(80px);
    }
    
    .glow-1 { top: -200px; left: -200px; }
    .glow-2 { bottom: -200px; right: -200px; }
    
    .content-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    
    .glass-morphism {
      background: rgba(26, 26, 38, 0.7);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    }
    
    .glass-morphism-elevated {
      background: rgba(34, 34, 58, 0.6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
    }
    
    .btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-primary) 0%, var(--accent-secondary) 100%);
      color: white;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    
    .btn-primary::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: -100%;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), transparent);
      transition: left 0.5s;
    }
    
    .btn-primary:hover::before {
      left: 100%;
    }
    
    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5), 0 10px 40px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
    }
    
    .btn-primary:active {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    
    .btn-secondary {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-accent);
      padding: 0.65rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }
    
    .btn-secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-primary);
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.05);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    
    .nav-link {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      position: relative;
    }
    
    .nav-link:hover {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
    }
    
    .nav-link-active {
      color: var(--accent-glow);
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
    }
    
    .metric-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(26, 26, 38, 0.8) 0%, rgba(34, 34, 58, 0.6) 100%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
      border-radius: 1rem;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    
    .metric-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-primary), transparent);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }
    
    .metric-card:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    
    .metric-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
      border-color: var(--accent-primary);
    }
    
    .component-btn {
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      background: rgba(34, 34, 58, 0.4);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    
    .component-btn::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: -100%;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1), transparent);
      transition: left 0.4s ease;
    }
    
    .component-btn:hover::after {
      left: 100%;
    }
    
    .component-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(34, 34, 58, 0.8);
      border-color: var(--accent-primary);
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }
    
    .component-btn-active {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--accent-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
    }
    
    .viewer-container {
      background: rgba(18, 18, 26, 0.8);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      border-radius: 1rem;
      min-height: 12rem;
      max-height: 36rem;
      overflow-y: auto;
      position: relative;
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .viewer-container::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-primary), transparent);
      animation: scanline 4s linear infinite;
    }
    
    @keyframes scanline {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-100%); opacity: 0; }
      50% { opacity: 1; }
    }
    
    .status-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem;

      background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15);
      color: var(--info);
      border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
    }
    
    .pulse-indicator {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: currentColor;
      animation: pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
    }
    
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.4; }
    }
    
    .tier-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-secondary));
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
    }
    
    .scrollbar-custom::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 6px;
    }
    
    .scrollbar-custom::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: transparent;
    }
    
    .scrollbar-custom::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--accent-primary);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    
    .scrollbar-custom::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: var(--accent-glow);
    }
    
    .loading-shimmer {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2), transparent);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: shimmer 2s infinite;
    }
    
    @keyframes shimmer {
      0% { background-position: -200% 0; }
      100% { background-position: 200% 0; }
    }
    
    .fade-in {
      animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-out;
    }
    
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    
    .chart-wrapper {
      height: 350px;
      position: relative;
    }
    
    input, select {
      background: rgba(34, 34, 58, 0.4);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);

      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      color: var(--text-primary);

      transition: all 0.2s ease;

    input:focus, select:focus {

      background: rgba(34, 34, 58, 0.6);

    }
    
    input::placeholder {
      color: var(--text-tertiary);

      transition: background 0.2s ease;
    }
    
    .audit-log-entry:hover {
      background: rgba(34, 34, 58, 0.5);
    }
  </style>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>PHOENIX V30.30 - APEX EDITION</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.0.6/dist/purify.min.js"></script>
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600;700&display=swap');
    
    :root {
      --bg-primary: #0a0a0f;
      --bg-secondary: #16161f;
      --bg-tertiary: #1e1e2d;
      --accent-primary: #a855f7;
      --accent-secondary: #8b5cf6;
      --accent-tertiary: #c084fc;
      --text-primary: #e5e7eb;
      --text-secondary: #9ca3af;
      --border-color: #2d2d3d;
      --success: #10b981;
      --warning: #f59e0b;
      --error: #ef4444;
      --info: #3b82f6;
    }
    
    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    
    body {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top, #16161f 0%, #0a0a0f 50%, #000000 100%);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      min-height: 100vh;
      position: relative;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }
    
    /* Animated background particles */
    .particle-container {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }
    
    .particle {
      position: absolute;
      background: var(--accent-primary);
      border-radius: 50%;
      opacity: 0.3;
      animation: float 20s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    
    @keyframes float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) translateX(0); }
      25% { transform: translateY(-100px) translateX(50px); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-50px) translateX(-50px); }
      75% { transform: translateY(-150px) translateX(100px); }
    }
    
    .content-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    
    .neon-glow {
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-primary), 0 0 16px var(--accent-primary);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }
    
    .neon-glow:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-primary), 0 0 24px var(--accent-primary), 0 0 36px var(--accent-primary);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    
    .neon-border {
      border: 1px solid var(--accent-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-primary), inset 0 0 6px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
    }
    
    .nav-active {
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 4px var(--accent-primary);
      color: var(--accent-tertiary);
    }
    
    .glass-panel {
      background: rgba(30, 30, 45, 0.6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2);
      border-radius: 1rem;
    }
    
    .viewer-box {
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
      min-height: 10rem;
      max-height: 32rem;
      overflow-y: auto;
      position: relative;
    }
    
    .viewer-box::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-primary), transparent);
      animation: scan 3s linear infinite;
    }
    
    @keyframes scan {
      0% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
      100% { transform: translateX(100%); }
    }
    
    .chart-container {
      height: 60vh;
      max-height: 350px;
      position: relative;
    }
    
    .metric-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-tertiary) 0%, var(--bg-secondary) 100%);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }
    
    .metric-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -2px;
      left: -2px;
      right: -2px;
      bottom: -2px;
      background: linear-gradient(45deg, var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-secondary), var(--accent-primary));
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      z-index: -1;
    }
    
    .metric-card:hover::before {
      opacity: 0.3;
    }
    
    .metric-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
    }
    
    .pulse-dot {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--success);
      animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.2); }
    }
    
    .snippet-btn {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    
    .snippet-btn::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      width: 0;
      height: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      transition: width 0.6s, height 0.6s;
    }
    
    .snippet-btn:hover::after {
      width: 300px;
      height: 300px;
    }
    
    .loading-bar {
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--accent-primary);
      animation: loading 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    
    @keyframes loading {
      0% { width: 0%; }
      50% { width: 100%; }
      100% { width: 0%; }
    }
    
    .tier-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease;
    }
    
    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    
    .scrollbar-custom::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 8px;
    }
    
    .scrollbar-custom::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    
    .scrollbar-custom::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--accent-primary);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    
    .scrollbar-custom::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: var(--accent-secondary);
    }
    
    .code-preview {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    
    .status-indicator {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

        particle.className = 'particle';
        particle.style.width = `${Math.random() * 4 + 2}px`;

        particle.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`;
        particle.style.top = `${Math.random() * 100}%`;
        particle.style.animationDelay = `${Math.random() * 20}s`;
        particle.style.animationDuration = `${Math.random() * 15 + 15}s`;
        container.appendChild(particle);
      }
    }
    
    // Audit Logger
    class AuditLogger {
      constructor(elementId) {
        this.element = document.getElementById(elementId);
        this.logs = [];
      }
      
      log(type, message) {
        const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
        const icons = { success: '✓', warning: '⚠', error: '✗', info: 'ℹ' };
        const colors = {
          success: 'var(--success)',
          warning: 'var(--warning)',
          error: 'var(--error)',
          info: 'var(--info)'
        };
        
        const logEntry = document.createElement('div');
        logEntry.className = 'flex items-start gap-3 p-2 bg-[var(--bg-tertiary)] rounded';
        logEntry.style.animation = 'fadeIn 0.3s ease';
        logEntry.innerHTML = `
          <span style="color: ${colors[type]};">${icons[type]}</span>
          <div>
            <span style="color: var(--text-secondary);">[${timestamp}]</span>
            <span style="color: var(--text-primary);"> ${message}</span>
          </div>
        `;
        
        this.element.insertBefore(logEntry, this.element.firstChild);
        this.logs.push({ type, message, timestamp });
        
        if (this.element.children.length > 20) {
          this.element.removeChild(this.element.lastChild);
        }
      }
    }

--[[
    Survive a Brainrot – Production-Ready Framework
    Addresses critical issues from original demo
    
    Structure:
    - ServerScriptService/MainServer.lua (this file)
    - ReplicatedStorage/Modules/* (shared code)
    - ServerStorage/Config.lua (secure config)
--]]

-- SERVICES
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- SECURE CONFIGURATION (ServerStorage only)
local Config = {
    Train = {
        Speed = 16,
        WagonCount = 3,
        WagonSpacing = 12,
        MaxHealth = 1000
    },
    Zombie = {
        SpawnInterval = 8,
        MaxCount = 20,
        SpawnRadius = 50,
        DespawnRadius = 200,
        BaseHealth = 100,
        BaseDamage = 10,
        BaseSpeed = 12,
        HallucinationChance = 0.3
    },
    Gameplay = {
        MaxDays = 99,
        DayDuration = 300, -- seconds
        DifficultyScale = 1.1 -- per day multiplier
    },
    Performance = {
        TickRate = 1/30, -- AI update rate
        CleanupInterval = 10
    }
}

-- UTILITY FUNCTIONS
local Utils = {}

function Utils.CreateWeld(part0, part1, offset)
    local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    weld.Part0 = part0
    weld.Part1 = part1
    weld.Parent = part0
    return weld
end

function Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    local ray = Ray.new(position, Vector3.new(0, -100, 0))
    local hit, hitPosition = workspace:FindPartOnRay(ray, nil, false, true)
    return hitPosition or position
end

function Utils.IsPositionSafe(position, radius)
    local region = Region3.new(position - Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius), 
                               position + Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius))
    region.ExpandToGrid(4)
    local parts = workspace:FindPartsInRegion3(region, nil, 100)
    return #parts < 5 -- Simple obstruction check
end

-- TRAIN MODULE (Fixed)
local Train = {}
Train.Wagons = {}
Train.Health = Config.Train.MaxHealth
Train.IsActive = true

function Train:Initialize()
    -- Create container for organization
    local trainFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    trainFolder.Name = "Train"
    trainFolder.Parent = workspace
    
    local previousWagon = nil
    
    for i = 1, Config.Train.WagonCount do
        local wagon = Instance.new("Part")
        wagon.Size = Vector3.new(10, 6, 10)
        wagon.Position = Vector3.new(i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing, 10, 0)
        wagon.Anchored = true -- Keep anchored, move via CFrame
        wagon.Name = "Wagon_" .. i
        wagon.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        wagon.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
        wagon.Parent = trainFolder
        
        -- Add health tracking
        local healthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
        healthValue.Name = "Health"
        healthValue.Value = Config.Train.MaxHealth
        healthValue.Parent = wagon
        
        -- Visual platform for players
        local platform = Instance.new("Part")
        platform.Size = Vector3.new(9, 1, 9)
        platform.Position = wagon.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
        platform.Anchored = true
        platform.Name = "Platform"
        platform.Parent = wagon
        
        table.insert(self.Wagons, {
            Part = wagon,
            Platform = platform,
            Offset = i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing
        })
        
        previousWagon = wagon
    end
    
    self.Folder = trainFolder
end

function Train:Update(deltaTime)
    if not self.IsActive then return end
    
    -- Move train along path (simple forward movement)
    for i, wagon in ipairs(self.Wagons) do
        local currentCF = wagon.Part.CFrame
        local movement = Vector3.new(Config.Train.Speed * deltaTime, 0, 0)
        
        wagon.Part.CFrame = currentCF + movement
        wagon.Platform.CFrame = wagon.Part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
    end
end

function Train:TakeDamage(amount)
    self.Health = math.max(0, self.Health - amount)
    if self.Health <= 0 then
        self:Destroy()
    end
end

function Train:Destroy()
    self.IsActive = false
    if self.Folder then
        self.Folder:Destroy()
    end
    -- Trigger game over
    print("❌ Train Destroyed - Game Over")
end

-- ZOMBIE MODULE (Fixed with proper AI)
local ZombieModule = {}
ZombieModule.ActiveZombies = {}
ZombieModule.ZombiePool = {} -- Object pooling
ZombieModule.LastSpawnTime = 0
ZombieModule.CurrentDay = 1

function ZombieModule:CreateZombieRig()
    -- Create proper R6-style rig with Humanoid
    local zombie = Instance.new("Model")
    zombie.Name = "Zombie"
    
    local torso = Instance.new("Part")
    torso.Name = "Torso"
    torso.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
    torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    torso.Parent = zombie
    
    local head = Instance.new("Part")
    head.Name = "Head"
    head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
    head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    head.Position = torso.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
    head.Parent = zombie
    
    -- Humanoid for pathfinding
    local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Name = "Humanoid"
    humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Zombie.BaseHealth * (Config.Gameplay.DifficultyScale ^ (self.CurrentDay - 1))
    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Zombie.BaseSpeed
    humanoid.Parent = zombie
    
    -- Neck weld
    local neck = Instance.new("Weld")
    neck.Part0 = torso
    neck.Part1 = head
    neck.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 1, 0)
    neck.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)
    neck.Parent = torso
    
    zombie.PrimaryPart = torso
    
    return zombie
end

function ZombieModule:SpawnZombie(position)
    if #self.ActiveZombies >= Config.Zombie.MaxCount then return end
    
    -- Validate spawn position
    local groundPos = Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    if not Utils.IsPositionSafe(groundPos, 3) then return end
    
    local zombie = self:CreateZombieRig()
    zombie:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(groundPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
    zombie.Parent = workspace
    
    local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    
    -- Apply hallucination effect
    local isHallucination = math.random() < Config.Zombie.HallucinationChance
    if isHallucination then
        for _, part in pairs(zombie:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
                part.Transparency = 0.3
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Store zombie data
    local zombieData = {
        Model = zombie,
        Humanoid = humanoid,
        IsHallucination = isHallucination,
        LastPathUpdate = 0,
        CurrentPath = nil,
        Target = nil,
        SpawnTime = tick()
    }
    
    table.insert(self.ActiveZombies, zombieData)
    
    -- Damage connection
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    end)
    
    return zombieData
end

function ZombieModule:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    local zombie = zombieData.Model
    if not zombie or not zombie.Parent then
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
        return
    end
    
    local humanoid = zombieData.Humanoid
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    
    -- Despawn if too far from train
    local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    local distanceToTrain = (zombie.PrimaryPart.Position - trainPos).Magnitude
    
    if distanceToTrain > Config.Zombie.DespawnRadius then
        self:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
        return
    end
    
    -- Update pathfinding periodically
    if tick() - zombieData.LastPathUpdate > 2 then
        zombieData.LastPathUpdate = tick()
        
        -- Find nearest player or train
        local target = self:FindNearestTarget(zombie.PrimaryPart.Position)
        if target then
            zombieData.Target = target
            
            -- Create path
            local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                AgentRadius = 2,
                AgentHeight = 5,
                AgentCanJump = true
            })
            
            local success, errorMsg = pcall(function()
                path:ComputeAsync(zombie.PrimaryPart.Position, target.Position)
            end)
            
            if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                zombieData.CurrentPath = path
                local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                
                -- Move to first waypoint
                if #waypoints > 1 then
                    humanoid:MoveTo(waypoints[2].Position)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Attack if close to target
    if zombieData.Target then
        local distance = (zombie.PrimaryPart.Position - zombieData.Target.Position).Magnitude
        if distance < 5 then
            self:AttackTarget(zombieData, zombieData.Target)
        end
    end
end

function ZombieModule:FindNearestTarget(position)
    local nearest = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    
    -- Check players
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (hrp.Position - position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDist then
                minDist = dist
                nearest = hrp
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Check train if no players nearby
    if minDist > 50 and Train.Wagons[1] then
        nearest = Train.Wagons[1].Part
    end
    
    return nearest
end

function ZombieModule:AttackTarget(zombieData, target)
    -- Simple damage application with cooldown
    if not zombieData.LastAttackTime or tick() - zombieData.LastAttackTime > 1 then
        zombieData.LastAttackTime = tick()
        
        if target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            -- Damage player
            target.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(Config.Zombie.BaseDamage)
        elseif target.Name:match("Wagon") then
            -- Damage train
            Train:TakeDamage(Config.Zombie.BaseDamage)
        end
    end
end

function ZombieModule:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    for i, zd in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        if zd == zombieData then
            table.remove(self.ActiveZombies, i)
            break
        end
    end
    
    if zombieData.Model then
        -- Create corpse with ragdoll
        Debris:AddItem(zombieData.Model, 5)
    end
end

function ZombieModule:UpdateAll(deltaTime)
    -- Update all zombies (throttled)
    for _, zombieData in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        self:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    end
    
    -- Spawn new zombies
    if tick() - self.LastSpawnTime > Config.Zombie.SpawnInterval then
        self.LastSpawnTime = tick()
        
        -- Spawn around train
        local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local distance = Config.Zombie.SpawnRadius
        local spawnPos = trainPos + Vector3.new(
            math.cos(angle) * distance,
            0,
            math.sin(angle) * distance
        )
        
        self:SpawnZombie(spawnPos)
    end
end

-- PLAYER MANAGEMENT (Fixed)
local PlayerManager = {}

function PlayerManager:SetupPlayer(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        -- Spawn on train platform
        if Train.Wagons[1] then
            hrp.CFrame = Train.Wagons[1].Platform.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        end
        
        -- Give basic weapon (proper tool setup needed in separate script)
        local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
        sword.Name = "Sword"
        sword.RequiresHandle = false
        sword.Parent = player.Backpack
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    PlayerManager:SetupPlayer(player)
end)

-- MAIN GAME LOOP (Fixed with proper delta time)
Train:Initialize()

local lastUpdate = tick()
local accumulator = 0

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local currentTime = tick()
    local deltaTime = currentTime - lastUpdate
    lastUpdate = currentTime
    
    accumulator = accumulator + deltaTime
    
    -- Fixed timestep for physics
    while accumulator >= Config.Performance.TickRate do
        Train:Update(Config.Performance.TickRate)
        ZombieModule:UpdateAll(Config.Performance.TickRate)
        accumulator = accumulator - Config.Performance.TickRate
    end
end)

-- Cleanup on shutdown
game:BindToClose(function()
    Train:Destroy()
    for _, zombieData in ipairs(ZombieModule.ActiveZombies) do
        ZombieModule:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    end

function Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    local ray = Ray.new(position, Vector3.new(0, -100, 0))
    local hit, hitPosition = workspace:FindPartOnRay(ray, nil, false, true)
    return hitPosition or position

Utility function to check if a position is safe (few obstructions):

function Utils.IsPositionSafe(position, radius)
    local region = Region3.new(position - Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius), position + Vector3.new(radius, radius, radius))
    region.ExpandToGrid(4)
    local parts = workspace:FindPartsInRegion3(region, nil, 100)
    return #parts < 5
end

Train.Health = Config.Train.MaxHealth

Train:Initialize - spawn wagons with platforms and health:

lua
function Train:Initialize()
    local trainFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    trainFolder.Name = "Train"
    trainFolder.Parent = workspace

    for i = 1, Config.Train.WagonCount do
        local wagon = Instance.new("Part")
        wagon.Size = Vector3.new(10, 6, 10)
        wagon.Position = Vector3.new(i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing, 10, 0)
        wagon.Anchored = true
        wagon.Name = "Wagon_" .. i
        wagon.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        wagon.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
        wagon.Parent = trainFolder

        local healthValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
        healthValue.Name = "Health"
        healthValue.Value = Config.Train.MaxHealth
        healthValue.Parent = wagon

        local platform = Instance.new("Part")
        platform.Size = Vector3.new(9, 1, 9)
        platform.Position = wagon.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
        platform.Anchored = true
        platform.Name = "Platform"
        platform.Parent = wagon

        table.insert(self.Wagons, {Part = wagon, Platform = platform, Offset = i * Config.Train.WagonSpacing})
    end

    self.Folder = trainFolder
end
Train:Update to move the train wagons forward each tick:

lua
function Train:Update(deltaTime)
    if not self.IsActive then return end
    for _, wagon in ipairs(self.Wagons) do
        local currentCF = wagon.Part.CFrame
        local movement = Vector3.new(Config.Train.Speed * deltaTime, 0, 0)
        wagon.Part.CFrame = currentCF + movement
        wagon.Platform.CFrame = wagon.Part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
    end
end
Train:TakeDamage reduces health and destroys train on zero health:

lua
function Train:TakeDamage(amount)
    self.Health = math.max(0, self.Health - amount)
    if self.Health <= 0 then
        self:Destroy()
    end
end

function ZombieModule:CreateZombieRig()
    local zombie = Instance.new("Model")
    zombie.Name = "Zombie"
    local torso = Instance.new("Part")
    torso.Name = "Torso"
    torso.Size = Vector3.new(2,2,1)
    torso.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    torso.Parent = zombie
    local head = Instance.new("Part")
    head.Name = "Head"
    head.Size = Vector3.new(2,1,1)
    head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green")
    head.Position = torso.Position + Vector3.new(0,1.5,0)
    head.Parent = zombie
    local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Name = "Humanoid"
    humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Zombie.BaseHealth * (Config.Gameplay.DifficultyScale ^ (self.CurrentDay - 1))
    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Zombie.BaseSpeed
    humanoid.Parent = zombie
    local neck = Instance.new("Weld")
    neck.Part0 = torso
    neck.Part1 = head
    neck.C0 = CFrame.new(0,1,0)
    neck.C1 = CFrame.new(0,-0.5,0)
    neck.Parent = torso
    zombie.PrimaryPart = torso
    return zombie
end
ZombieModule:SpawnZombie creates zombie rig, validates position, applies hallucination effect:

lua
function ZombieModule:SpawnZombie(position)
    if #self.ActiveZombies >= Config.Zombie.MaxCount then return end
    local groundPos = Utils.GetGroundPosition(position)
    if not Utils.IsPositionSafe(groundPos, 3) then return end
    local zombie = self:CreateZombieRig()
    zombie:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(groundPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
    zombie.Parent = workspace
    local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local isHallucination = math.random() < Config.Zombie.HallucinationChance
    if isHallucination then
        for _, part in pairs(zombie:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
                part.Transparency = 0.3
            end
        end
    end
    local zombieData = {
        Model = zombie,
        Humanoid = humanoid,
        IsHallucination = isHallucination,
        LastPathUpdate = 0,
        CurrentPath = nil,
        Target = nil,
        SpawnTime = tick()
    }
    table.insert(self.ActiveZombies, zombieData)
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function() self:RemoveZombie(zombieData) end)
    return zombieData
end
ZombieModule:UpdateZombie handles movement, pathfinding, despawning, and attacking:

lua
function ZombieModule:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    local zombie = zombieData.Model
    if not zombie or not zombie.Parent then self:RemoveZombie(zombieData); return end
    local humanoid = zombieData.Humanoid
    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
    local distanceToTrain = (zombie.PrimaryPart.Position - trainPos).Magnitude
    if distanceToTrain > Config.Zombie.DespawnRadius then self:RemoveZombie(zombieData); return end
    if tick() - zombieData.LastPathUpdate > 2 then
        zombieData.LastPathUpdate = tick()
        local target = self:FindNearestTarget(zombie.PrimaryPart.Position)
        if target then
            zombieData.Target = target
            local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({AgentRadius=2, AgentHeight=5, AgentCanJump=true})
            local success, errorMsg = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(zombie.PrimaryPart.Position, target.Position) end)
            if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                zombieData.CurrentPath = path
                local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                if #waypoints > 1 then humanoid:MoveTo(waypoints[2].Position) end
            end
        end
    end
    if zombieData.Target then
        local distance = (zombie.PrimaryPart.Position - zombieData.Target.Position).Magnitude
        if distance < 5 then self:AttackTarget(zombieData, zombieData.Target) end
    end
end
ZombieModule:FindNearestTarget returns closest player or train wagon:

lua
function ZombieModule:FindNearestTarget(position)
    local nearest = nil
    local minDist = math.huge
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local dist = (hrp.Position - position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDist then minDist = dist; nearest = hrp end
        end
    end
    if minDist > 50 and Train.Wagons[1] then nearest = Train.Wagons[1].Part end
    return nearest
end
ZombieModule:AttackTarget damages player humanoid or train health with cooldown:

lua
function ZombieModule:AttackTarget(zombieData, target)
    if not zombieData.LastAttackTime or tick() - zombieData.LastAttackTime > 1 then
        zombieData.LastAttackTime = tick()
        if target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            target.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(Config.Zombie.BaseDamage)
        elseif target.Name:match("Wagon") then
            Train:TakeDamage(Config.Zombie.BaseDamage)
        end
    end
end

function ZombieModule:RemoveZombie(zombieData)
    for i, zd in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do

ZombieModule:UpdateAll updates all zombies and spawns new ones periodically:

lua
function ZombieModule:UpdateAll(deltaTime)
    for _, zombieData in ipairs(self.ActiveZombies) do
        self:UpdateZombie(zombieData, deltaTime)
    end
    if tick() - self.LastSpawnTime > Config.Zombie.SpawnInterval then
        self.LastSpawnTime = tick()
        local trainPos = Train.Wagons[1] and Train.Wagons[1].Part.Position or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local distance = Config.Zombie.SpawnRadius
        local spawnPos = trainPos + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * distance, 0, math.sin(angle) * distance)
        self:SpawnZombie(spawnPos)
    end
end

lua
function SpatialHash:Insert(object, position)
    local x, y, z = self:GetCellIndices(position)
    -- Insert into all neighboring cells to handle object size overlap
    for xi = x - 1, x + 1 do
        for yi = y - 1, y + 1 do
            for zi = z - 1, z + 1 do
                local key = string.format("%d.%d.%d", xi, yi, zi)
                if not self.Grid[key] then
                    self.Grid[key] = {}
                end
                -- Avoid duplicates
                local cell = self.Grid[key]
                local exists = false
                for _, obj in ipairs(cell) do
                    if obj == object then
                        exists = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not exists then
                    table.insert(cell, object)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
This snippet completes the insert, making sure objects also get registered in adjacent cells to cover their bounding volume for better accuracy in spatial queries.

lua
function SpatialHash:Insert(object, position)
    local x, y, z = self:GetCellIndices(position)
    for xi = x - 1, x + 1 do
        for yi = y - 1, y + 1 do
            for zi = z - 1, z + 1 do
                local key = string.format("%d.%d.%d", xi, yi, zi)
                if not self.Grid[key] then
                    self.Grid[key] = {}
                end
                local cell = self.Grid[key]
                local exists = false
                for _, obj in ipairs(cell) do
                    if obj == object then
                        exists = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not exists then
                    table.insert(cell, object)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function SpatialHash:Remove(object, position)
    local x, y, z = self:GetCellIndices(position)
    for xi = x - 1, x + 1 do
        for yi = y - 1, y + 1 do
            for zi = z - 1, z + 1 do
                local key = string.format("%d.%d.%d", xi, yi, zi)
                local cell = self.Grid[key]
                if cell then
                    for i, obj in ipairs(cell) do
                        if obj == object then
                            table.remove(cell, i)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function SpatialHash:Update(object, oldPosition, newPosition)
    self:Remove(object, oldPosition)
    self:Insert(object, newPosition)
end

function SpatialHash:Clear()
    self.Grid = {}
end

function SpatialHash:GetNearbyObjects(position, range)
    local results = {}
    local x, y, z = self:GetCellIndices(position)
    local r = math.ceil(range / self.CellSize)
    for xi = x - r, x + r do
        for yi = y - r, y + r do
            for zi = z - r, z + r do
                local key = string.format("%d.%d.%d", xi, yi, zi)
                local cell = self.Grid[key]
                if cell then
                    for _, obj in pairs(cell) do
                        table.insert(results, obj)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return results
end

/**
 * Efficiently parses 'data-narrative' and 'data-instruction' attributes
 * from a given asset's HTML string representation.
 * @param {string} htmlString - The HTML string of the asset element.
 * @returns {Object} An object containing 'narrative' and 'instruction' strings.
 */
function parseSoulAsset(htmlString) {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const doc = parser.parseFromString(htmlString, 'text/html');
  const assetElem = doc.body.firstElementChild;
  if (!assetElem) {
    return { narrative: '', instruction: '' };
  }
  return {
    narrative: assetElem.getAttribute('data-narrative') || '',
    instruction: assetElem.getAttribute('data-instruction') || ''
  };
}

// 12. Saiyan Ripple Effect Button
export function RippleButton({ children, onClick }) {
  function createRipple(event) {
    const button = event.currentTarget;
    const circle = document.createElement("span");
    const diameter = Math.max(button.clientWidth, button.clientHeight);
    circle.style.width = circle.style.height = `${diameter}px`;
    circle.style.left = `${event.clientX - button.offsetLeft - diameter/2}px`;
    circle.style.top = `${event.clientY - button.offsetTop - diameter/2}px`;
    circle.classList.add("ripple");
    const ripple = button.getElementsByClassName("ripple")[0];
    if(ripple) ripple.remove();
    button.appendChild(circle);
  }
  return (
    <>
      <button
        onClick={(e) => {
          createRipple(e);
          if(onClick) onClick(e);
        }}
        style={{
          position: 'relative',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #B71FFF, #FFD700)',
          color: '#FFF',
          border: 'none',
          padding: '12px 24px',
          borderRadius: '24px',
          fontFamily: "'Orbitron', monospace",
          boxShadow: '0 0 15px #B71FFF',
          cursor:'pointer'
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </button>
      <style>{`
        .ripple {
          position: absolute;
          border-radius: 50%;
          background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.6);
          animation: rippleEffect 600ms linear;
          pointer-events: none;
          transform: scale(0);
          opacity: 1;
          z-index: 10;
        }
        @keyframes rippleEffect {
          to {
            transform: scale(4);
            opacity: 0;
          }
        }
      `}</style>
    </>
  );
}

// 13. Saiyan Circular Progress Glow
export function CircularProgress({ progress }) {
  const radius = 50;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const offset = circumference - (progress / 100) * circumference;

  return (
    <svg width="120" height="120" style={{transform: 'rotate(-90deg)'}}>
      <circle
        stroke="#222"
        fill="transparent"
        strokeWidth="10"
        r={radius}
        cx="60"
        cy="60"
      />
      <circle
        stroke="url(#gradient)"
        fill="transparent"
        strokeWidth="10"
        r={radius}
        cx="60"
        cy="60"
        strokeDasharray={circumference}
        strokeDashoffset={offset}
        strokeLinecap="round"
        style={{transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 0.4s ease'}}
      />
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="gradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
          <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#B71FFF" />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#FFD700" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
    </svg>
  );
}

name: CI/CD Publish

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

      - name: Install dependencies

      - name: Run lint

      - name: Run tests

      - name: Build

      - name: Publish package
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npm publish --access public

### Solution 1: API Input Sanitization
```javascript
// File: middleware/sanitizer.js
const sanitizeInput = (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    // Sanitize query parameters
    if (req.query.msg) {
      req.query.msg = req.query.msg
        .toString()
        .trim()
        .replace(/[<>\"\']/g, '') // Remove HTML/script tags
        .substring(0, 1000); // Limit length
    }
    if (req.query.agent) {
      req.query.agent = req.query.agent
        .toString()
        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '')
        .substring(0, 50);
    }
    
    // Sanitize URL path to prevent directory traversal
    if (req.params.file) {
      req.params.file = req.params.file.replace(/\.\./g, '');
    }
    
    next();
  } catch (error) {
    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid input parameters' }));
  }
};

// In server.js - Apply globally
const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  // Create fake request context for middleware
  const reqContext = { query: {}, params: {} };
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:4200`);
  url.searchParams.forEach((value, key) => {
    reqContext.query[key] = value;
  });
  
  sanitizeInput(reqContext, res, () => {
    req.query = reqContext.query;
    // Continue with normal request handling
  });
});
```

```powershell
# File: PHOENIX_V39_Setup.ps1
function Invoke-RestMethodWithRetry {
    param(
        [string]$Uri,
        [int]$TimeoutSec = 5,
        [int]$MaxRetries = 3
    )
    
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $MaxRetries; $i++) {
        try {
            $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $Uri `
                -TimeoutSec $TimeoutSec `
                -ErrorAction Stop
            return $response
        } catch {
            Write-Host "[!] Attempt $i/$MaxRetries failed: $_"
            if ($i -eq $MaxRetries) {
                throw "Failed to connect after $MaxRetries attempts"
            }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        }

}
```

### Solution 7: CORS Origin Validation
```javascript
// File: middleware/cors.js
const allowedOrigins = [
  'http://localhost:4200',
  'http://127.0.0.1:4200',
  'file://', // For local HTML files
  'null' // For file:// protocol
];

function setCorsHeaders(req, res) {
  const origin = req.headers.origin || req.headers.referer || 'null';
  
  // Check if origin is allowed
  const isAllowed = allowedOrigins.some(allowed => {
    if (allowed === 'file://' && origin.startsWith('file://')) return true;
    return origin === allowed || origin.startsWith(allowed);
  });
  
  if (isAllowed) {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);
  } else {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', 'null');
  }
  
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');
  
  // Handle preflight
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.writeHead(204);
    res.end();
    return true; // Indicates preflight handled
  }
  
  return false;
}

// In server.js
const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  if (setCorsHeaders(req, res)) return; // Preflight handled
  // ... rest of request handling
});
```

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const { execSync } = require('child_process');

function verifyHashFile(hashFile) {
  const signatureFile = `${hashFile}.asc`;
  
  if (!fs.existsSync(signatureFile)) {
    throw new Error(`Signature file not found: ${signatureFile}`);
  }
  
  try {
    execSync(`gpg --verify ${signatureFile} ${hashFile}`, {
      stdio: 'pipe'
    });
    console.log('✅ Hash file signature valid');
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Hash file signature INVALID or GPG not installed');
    throw new Error('Hash verification failed');
  }
}
```

```powershell
function Wait-ForServerReady {
    param(
        [string]$Url,
        [int]$MaxAttempts = 30,
        [int]$DelaySeconds = 1
    )
    
    Write-Host "[*] Waiting for server at $Url..."

            $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $Url -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop

    return $false
}
```

### Solution 12: Incremental Backup Strategy
```powershell
# File: scripts/smart-backup.ps1
param(
    [string]$SourceDir = ".",
    [string]$BackupRoot = "C:\Backups\PHOENIX",
    [switch]$Incremental
)

$timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd_HHmmss"
$BackupDir = Join-Path $BackupRoot "Backup_$timestamp"

# Ensure backup directory exists
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null

# Excluded patterns
$excludePatterns = @(
    "node_modules",
    "*.log",
    "*.pid",
    ".git",
    "Backups",
    "db.json"
)

Write-Host "[*] Creating backup: $BackupDir"

if ($Incremental) {
    # Find the last backup
    $lastBackup = Get-ChildItem -Path $BackupRoot -Directory | 
        Sort-Object Name -Descending | 
        Select-Object -First 1
    
    if ($lastBackup) {
        Write-Host "[*] Incremental backup from: $($lastBackup.Name)"
        
        # Use Robocopy for incremental backup (much faster)
        $excludeArgs = $excludePatterns | ForEach-Object { "/XD $_" }
        robocopy $SourceDir $BackupDir /MIR /XO /R:2 /W:1 $excludeArgs /LOG:"$BackupDir\backup.log"
    }
} else {
    # Full backup
    Get-ChildItem -Path $SourceDir -Recurse | ForEach-Object {
        $shouldExclude = $false
        foreach ($pattern in $excludePatterns) {
            if ($_.FullName -like "*$pattern*") {
                $shouldExclude = $true
                break
            }
        }
        
        if (-not $shouldExclude) {
            $relativePath = $_.FullName.Substring($SourceDir.Length)
            $destPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath
            
            if ($_.PSIsContainer) {
                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destPath -Force | Out-Null
            } else {
                Copy-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $destPath -Force
            }
        }
    }
}

Write-Host "✅ Backup complete: $BackupDir"

# Clean up old backups (keep last 10)
$allBackups = Get-ChildItem -Path $BackupRoot -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending
if ($allBackups.Count -gt 10) {
    $allBackups | Select-Object -Skip 10 | ForEach-Object {
        Write-Host "[*] Removing old backup: $($_.Name)"
        Remove-Item -Path $_.FullName -Recurse -Force
    }
}
```

### Solution 13: Persistent Chat History with LowDB
```javascript
// File: db/chatHistory.js
// npm install lowdb@3.0.0

const { Low } = require('lowdb');
const { JSONFile } = require('lowdb/node');
const path = require('path');

class ChatHistoryDB {
  constructor(dbPath = './data/chatHistory.json') {
    this.dbPath = dbPath;
    this.db = null;
  }
  
  async init() {
    // Ensure data directory exists
    const dir = path.dirname(this.dbPath);
    const fs = require('fs');
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    }
    
    const adapter = new JSONFile(this.dbPath);
    this.db = new Low(adapter, { chatHistory: {} });
    
    await this.db.read();
    
    // Initialize structure if empty
    this.db.data = this.db.data || { chatHistory: {} };
    
    console.log(`[DB] Chat history loaded from ${this.dbPath}`);
  }
  
  async addMessage(agent, role, content) {
    if (!this.db.data.chatHistory[agent]) {
      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = [];
    }
    
    this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].push({
      role,
      content,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    
    // Limit history per agent to 100 messages
    if (this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].length > 100) {
      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].slice(-100);
    }
    
    await this.db.write();
  }
  
  async getHistory(agent, limit = null) {
    const history = this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] || [];
    return limit ? history.slice(-limit) : history;
  }
  
  async clearHistory(agent) {
    if (agent) {
      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = [];
    } else {
      this.db.data.chatHistory = {};
    }
    await this.db.write();
  }
  
  async getAllAgents() {
    return Object.keys(this.db.data.chatHistory);
  }
}

module.exports = ChatHistoryDB;

// Usage in server.js
const ChatHistoryDB = require('./db/chatHistory');
const chatDB = new ChatHistoryDB();

(async () => {
  await chatDB.init();
  
  // In API handlers:
  // await chatDB.addMessage('agent1', 'user', 'Hello');
  // const history = await chatDB.getHistory('agent1', 10);
})();
```

```powershell
# File: scripts/verify-hashes.ps1
param(
    [string]$HashFile = "MASTER_HASHES.csv",
    [string]$BatchFolder = ".\MASTER_BATCHES"
)

Write-Host "[*] Loading hash database..."

# Load all hashes into memory once

    $hashDatabase[$_.FileName] = $_.Hash
}

Write-Host "[*] Verifying $($hashDatabase.Count) files..."

$failures = @()
$verified = 0

Get-ChildItem -Path $BatchFolder -Filter "*.txt" | ForEach-Object {
    $expectedHash = $hashDatabase[$_.Name]
    
    if ($null -eq $expectedHash) {
        $failures += "Missing hash for: $($_.Name)"
        return
    }
    
    $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Path $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
    
    if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) {
        $failures += "Hash mismatch: $($_.Name)"
    } else {
        $verified++
    }
}

Write-Host "✅ Verified: $verified files"

if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host "❌ Failures: $($failures.Count)"
    $failures | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "   $_" }
    exit 1
}
```

### Solution 15: Paginated History Endpoint
```javascript
// File: routes/history.js
async function handleHistoryRequest(req, res, chatDB) {
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost`);
  const agent = url.searchParams.get('agent');
  const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit')) || 50;
  const offset = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('offset')) || 0;
  
  if (!agent) {
    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Agent parameter required' }));
    return;
  }
  
  try {
    const fullHistory = await chatDB.getHistory(agent);
    const total = fullHistory.length;
    const paginatedHistory = fullHistory.slice(offset, offset + limit);
    
    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({
      agent,
      messages: paginatedHistory,
      pagination: {
        total,
        limit,
        offset,
        hasMore: (offset + limit) < total
      }
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Failed to retrieve history' }));
  }
}

module.exports = { handleHistoryRequest };
```

```javascript
// File: routes/analysis.js
const { Worker } = require('worker_threads');
const path = require('path');

async function runProAnalysis(data) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const worker = new Worker(
      path.join(__dirname, '../workers/pro-analysis-worker.js'),
      { workerData: data }
    );
    
    worker.on('message', resolve);
    worker.on('error', reject);
    worker.on('exit', (code) => {
      if (code !== 0) {
        reject(new Error(`Worker stopped with exit code ${code}`));
      }
    });
    
    // Timeout after 30 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      worker.terminate();
      reject(new Error('Analysis timeout'));
    }, 30000);
  });
}

module.exports = { runProAnalysis };
```

### Solution 19: Cached Asset List
```javascript
// File: cache/assetCache.js
class AssetCache {
  constructor(ttlSeconds = 300) {
    this.cache = null;
    this.lastUpdate = null;
    this.ttl = ttlSeconds * 1000; // Convert to milliseconds
  }
  
  isValid() {
    if (!this.cache || !this.lastUpdate) return false;
    return (Date.now() - this.lastUpdate) < this.ttl;
  }
  
  get(runtime) {
    if (this.isValid()) {
      return this.cache;
    }
    
    // Refresh cache
    this.cache = Object.keys(runtime.getAssetList());
    this.lastUpdate = Date.now();
    console.log(`[CACHE] Asset list refreshed (${this.cache.length} assets)`);
    
    return this.cache;
  }
  
  invalidate() {
    this.cache = null;
    this.lastUpdate = null;
  }
}

module.exports = AssetCache;

// Usage in server.js
const AssetCache = require('./cache/assetCache');
const assetCache = new AssetCache(300); // 5 minute TTL

  res.end(JSON.stringify({ assets, cached: true }));
  return;
```

Solution 21: Graceful Shutdown Handling
javascript
// File: server.js
function setupGracefulShutdown(server) {
  const shutdown = () => {
    console.log('[PHOENIX] Graceful shutdown initiated...');
    server.close(() => {
      console.log('[PHOENIX] HTTP server closed');
      process.exit(0);
    });

    setTimeout(() => {
      console.error('[PHOENIX] Forced shutdown after timeout');
      process.exit(1);
    }, 10000);
  };

  process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);
