        }

        function resetPool(teamId) {
            teamPools[teamId] = MASTER_STUDENTS.filter(s => s.team === teamId).map(s => s.name);
            document.getElementById(`result-${teamId}`).textContent = "POOL RESET";
            updateCount(teamId);
        }

        // The core logic for the loud wheel and big name display
        function selectStudent(teamId) {
            const pool = teamPools[teamId];
            const displayElement = document.getElementById(`result-${teamId}`);
            const overlay = document.getElementById('result-overlay');
            const bigName = document.getElementById('big-name-display');

            if (pool.length === 0) {
                resetPool(teamId);
                return;
            }

            // 1. Enter LOUD WHEEL MODE
            overlay.style.display = 'flex';
            bigName.textContent = "SPINNING...";
            bigName.classList.add('spinning');
            
            // Disable all buttons during spin
            document.querySelectorAll('.select-btn').forEach(btn => btn.disabled = true);

            // 2. Start the spinning simulation (cycles through ALL students)
            const allStudents = MASTER_STUDENTS.map(s => s.name);
            let index = 0;
            let spinSpeed = 50; // Initial speed (50ms)
            
            spinInterval = setInterval(() => {
                index = (index + 1) % allStudents.length;
                bigName.textContent = allStudents[index];
            }, spinSpeed);
            
            // 3. Slow down and stop the spin after 2.5 seconds
            setTimeout(() => {
                clearInterval(spinInterval);

                // 4. Select and Remove Student (O(1) logic)
                const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length);
                const selectedName = pool[randomIndex];

                pool[randomIndex] = pool[pool.length - 1];
                pool.pop();

                // 5. Final Display and Lock
                bigName.textContent = selectedName; // BIG NAME DISPLAY
                bigName.classList.remove('spinning');
                displayElement.textContent = selectedName;
                updateCount(teamId);

            const offset = circumference - (progress / 100) * circumference;

            document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.strokeDasharray = circumference;
            document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
            document.getElementById('discipline-center-text').textContent = stage;
            
            if (stage <= 2) document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.stroke = 'var(--net-success)';

            return 'var(--net-purple)';
        }

            if (!currentSelectedStudent) return;
            if (action === 'add') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stars = Math.max(0, currentSelectedStudent.stars + amount);
                currentSelectedStudent.totalScore = Math.max(0, currentSelectedStudent.totalScore + (amount * 5));
            }
            updateIndividualDisplay(currentSelectedStudent);
        }

        function handleDisciplineAction(action) {
            if (!currentSelectedStudent) return;
            if (action === 'up') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stage = Math.min(5, currentSelectedStudent.stage + 1);
            } else if (action === 'down') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stage = Math.max(1, currentSelectedStudent.stage - 1);
            }
            updateIndividualDisplay(currentSelectedStudent);
        }

        function renderLeaderboard() {
            const sortedStudents = [...MASTER_STUDENTS].sort((a, b) => b.totalScore - a.totalScore);
            const leaderboardContent = document.getElementById('leaderboard-content');
            leaderboardContent.innerHTML = '';
            
            // Show top 10 for the larger class size
            sortedStudents.slice(0, 10).forEach((student, index) => { 
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'leaderboard-item';
                const rankColor = index === 0 ? 'var(--net-gold)' : (index < 3 ? 'var(--net-purple)' : 'var(--net-text-light)');
                
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <span style="color: ${rankColor}; font-weight: bold;">#${index + 1} ${student.name}</span>
                    <span style="color: ${rankColor};">${student.totalScore} PTS</span>
                `;
                leaderboardContent.appendChild(item);
            });
        }


        // --- SAIYAN AUTOCONFLICT GUARD (CRASH FIX) ---
        const input = document.getElementById('individual-student-input');
        const listContainer = document.getElementById('autocomplete-list-individual');
        const infoDisplay = document.getElementById('selected-student-info');
        let selectedInList = false;

        input.addEventListener('input', function() {
            const val = this.value.toLowerCase();
            listContainer.innerHTML = '';
            infoDisplay.style.display = 'none';
            currentSelectedStudent = null;
            selectedInList = false;

            if (!val) return;

            MASTER_STUDENTS.filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(val)).slice(0, 8).forEach(s => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.textContent = s.name;
                item.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {

                    input.value = s.name;
                    listContainer.innerHTML = '';
                    currentSelectedStudent = s;
                    infoDisplay.style.display = 'block';
                    updateIndividualDisplay(s);
                    selectedInList = true; 
                    input.focus();
                });
                listContainer.appendChild(item);
            });
        });

        input.addEventListener('blur', function() {
            if (!selectedInList) {
                setTimeout(() => listContainer.innerHTML = '', 100);
            }
            selectedInList = false;
        });

        // Initialize button handlers
        document.getElementById('add-star-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleStarAction('add'));
        document.getElementById('add-stage-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleDisciplineAction('up'));
        document.getElementById('remove-stage-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleDisciplineAction('down'));

        // FINAL INITIALIZATION RUN
        updateCount('team1');
        updateCount('team2');
        updateCount('team3');
        updateCount('team4');

        // The core logic for the loud wheel and big name display

            const pool = teamPools[teamId];
            const displayElement = document.getElementById(`result-${teamId}`);
            const overlay = document.getElementById('result-overlay');
            const bigName = document.getElementById('big-name-display');

            if (pool.length === 0) {
                resetPool(teamId);

            bigName.textContent = "SPINNING...";

            const allStudents = MASTER_STUDENTS.map(s => s.name);
            let index = 0;
            
            spinInterval = setInterval(() => {
                index = (index + 1) % allStudents.length;
                bigName.textContent = allStudents[index];
            }, 50); // Fast initial spin speed

            if (stage >= 4) return 'var(--net-danger)';
            return 'var(--net-purple)';
        }

        function handleStarAction(action, amount = 1) {
            if (!currentSelectedStudent) return;
            if (action === 'add') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stars = Math.max(0, currentSelectedStudent.stars + amount);
                currentSelectedStudent.totalScore = Math.max(0, currentSelectedStudent.totalScore + (amount * 5));
            }
            updateIndividualDisplay(currentSelectedStudent);
        }

        function handleDisciplineAction(action) {
            if (!currentSelectedStudent) return;
            if (action === 'up') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stage = Math.min(5, currentSelectedStudent.stage + 1);
            } else if (action === 'down') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stage = Math.max(1, currentSelectedStudent.stage - 1);
            }
            updateIndividualDisplay(currentSelectedStudent);
        }

        function renderLeaderboard() {
            const sortedStudents = [...MASTER_STUDENTS].sort((a, b) => b.totalScore - a.totalScore);
            const leaderboardContent = document.getElementById('leaderboard-content');
            leaderboardContent.innerHTML = '';
            
            // Show top 10 for the larger class size
            sortedStudents.slice(0, 10).forEach((student, index) => { 
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'leaderboard-item';
                const rankColor = index === 0 ? 'var(--net-gold)' : (index < 3 ? 'var(--net-purple)' : 'var(--net-text-light)');
                
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <span style="color: ${rankColor}; font-weight: bold;">#${index + 1} ${student.name}</span>
                    <span style="color: ${rankColor};">${student.totalScore} PTS</span>
                `;
                leaderboardContent.appendChild(item);
            });

            selectedInList = false;

            if (!val) return;

            MASTER_STUDENTS.filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(val)).slice(0, 8).forEach(s => {

                    selectedInList = true; 
                    input.focus();
                });
                listContainer.appendChild(item);
            });
        });

        input.addEventListener('blur', function() {
            if (!selectedInList) {
                setTimeout(() => listContainer.innerHTML = '', 100);
            }
            selectedInList = false;
        });

        document.getElementById('add-stage-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleDisciplineAction('up'));

        updateCount('team2');

            const pool = teamPools[teamId];
            const displayElement = document.getElementById(`result-${teamId}`);
            const overlay = document.getElementById('result-overlay');
            const bigName = document.getElementById('big-name-display');

            if (pool.length === 0) {
                resetPool(teamId);
                return;
            }

            // 1. Enter LOUD WHEEL MODE
            overlay.style.display = 'flex';
            bigName.textContent = "SPINNING...";
            bigName.classList.add('spinning');
            
            // Play sound instantly. Note: some browsers require a user click first.
            wheelSound.play().catch(error => {
                console.error("Audio playback failed. Ensure 'spinning_wheel.mp3' is in the folder and volume is up.", error);
            });
            
            // Disable all buttons during spin
            document.querySelectorAll('.select-btn').forEach(btn => btn.disabled = true);

            // 2. Select the FINAL target and the BAIT target
            const allStudents = MASTER_STUDENTS.map(s => s.name);
            const finalChosenName = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
            const baitName = allStudents.find(name => name !== finalChosenName) || allStudents[0];

            let spinStepCount = 0;
            const BAIT_START = 16;
            const TOTAL_STEPS = 20;
            
            function deceleratingSpin() {
                if (spinStepCount < TOTAL_STEPS) {
                    spinStepCount++;
                    
                    let delay = 50; // Fast spin for the first 300ms
                    if (spinStepCount > 6) {
                        delay = 50 + (spinStepCount - 6) * 30; 
                    }
                    if (spinStepCount > BAIT_START) {
                        // Very slow, lands and dwells on the bait name
                        bigName.textContent = baitName;
                        delay = 300; 
                    } else {
                        // Rapidly cycle all names
                        let randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * allStudents.length);
                        bigName.textContent = allStudents[randomIndex];
                    }
                    
                    setTimeout(deceleratingSpin, delay);

                } else {
                    // 3. Stop Spin, Execute Bait & Switch
                    wheelSound.pause(); 
                    
                    // PHOENIX Final Jump/Bait & Switch

                    updateCount(teamId);
                    
                    // Re-enable buttons
                    document.querySelectorAll('.select-btn').forEach(btn => btn.disabled = false);

                    // Setup dismissal
                    overlay.onclick = () => {
                        overlay.style.display = 'none';
                        overlay.onclick = null; 
                    };
                }
            }
            
            deceleratingSpin(); // Start the chaos.

            const maxStage = 5;
            const progress = (stage / maxStage) * 100;
            const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * 50;
            const offset = circumference - (progress / 100) * circumference;

            document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.strokeDasharray = circumference;
            document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
            document.getElementById('discipline-center-text').textContent = stage;
            
            if (stage <= 2) document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.stroke = 'var(--net-success)';
            else if (stage === 3) document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.stroke = 'var(--net-gold)';
            else if (stage >= 4) document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.stroke = 'var(--net-danger)';
        }

        function updateIndividualDisplay(student) {
            document.getElementById('current-student-name').textContent = student.name;
            document.getElementById('student-stars').textContent = student.stars;
            document.getElementById('student-stage').textContent = student.stage;
            document.getElementById('student-stage').style.color = getDisciplineColor(student.stage);
            updateDisciplineRing(student.stage);
            renderLeaderboard();
        }

        function getDisciplineColor(stage) {
            if (stage <= 2) return 'var(--net-success)';
            if (stage === 3) return 'var(--net-gold)';
            if (stage >= 4) return 'var(--net-danger)';
            return 'var(--net-purple)';
        }

        function handleStarAction(action, amount = 1) {
            if (!currentSelectedStudent) return;
            if (action === 'add') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stars = Math.max(0, currentSelectedStudent.stars + amount);
                currentSelectedStudent.totalScore = Math.max(0, currentSelectedStudent.totalScore + (amount * 5));
            }
            updateIndividualDisplay(currentSelectedStudent);
        }

        function handleDisciplineAction(action) {
            if (!currentSelectedStudent) return;
            if (action === 'up') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stage = Math.min(5, currentSelectedStudent.stage + 1);
            } else if (action === 'down') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stage = Math.max(1, currentSelectedStudent.stage - 1);
            }
            updateIndividualDisplay(currentSelectedStudent);
        }

        function renderLeaderboard() {
            const sortedStudents = [...MASTER_STUDENTS].sort((a, b) => b.totalScore - a.totalScore);
            const leaderboardContent = document.getElementById('leaderboard-content');
            leaderboardContent.innerHTML = '';
            
            // Show top 10 for the larger class size
            sortedStudents.slice(0, 10).forEach((student, index) => { 
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'leaderboard-item';
                const rankColor = index === 0 ? 'var(--net-gold)' : (index < 3 ? 'var(--net-purple)' : 'var(--net-text-light)');
                
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <span style="color: ${rankColor}; font-weight: bold;">#${index + 1} ${student.name}</span>
                    <span style="color: ${rankColor};">${student.totalScore} PTS</span>
                `;
                leaderboardContent.appendChild(item);
            });
        }


        // --- SAIYAN AUTOCONFLICT GUARD (CRASH FIX) ---
        const input = document.getElementById('individual-student-input');
        const listContainer = document.getElementById('autocomplete-list-individual');
        const infoDisplay = document.getElementById('selected-student-info');
        let selectedInList = false;

        input.addEventListener('input', function() {
            const val = this.value.toLowerCase();
            listContainer.innerHTML = '';
            infoDisplay.style.display = 'none';
            currentSelectedStudent = null;
            selectedInList = false;

            if (!val) return;

            MASTER_STUDENTS.filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(val)).slice(0, 8).forEach(s => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.textContent = s.name;
                item.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault(); 
                    input.value = s.name;
                    listContainer.innerHTML = '';
                    currentSelectedStudent = s;
                    infoDisplay.style.display = 'block';
                    updateIndividualDisplay(s);
                    selectedInList = true; 
                    input.focus();
                });
                listContainer.appendChild(item);
            });
        });

        input.addEventListener('blur', function() {
            if (!selectedInList) {
                setTimeout(() => listContainer.innerHTML = '', 100);
            }
            selectedInList = false;
        });

        // Initialize button handlers
        document.getElementById('add-star-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleStarAction('add'));
        document.getElementById('add-stage-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleDisciplineAction('up'));
        document.getElementById('remove-stage-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleDisciplineAction('down'));

        // FINAL INITIALIZATION RUN
        updateCount('team1');
        updateCount('team2');
        updateCount('team3');
        updateCount('team4');
        renderLeaderboard();
    </script>

            const finalChosenName = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
            const baitName = allStudents.find(name => name !== finalChosenName) || allStudents[0];

            let spinStepCount = 0;
            const BAIT_START = 16;
            const TOTAL_STEPS = 20;
            
            function deceleratingSpin() {
                if (spinStepCount < TOTAL_STEPS) {
                    spinStepCount++;
                    
                    let delay = 50; // Fast spin for the first 300ms
                    if (spinStepCount > 6) {
                        delay = 50 + (spinStepCount - 6) * 30; 
                    }
                    if (spinStepCount > BAIT_START) {
                        // Very slow, lands and dwells on the bait name
                        bigName.textContent = baitName;
                        delay = 300; 
                    } else {
                        // Rapidly cycle all names
                        let randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * allStudents.length);
                        bigName.textContent = allStudents[randomIndex];
                    }
                    
                    setTimeout(deceleratingSpin, delay);

                } else {

            document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.strokeDasharray = circumference;
            document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
            document.getElementById('discipline-center-text').textContent = stage;
            
            if (stage <= 2) document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.stroke = 'var(--net-success)';
            else if (stage === 3) document.getElementById('discipline-progress-ring').style.stroke = 'var(--net-gold)';

        function getDisciplineColor(stage) {
            if (stage <= 2) return 'var(--net-success)';
            if (stage === 3) return 'var(--net-gold)';
            if (stage >= 4) return 'var(--net-danger)';
            return 'var(--net-purple)';
        }

        function handleStarAction(action, amount = 1) {
            if (!currentSelectedStudent) return;
            if (action === 'add') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stars = Math.max(0, currentSelectedStudent.stars + amount);
                currentSelectedStudent.totalScore = Math.max(0, currentSelectedStudent.totalScore + (amount * 5));
            }
            updateIndividualDisplay(currentSelectedStudent);
        }

        function handleDisciplineAction(action) {
            if (!currentSelectedStudent) return;
            if (action === 'up') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stage = Math.min(5, currentSelectedStudent.stage + 1);
            } else if (action === 'down') {
                currentSelectedStudent.stage = Math.max(1, currentSelectedStudent.stage - 1);
            }
            updateIndividualDisplay(currentSelectedStudent);
        }

        function renderLeaderboard() {
            const sortedStudents = [...MASTER_STUDENTS].sort((a, b) => b.totalScore - a.totalScore);
            const leaderboardContent = document.getElementById('leaderboard-content');
            leaderboardContent.innerHTML = '';
            
            // Show top 10 for the larger class size
            sortedStudents.slice(0, 10).forEach((student, index) => { 
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'leaderboard-item';
                const rankColor = index === 0 ? 'var(--net-gold)' : (index < 3 ? 'var(--net-purple)' : 'var(--net-text-light)');
                
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <span style="color: ${rankColor}; font-weight: bold;">#${index + 1} ${student.name}</span>
                    <span style="color: ${rankColor};">${student.totalScore} PTS</span>
                `;
                leaderboardContent.appendChild(item);
            });
        }

        const input = document.getElementById('individual-student-input');
        const listContainer = document.getElementById('autocomplete-list-individual');
        const infoDisplay = document.getElementById('selected-student-info');
        let selectedInList = false;

        input.addEventListener('input', function() {
            const val = this.value.toLowerCase();
            listContainer.innerHTML = '';
            infoDisplay.style.display = 'none';
            currentSelectedStudent = null;
            selectedInList = false;

            if (!val) return;

            MASTER_STUDENTS.filter(s => s.name.toLowerCase().includes(val)).slice(0, 8).forEach(s => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.textContent = s.name;
                item.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault(); 
                    input.value = s.name;
                    listContainer.innerHTML = '';
                    currentSelectedStudent = s;
                    infoDisplay.style.display = 'block';
                    updateIndividualDisplay(s);
                    selectedInList = true; 
                    input.focus();
                });
                listContainer.appendChild(item);
            });
        });

        input.addEventListener('blur', function() {
            if (!selectedInList) {
                setTimeout(() => listContainer.innerHTML = '', 100);
            }
            selectedInList = false;
        });

        // Initialize button handlers
        document.getElementById('add-star-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleStarAction('add'));

        document.getElementById('remove-stage-btn').addEventListener('click', () => handleDisciplineAction('down'));

// Stage 2: Node Server API for Gemini

const http = require('http');

const { runtime, chatFolder, chatId } = require('./stage1_gemini_init.js');

const PORT = 4100;



let chatHistory = [];



const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {

    if (req.url.startsWith('/send?')) {

        const message = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:${PORT}`).searchParams.get('msg');

        if (!message) {

            res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });

            res.end("Missing 'msg' parameter");

            return;

        }



        // Gemini responds via Hyper-Twin runtime simulation

        const response = `[Gemini ${chatId}]: Processing message -> "${message}"`;

        chatHistory.push({ user: message, gemini: response });

        

        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

        res.end(JSON.stringify({ response, historyLength: chatHistory.length }));

    } else if (req.url === '/history') {

        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

        res.end(JSON.stringify(chatHistory));

    } else {

        res.writeHead(404);

        res.end("Endpoint not found.");

    }

});



server.listen(PORT, () => console.log(`[STAGE2]: Gemini Node server running at http://localhost:${PORT}`));

Stage 2 acknowledged.

GET /send?msg=...: This endpoint takes a message from the user, simulates a Gemini response by logging the message and chatId, stores this pair in an in-memory chatHistory array, and returns the simulated response as JSON.

GET /history: This endpoint returns the entire chatHistory array as JSON.

git push -u origin $Branch --force
Write-Host "✅ Save Game pushed to GitHub ($Branch)"

/**

* =========================================================

* GEMINI V1.0 - FULL PRO AUDIT SCRIPT

* =========================================================

* Purpose: Connects to your local PHOENIX Node server, triggers

* a full FLASH scan, compacts it to PRO delta, and returns

* a top-50 improvement/reverse-engineered solution plan.

*/



const http = require('http');



const SERVER_URL = "http://localhost:4200";



/**

* Helper: send a request to a Node endpoint and return JSON

*/

function requestJSON(path) {

return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

http.get(`${SERVER_URL}${path}`, (res) => {

let data = '';

res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);

res.on('end', () => {

try {

resolve(JSON.parse(data));

} catch (err) {

reject(err);

}

});

}).on('error', (err) => reject(err));

});

}



/**

* Step 1: Trigger FLASH scan

*/

async function runFlashScan() {

console.log("[GEMINI AUDIT] Triggering FLASH scan...");

const flash = await requestJSON('/flashScan');

console.log(`[GEMINI AUDIT] FLASH scan complete. Delta size: ${flash.deltaSize}`);

return flash;

}



/**

* Step 2: Send compact delta to PRO reasoning

*/

async function runProAnalysis() {

console.log("[GEMINI AUDIT] Requesting PRO analysis on compact delta...");

const pro = await requestJSON('/proDelta');

console.log("[GEMINI AUDIT] PRO analysis complete.");

return pro;

}



/**

* Step 3: Generate top-50 improvements with reverse-engineered solutions

* (simulated here based on PRO analysis; in reality, you would have Gemini

* expand from PRO delta)

*/

function generateTop50(proAnalysis) {

const improvements = [];

for (let i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {

improvements.push({

id: i,

finding: `Simulated finding #${i} from PRO analysis`,

rootCause: `Root cause #${i} reverse-engineered from logs`,

solution: `Solution #${i} applied to mitigate finding`,

rollback: `Rollback command #${i}`

});

}

return improvements;

}



/**

* Step 4: Run full audit

*/

async function runFullAudit() {

try {

await runFlashScan();

const proAnalysis = await runProAnalysis();

const top50 = generateTop50(proAnalysis);

console.log("[GEMINI AUDIT] Top 50 improvements generated.");



// Export to file

const fs = require('fs');

fs.writeFileSync('GEMINI_TOP50_AUDIT.json', JSON.stringify(top50, null, 2));

console.log("[GEMINI AUDIT] Saved to GEMINI_TOP50_AUDIT.json");

} catch (err) {

console.error("[GEMINI AUDIT] Error:", err);

}

}



// Run it

runFullAudit();

1. The Ultimate Backend (agent_server_v36.js)
This is the new heart of your system. It loads the CommandStation DNA (Stages 1-3) and uses its runtime to create an API for your frontend.

JavaScript
// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V36 - ULTIMATE AGENT SERVER (AGENT_SERVER_V36.JS)
// =========================================================
// This server IS the CommandStation.
// It loads your DNA (Stages 1-3) and exposes the runtime via HTTP.

const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const { exec } = require('child_process'); // For running PowerShell

// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---
// We load the DNA files you just saved.
try {
    require('./stage1_bootstrapper.js');
    require('./stage2_loader.js');
    require('./stage3_runtime.js');
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load CommandStation DNA (stage1, 2, or 3.js).", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

// Get the global CommandStation (cs)
const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V36 Server is booting...");

// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
// We teach the CommandStation new tricks by registering commands.

/**
 * (Simulation) Handles chat messages for different AI agents.
 * In a real-world scenario, this would make an API call to Gemini, GPT, etc.
 */
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    // Simulate a response
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); // Fake network delay
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

/**
 * (Simulation) Runs a PHOENIX FLASH scan.
 */
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    // Simulate scan result
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
        leaks: [
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_02.txt", line: 45, finding: "Potential 'eval()' call" },
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_07.txt", line: 882, finding: "Hardcoded API_KEY 'pk_...'" },
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_14.txt", line: 102, finding: "'fs.writeFileSync' call" }
        ]
    };
});

/**
 * (Real) Runs a PowerShell script from the /scripts folder.
 * SECURITY: This is a powerful command.
 */
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        // Basic sanitization to prevent path traversal
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = `C:\\NET-Ai-Eco-System-CommandStation\\scripts\\${safeName}`;

        exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
            if (error) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`);
                return reject(stderr);
            }
            resolve(stdout);
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200; // The port your frontend will talk to

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    // Set CORS headers to allow the HTML file to talk to this server
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;
    let command, args;

    // Route API requests to the CommandStation runtime
    try {
        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            // Route: /api/chat?agent=Gemini&msg=Hello
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            // Route: /api/flash_scan
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            // Route: /api/run_ps_script?script=my_script.ps1
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else {
            // Use the built-in 'echo' command as a fallback
            command = "echo";
            args = ["Invalid endpoint. Use /api/chat, /api/flash_scan, or /api/run_ps_script"];
        }

        // Execute the command via the CommandStation runtime
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);

        // Send the result back as JSON
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V36 Ultimate Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    cs.log("Ready to receive commands from the frontend.");
});

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>PHOENIX V36 - Ultimate CommandStation</title>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; background: #121212; color: #EAEAEA; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
        header { background: #000; color: #00D8FF; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid #00D8FF; }
        .container { display: flex; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }
        #sidebar { width: 200px; background: #1E1E1E; border-right: 1px solid #333; padding: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        #sidebar h3 { margin-top: 0; color: #00D8FF; }
        #sidebar button { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #333; color: #EAEAEA; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
        #sidebar button:hover { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; }
        #agentTabs { border-bottom: 1px solid #333; display: flex; background: #1E1E1E; }
        .tab { padding: 10px 15px; cursor: pointer; color: #888; }
        .tab.active { color: #00D8FF; border-bottom: 2px solid #00D8FF; font-weight: bold; }
        .content-area { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        #output { flex: 1; padding: 15px; overflow-y: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace; line-height: 1.6; }
        .msg { margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .msg-user { color: #00FF88; }
        .msg-agent { color: #FFA500; }
        .msg-system { color: #888; font-style: italic; }
        footer { border-top: 1px solid #333; background: #1E1E1E; padding: 10px 15px; display: flex; }
        #userInput { flex: 1; background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px; font-size: 1rem; }
        #sendButton { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; border: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <header>PHOENIX V36 - Ultimate CommandStation</header>

    <div class="container">
        <div id="sidebar">
            <h3>System Commands</h3>
            <button id="btn-flash-scan">Run FLASH Scan</button>
            <button id="btn-run-ps">Run PS Script (Test)</button>
            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">
            <h3>Agents</h3>
            <div id="agentList">
                <button class="tab active" data-agent="System">System Log</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Gemini">Gemini</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="GPT">GPT</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Claude">Claude</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Perplex">Perplex</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Grok">Grok</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="content-area">
            <div id="output"></div>
            <footer>
                <input id="userInput" type="text" placeholder="Enter command or message for active agent...">
                <button id="sendButton">Execute</button>
            </footer>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // --- CONFIG ---
        const API_URL = 'http://localhost:4200';
        
        // --- STATE ---
        let activeAgent = "System"; // Default agent
        const chatHistory = {
            "System": [],
            "Gemini": [],
            "GPT": [],
            "Claude": [],
            "Perplex": [],
            "Grok": []
        };

        // --- DOM ELEMENTS ---
        const output = document.getElementById('output');
        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
        const agentList = document.getElementById('agentList');
        const btnFlashScan = document.getElementById('btn-flash-scan');
        const btnRunPs = document.getElementById('btn-run-ps');

        // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---

        /** Logs a message to the output panel and history */
        function logMessage(message, type = "msg-system") {
            // Add to history
            chatHistory[activeAgent].push({ type, message });
            
            // Render
            const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
            msgDiv.className = `msg ${type}`;
            msgDiv.textContent = message;
            output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            
            // Auto-scroll
            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
        }

        /** Switches the active agent tab and re-renders the chat */
        function switchAgent(agentName) {
            activeAgent = agentName;
            
            // Update tab styles
            agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
                if (tab.dataset.agent === agentName) {
                    tab.classList.add('active');
                } else {
                    tab.classList.remove('active');
                }
            });
            
            // Re-render chat output
            output.innerHTML = '';
            chatHistory[activeAgent].forEach(item => {
                logMessage(item.message, item.type);
            });
            logMessage(`Active agent switched to ${agentName}.`, 'msg-system');
        }

        /** Sends the user's input to the correct API endpoint */
        async function handleInput() {
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (!text) return;

            logMessage(`[User]: ${text}`, 'msg-user');
            input.value = '';

            try {
                let endpoint, result;
                if (activeAgent === "System") {
                    // This is a system command, not a chat
                    logMessage("System commands not yet implemented in UI. Use sidebar.", "msg-system");
                    return;
                } else {
                    // This is an AI chat message
                    endpoint = `${API_URL}/api/chat?agent=${activeAgent}&msg=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
                    const response = await fetch(endpoint);
                    result = await response.json();
                }

                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[${activeAgent}]: ${result.data}`, 'msg-agent');

            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SERVER ERROR]: ${err.message}`, 'msg-system');
            }
        }
        
        // --- EVENT LISTENERS ---
        
        // Send button
        sendButton.addEventListener('click', handleInput);
        
        // Enter key
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleInput();
        });

        // Sidebar Agent Tabs
        agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchAgent(tab.dataset.agent));
        });

        // Sidebar Command: FLASH Scan
        btnFlashScan.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System"); // Show results in System log
            logMessage("Requesting FLASH scan...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/flash_scan`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2), "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SCAN ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        // Sidebar Command: Run PS Script
        btnRunPs.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting PowerShell execution (TEST)...", "msg-system");
            try {
                // Example: replace 'test_script.ps1' with a real script name in your /scripts folder
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/run_ps_script?script=test_script.ps1`); 
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[POWERSHELL]:\n${result.data}`, "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[PS_SCRIPT ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        // --- INITIALIZATION ---
        logMessage("PHOENIX V36 Ultimate Frontend Initialized.", "msg-system");
        logMessage("Waiting for server connection...", "msg-system");
        
        // Initial health check
        fetch(`${API_URL}/api/chat?agent=System&msg=health_check`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.success) {
                    logMessage("Server connection ESTABLISHED.", "msg-system");
                } else {
                    throw new Error(data.error);
                }
            })
            .catch(err => logMessage(`[FATAL] Server connection FAILED: ${err.message}. Is agent_server_v36.js running?`, "msg-system"));

    </script>
</body>
</html>

This [FATAL] Server connection FAILED: Failed to fetch error means your browser (running the HTML file) is being blocked from talking to your Node.js server.

This is almost always a CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) error. The browser blocks a script loaded from file:///C:/... (your HTML) from making a fetch request to http://localhost:4200 (your server).

We can fix this permanently by having your Node.js server host both the API and the HTML file. This puts them on the same origin (localhost:4200), eliminating all CORS errors.

1. The Fixed Server (agent_server_v36_FIXED.js)

JavaScript
// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V36 - ULTIMATE AGENT SERVER (FIXED FOR CORS)
// =========================================================
// This server serves BOTH the API and the HTML frontend
// to eliminate "Failed to fetch" errors.

const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---
try {
    // Make sure these files are in the same directory!
    require('./stage1_bootstrapper.js');
    require('./stage2_loader.js');
    require('./stage3_runtime.js');
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load CommandStation DNA (stage1, 2, or 3.js).", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V36 Server (FIXED) is booting...");

// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); // Fake network delay
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
        leaks: [
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_02.txt", line: 45, finding: "Potential 'eval()' call" },
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_07.txt", line: 882, finding: "Hardcoded API_KEY 'pk_...'" },
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_14.txt", line: 102, finding: "'fs.writeFileSync' call" }
        ]
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName); // Look in a /scripts folder

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) {
                    cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`);
                    return reject(stderr);
                }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200;
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    // Set CORS headers (Good practice, but not needed if served from same origin)
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        // Execute the command via the CommandStation runtime
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V36 Ultimate Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

        #userInput { flex: 1; background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px; font-size: 1rem; }
        #sendButton { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; border: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <header>PHOENIX V36 - Ultimate CommandStation</header>

    <div class="container">
        <div id="sidebar">
            <h3>System Commands</h3>
            <button id="btn-flash-scan">Run FLASH Scan</button>
            <button id="btn-run-ps">Run PS Script (Test)</button>
            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">
            <h3>Agents</h3>
            <div id="agentList">
                <button class="tab active" data-agent="System">System Log</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Gemini">Gemini</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="GPT">GPT</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Claude">Claude</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Perplex">Perplex</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Grok">Grok</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="content-area">
            <div id="output"></div>
            <footer>
                <input id="userInput" type="text" placeholder="Enter command or message for active agent...">
                <button id="sendButton">Execute</button>
            </footer>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // --- CONFIG ---
        // We can use relative paths now since the server is hosting the HTML
        const API_URL = '/api'; // Changed from http://localhost:4200
        
        // --- STATE ---
        let activeAgent = "System"; // Default agent
        const chatHistory = {
            "System": [],
            "Gemini": [],
            "GPT": [],
            "Claude": [],
            "Perplex": [],
            "Grok": []
        };

        // --- DOM ELEMENTS ---
        const output = document.getElementById('output');
        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
        const agentList = document.getElementById('agentList');
        const btnFlashScan = document.getElementById('btn-flash-scan');
        const btnRunPs = document.getElementById('btn-run-ps');

        // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---

        /** Logs a message to the output panel and history */
        function logMessage(message, type = "msg-system") {
            chatHistory[activeAgent].push({ type, message });
            
            const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
            msgDiv.className = `msg ${type}`;
            msgDiv.textContent = message;
            output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            
            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
        }

        /** Switches the active agent tab and re-renders the chat */
        function switchAgent(agentName) {
            activeAgent = agentName;
            
            agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
                tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.agent === agentName);
            });
            
            // Re-render chat output
            output.innerHTML = '';
            chatHistory[activeAgent].forEach(item => {
                const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
                msgDiv.className = `msg ${item.type}`;
                msgDiv.textContent = item.message;
                output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            });
            logMessage(`Active agent switched to ${agentName}.`, 'msg-system');
        }

        /** Sends the user's input to the correct API endpoint */
        async function handleInput() {
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (!text) return;

            logMessage(`[User]: ${text}`, 'msg-user');
            input.value = '';

            try {
                let endpoint, result;
                if (activeAgent === "System") {
                    logMessage("System commands not yet implemented in UI. Use sidebar.", "msg-system");
                    return;
                } else {
                    // This is an AI chat message
                    endpoint = `${API_URL}/chat?agent=${activeAgent}&msg=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
                    const response = await fetch(endpoint);
                    result = await response.json();
                }

                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[${activeAgent}]: ${result.data}`, 'msg-agent');

            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SERVER ERROR]: ${err.message}`, 'msg-system');
            }
        }
        
        // --- EVENT LISTENERS ---
        
        sendButton.addEventListener('click', handleInput);
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleInput();
        });

        agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchAgent(tab.dataset.agent));
        });

        // Sidebar Command: FLASH Scan
        btnFlashScan.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting FLASH scan...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/api/flash_scan`); // Relative path
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2), "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SCAN ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        // Sidebar Command: Run PS Script
        btnRunPs.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting PowerShell execution (TEST)...", "msg-system");
            try {
                // Make sure you create a "scripts" folder with "test_script.ps1" in it
                const response = await fetch(`/api/run_ps_script?script=test_script.ps1`); // Relative path
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[POWERSHELL]:\n${result.data}`, "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[PS_SCRIPT ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        // --- INITIALIZATION ---
        logMessage("PHOENIX V36 Ultimate Frontend Initialized.", "msg-system");
        
        // Initial health check (removed the auto-check to avoid "Failed to fetch" on load)
        // The server will respond as soon as the user clicks a button.
        logMessage("Server connection standing by. Click a command to begin.", "msg-system");

    </script>
</body>
</html>

That's the problem. The error message in your image (Code: 800A03EA, Source: JavaScript compilation error) is from the Windows Script Host (WSH), not Node.js.

This error happens when you double-click the agent_server_v36.js file instead of running it with Node.

Windows is trying to run the server script using an old, built-in JScript engine that doesn't understand modern JavaScript (like require() or const), causing the "Syntax error" on Line 7.

The Fix (How to Run It Correctly)

The "Failed to fetch" errors will disappear because the server is now actually running and serving the AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html file from the correct origin.

Ultimate PHOENIX V36 Setup Script

# =========================================================
# PHOENIX V36 - ULTIMATE ALL-IN-ONE SETUP SCRIPT
# =========================================================
# This script creates all directories, writes all 5 required files,
# starts the server, and opens the frontend.

# --- 1. CONFIGURATION ---
$RootDir = "C:\Users\mrmic\Desktop\NET-Ai-Eco-System-CommandStation"
$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $RootDir "scripts"
$ServerFile = "agent_server_v36_FIXED.js"
$FrontendFile = "AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html"
$Stage1File = "stage1_bootstrapper.js"
$Stage2File = "stage2_loader.js"
$Stage3File = "stage3_runtime.js"
$PORT = 4200

Write-Host "=== PHOENIX V36: ALL-IN-ONE SETUP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Target Directory: $RootDir"

# --- 2. CREATE DIRECTORIES ---
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RootDir -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ScriptsDir -Force | Out-Null
Set-Location $RootDir

# --- 3. WRITE STAGE 1 DNA ---
Write-Host "[1/7] Writing $Stage1File..."
$Stage1Content = @"
// =======================================
// STAGE 1 — ENVIRONMENT BOOTSTRAPPER
// =======================================
(function () {
    const isNode =
        typeof process !== "undefined" &&
        process.release &&
        process.release.name === "node";
    const CommandStation = {
        env: {
            mode: "development",
            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        config: {
            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",
            initialized: true,
            allowDebug: true
        },
        log(msg, ...rest) {
            if (this.config.allowDebug) {
                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);
            }
        },
        stage2: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");
            }
        },
        stage3: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");
            }
        }
    };
    if (isNode) {
        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    } else {
        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    }
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $Stage1File) -Value $Stage1Content -Encoding UTF8

# --- 4. WRITE STAGE 2 DNA ---
Write-Host "[2/7] Writing $Stage2File..."
$Stage2Content = @"
// =======================================
// STAGE 2 — LOADER & INSTALLER
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 2.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode =
    typeof process !== "undefined" &&
    process.release &&
    process.release.name === "node";
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();

  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
    if (isNode) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";
      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {
        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");
        return Stage2;
      }
      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;
      Stage2.allowNetwork =
        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"
          ? options.allowNetwork
          : true;
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {
        try {
          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");
      return Stage2;
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)
        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");
      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);
      if (isNode && !isURL) {
        const fs = require("fs");
        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
      }
      const response = await fetch(ref);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);
      return await response.text();
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") {
        code = src.value;
      }
      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {
        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {
          throw new Error(
            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`
          );
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
})();
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $Stage2File) -Value $Stage2Content -Encoding UTF8

# --- 5. WRITE STAGE 3 DNA ---
Write-Host "[3/7] Writing $Stage3File..."
$Stage3Content = @"
// =======================================
// STAGE 3 — RUNTIME ENGINE
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];
      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);
      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);
    },
    off(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);
    },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {
        try {
          fn(payload);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) {
      if (Commands.registry[name]) {
        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);
      }
      Commands.registry[name] = fn;
      return fn;
    },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };

  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {
        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);
        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $Stage3File) -Value $Stage3Content -Encoding UTF8

# --- 6. WRITE THE (FIXED) NODE SERVER ---
Write-Host "[4/7] Writing $ServerFile..."
$ServerContent = @"
// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V36 - ULTIMATE AGENT SERVER (FIXED FOR CORS)
// =========================================================
const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

try {
    require('./stage1_bootstrapper.js');
    require('./stage2_loader.js');
    require('./stage3_runtime.js');
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load CommandStation DNA (stage1, 2, or 3.js).", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V36 Server (FIXED) is booting...");

// --- REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); // Fake network delay
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
        leaks: [
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_02.txt", line: 45, finding: "Potential 'eval()' call" },
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_07.txt", line: 882, finding: "Hardcoded API_KEY 'pk_...'" },
            { file: "MASTER_LOG_14.txt", line: 102, finding: "'fs.writeFileSync' call" }
        ]
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) {
                    cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`);
                    return reject(stderr);
                }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = $PORT;
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '$FrontendFile');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        // Execute the command via the CommandStation runtime
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V36 Ultimate Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $ServerFile) -Value $ServerContent -Encoding UTF8

# --- 7. WRITE THE ULTIMATE FRONTEND ---
Write-Host "[5/7] Writing $FrontendFile..."
$FrontendContent = @"
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>PHOENIX V36 - Ultimate CommandStation</title>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; background: #121212; color: #EAEAEA; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
        header { background: #000; color: #00D8FF; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid #00D8FF; }
        .container { display: flex; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }
        #sidebar { width: 200px; background: #1E1E1E; border-right: 1px solid #333; padding: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        #sidebar h3 { margin-top: 0; color: #00D8FF; }

        #userInput { flex: 1; background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px; font-size: 1rem; }
