    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <header>PHOENIX V36 - Ultimate CommandStation</header>
    <div class="container">
        <div id="sidebar">
            <h3>System Commands</h3>
            <button id="btn-flash-scan">Run FLASH Scan</button>
            <button id="btn-run-ps">Run PS Script (Test)</button>
            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">
            <h3>Agents</h3>
            <div id="agentList">
                <button class="tab active" data-agent="System">System Log</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Gemini">Gemini</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="GPT">GPT</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Claude">Claude</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Perplex">Perplex</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Grok">Grok</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="content-area">
            <div id="output"></div>
            <footer>
                <input id="userInput" type="text" placeholder="Enter command or message for active agent...">
                <button id="sendButton">Execute</button>
            </footer>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        const API_URL = 'http://localhost:$PORT';
        let activeAgent = "System";
        const chatHistory = {
            "System": [], "Gemini": [], "GPT": [], "Claude": [], "Perplex": [], "Grok": []
        };

        const output = document.getElementById('output');
        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
        const agentList = document.getElementById('agentList');
        const btnFlashScan = document.getElementById('btn-flash-scan');
        const btnRunPs = document.getElementById('btn-run-ps');

        function logMessage(message, type = "msg-system") {
            chatHistory[activeAgent].push({ type, message });
            const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
            msgDiv.className = `msg ${type}`;
            msgDiv.textContent = message;
            output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
        }

        function switchAgent(agentName) {
            activeAgent = agentName;
            agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
                tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.agent === agentName);
            });
            output.innerHTML = '';
            chatHistory[activeAgent].forEach(item => {
                const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
                msgDiv.className = `msg ${item.type}`;
                msgDiv.textContent = item.message;
                output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            });
            logMessage(`Active agent switched to ${agentName}.`, 'msg-system');
        }

        async function handleInput() {
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (!text) return;

            logMessage(`[User]: ${text}`, 'msg-user');
            input.value = '';

            try {
                let endpoint, result;
                if (activeAgent === "System") {
                    logMessage("System commands not yet implemented in UI. Use sidebar.", "msg-system");
                    return;
                } else {
                    endpoint = `${API_URL}/api/chat?agent=${activeAgent}&msg=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
                    const response = await fetch(endpoint);
                    result = await response.json();
                }

                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[${activeAgent}]: ${result.data}`, 'msg-agent');

            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SERVER ERROR]: ${err.message}`, 'msg-system');
            }
        }
        
        sendButton.addEventListener('click', handleInput);
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleInput();
        });

        agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchAgent(tab.dataset.agent));
        });

        btnFlashScan.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting FLASH scan...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/flash_scan`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2), "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SCAN ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        btnRunPs.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting PowerShell execution (TEST)...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/run_ps_script?script=test_script.ps1`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[POWERSHELL]:\n${result.data}`, "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[PS_SCRIPT ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        // Initial health check
        logMessage("PHOENIX V36 Ultimate Frontend Initialized.", "msg-system");
        fetch(`${API_URL}/api/chat?agent=System&msg=health_check`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.success) {
                    logMessage("Server connection ESTABLISHED.", "msg-system");
                } else { throw new Error(data.error); }
            })
            .catch(err => logMessage(`[FATAL] Server connection FAILED: ${err.message}.`, "msg-system"));
    </script>
</body>
</html>

This ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED error means the browser tried to connect to http://localhost:4200, but the server (agent_server_v36_FIXED.js) isn't running.

Ultimate PHOENIX V37 Setup Script (Monolithic)

PowerShell
# =========================================================
# PHOENIX V37 - ULTIMATE MONOLITHIC SETUP SCRIPT
# =========================================================
# This script creates ONE server file with ALL DNA embedded
# to prevent "Failed to fetch" and "ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED" errors.

# --- 1. CONFIGURATION ---
$RootDir = "C:\Users\mrmic\Desktop\NET-Ai-Eco-System-CommandStation"
$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $RootDir "scripts"
$ServerFile = "agent_server_FINAL.js"
$FrontendFile = "AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html"
$PORT = 4200

Write-Host "=== PHOENIX V37: MONOLITHIC SETUP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Target Directory: $RootDir"

# --- 2. CREATE DIRECTORIES ---
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RootDir -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ScriptsDir -Force | Out-Null
Set-Location $RootDir

# --- 3. WRITE THE ULTIMATE (FIXED) NODE SERVER ---
Write-Host "[1/3] Writing $ServerFile (with all DNA embedded)..."
$ServerContent = @"
// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V37 - ULTIMATE AGENT SERVER (MONOLITHIC)
// =========================================================
// Contains Stage 1, 2, 3 DNA + API Server in one file.

const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- STAGE 1: BOOTSTRAPPER ---
(function () {
    const isNode = true;
    const CommandStation = {
        env: { mode: "development", platform: "node", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        config: { version: "1.0.0-STAGE1", initialized: true, allowDebug: true },
        log(msg, ...rest) { if (this.config.allowDebug) { console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest); } },
        stage2: { loaded: false, init: () => { throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet."); } },
        stage3: { loaded: false, init: () => { throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet."); } }
    };
    global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// --- STAGE 2: LOADER ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") { throw new Error("Stage 1 must be loaded."); }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode = true;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) { if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) { try { console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args); } catch (e) {} } }
  
  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
  }
  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (typeof base[k] === "object" && base[k] !== null && !Array.isArray(base[k]) && typeof overlay[k] === "object" && overlay[k] !== null && !Array.isArray(overlay[k])) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = "node";
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork) throw new Error("Network access disabled.");
      const fs = require("fs");
      return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") { code = src.value; }
      else if (src.type === "path") { code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value); }
      else { throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`); }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) { throw new Error(`Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch!`); }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
  cs.stage2.init(); // Auto-init Stage 2
})();

// --- STAGE 3: RUNTIME ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") { throw new Error("Stage 1/2 must be loaded."); }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) { if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) { try { console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args); } catch (e) {} } }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) { if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = []; Bus.listeners[event].push(fn); return () => Bus.off(event, fn); },
    off(event, fn) { if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return; Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn); },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) { try { fn(payload); } catch (err) { safeLog("Bus listener error:", err); } }
    }
  };
  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) { if (Commands.registry[name]) { safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`); } Commands.registry[name] = fn; return fn; },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };
  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) { safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`); clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler); }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try { Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() }); await fn(); } catch (err) { Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() }); }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };
  
  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => { return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config; });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => { cs.config[key] = value; return true; });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => { return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env; });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();

// --- V36 API COMMANDS ---
const cs = global.CommandStation;

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- V36 HTTP SERVER (CORS FIXED) ---
const PORT = $PORT;
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '$FrontendFile');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    // Set CORS headers
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html. Make sure it is in the same folder.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else {
            // Health check endpoint
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V36 Server is healthy."];
        }

        // Execute via CommandStation
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V37 Ultimate Server (Monolithic) running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

    </script>
</body>
</html>

# =========================================================
# PHOENIX V38 - ULTIMATE MONOLITHIC SETUP (FIXED)
# =========================================================
# This script creates ONE server file (all DNA embedded) and
# ONE frontend file, then runs the server in this window
# to prevent silent crashes and connection errors.

# --- 1. CONFIGURATION ---
$RootDir = "C:\Users\mrmic\Desktop\NET-Ai-Eco-System-CommandStation"
$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $RootDir "scripts"
$ServerFile = "agent_server_V38.js"
$FrontendFile = "AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html"

$ServerContent = @"
// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V38 - ULTIMATE AGENT SERVER (MONOLITHIC)
// =========================================================
// Contains Stage 1, 2, 3 DNA + API Server in one file.

const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- STAGE 1: BOOTSTRAPPER ---
(function () {
    const isNode = true;
    const CommandStation = {
        env: { mode: "development", platform: "node", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        config: { version: "1.0.0-STAGE1", initialized: true, allowDebug: true },
        log(msg, ...rest) { if (this.config.allowDebug) { console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest); } },
        stage2: { loaded: false, init: () => { throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet."); } },
        stage3: { loaded: false, init: () => { throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet."); } }
    };
    global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// --- STAGE 2: LOADER ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") { throw new Error("Stage 1 must be loaded."); }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode = true;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) { if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) { try { console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args); } catch (e) {} } }
  
  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
  }
  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (typeof base[k] === "object" && base[k] !== null && !Array.isArray(base[k]) && typeof overlay[k] === "object" && overlay[k] !== null && !Array.isArray(overlay[k])) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = "node";
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork) throw new Error("Network access disabled.");
      const fs = require("fs");
      return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") { code = src.value; }
      else if (src.type === "path") { code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value); }
      else { throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`); }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) { throw new Error(`Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch!`); }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
  cs.stage2.init(); // Auto-init Stage 2
})();

// --- STAGE 3: RUNTIME ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") { throw new Error("Stage 1/2 must be loaded."); }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) { if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) { try { console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args); } catch (e) {} } }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) { if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = []; Bus.listeners[event].push(fn); return () => Bus.off(event, fn); },
    off(event, fn) { if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return; Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn); },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) { try { fn(payload); } catch (err) { safeLog("Bus listener error:", err); } }
    }
  };
  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) { if (Commands.registry[name]) { safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`); } Commands.registry[name] = fn; return fn; },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };
  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) { safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`); clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler); }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try { Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() }); await fn(); } catch (err) { Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() }); }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };
  
  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => { return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config; });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => { cs.config[key] = value; return true; });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => { return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env; });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();

// --- V38 API COMMANDS ---
const cs = global.CommandStation;

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- V38 HTTP SERVER (CORS FIXED) ---
const PORT = $PORT;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1'; // Explicitly listen on localhost (IPv4)
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '$FrontendFile');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    // Set CORS headers
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html. Make sure it is in the same folder.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V38 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        // Execute via CommandStation
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V38 Ultimate Server (Monolithic) running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $ServerFile) -Value $ServerContent -Encoding UTF8

# --- 4. WRITE THE ULTIMATE FRONTEND ---
Write-Host "[2/3] Writing $FrontendFile..."
$FrontendContent = @"
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>PHOENIX V38 - Ultimate CommandStation</title>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; background: #121212; color: #EAEAEA; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
        header { background: #000; color: #00D8FF; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid #00D8FF; }
        .container { display: flex; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }
        #sidebar { width: 200px; background: #1E1E1E; border-right: 1px solid #333; padding: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        #sidebar h3 { margin-top: 0; color: #00D8FF; }
        #sidebar button { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #333; color: #EAEAEA; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
        #sidebar button:hover { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; }
        #agentList button { background: #2A2A2A; }
        #agentList button.active { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; font-weight: bold; }
        .content-area { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        #output { flex: 1; padding: 15px; overflow-y: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace; line-height: 1.6; }
        .msg { margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .msg-user { color: #00FF88; }
        .msg-agent { color: #FFA500; }
        .msg-system { color: #888; font-style: italic; }
        footer { border-top: 1px solid #333; background: #1E1E1E; padding: 10px 15px; display: flex; }
        #userInput { flex: 1; background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px; font-size: 1rem; }
        #sendButton { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; border: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <header>PHOENIX V38 - Ultimate CommandStation</header>
    <div class="container">
        <div id="sidebar">
            <h3>System Commands</h3>
            <button id="btn-flash-scan">Run FLASH Scan</button>
            <button id="btn-run-ps">Run PS Script (Test)</button>
            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">
            <h3>Agents</h3>
            <div id="agentList">
                <button class="tab active" data-agent="System">System Log</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Gemini">Gemini</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="GPT">GPT</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Claude">Claude</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Perplex">Perplex</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Grok">Grok</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="content-area">
            <div id="output"></div>
            <footer>
                <input id="userInput" type="text" placeholder="Enter command or message for active agent...">
                <button id="sendButton">Execute</button>
            </footer>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        const API_URL = 'http://localhost:$PORT';
        let activeAgent = "System";
        const chatHistory = {
            "System": [], "Gemini": [], "GPT": [], "Claude": [], "Perplex": [], "Grok": []
        };

        const output = document.getElementById('output');
        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
        const agentList = document.getElementById('agentList');
        const btnFlashScan = document.getElementById('btn-flash-scan');
        const btnRunPs = document.getElementById('btn-run-ps');

        function logMessage(message, type = "msg-system") {
            chatHistory[activeAgent].push({ type, message });
            const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
            msgDiv.className = `msg ${type}`;
            msgDiv.textContent = message;
            output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
        }

        function switchAgent(agentName) {
            activeAgent = agentName;
            agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
                tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.agent === agentName);
            });
            output.innerHTML = '';
            chatHistory[activeAgent].forEach(item => {
                const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
                msgDiv.className = `msg ${item.type}`;
                msgDiv.textContent = item.message;
                output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            });
            logMessage(`Active agent switched to ${agentName}.`, 'msg-system');
        }

        async function handleInput() {
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (!text) return;
            logMessage(`[User]: ${text}`, 'msg-user');
            input.value = '';

            try {
                let endpoint, result;
                if (activeAgent === "System") {
                    logMessage("System commands not yet implemented in UI. Use sidebar.", "msg-system");
                    return;
                } else {
                    endpoint = `${API_URL}/api/chat?agent=${activeAgent}&msg=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
                    const response = await fetch(endpoint);
                    result = await response.json();
                }

                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[${activeAgent}]: ${result.data}`, 'msg-agent');

            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SERVER ERROR]: ${err.message}`, 'msg-system');
            }
        }
        
        sendButton.addEventListener('click', handleInput);
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleInput();
        });

        agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchAgent(tab.dataset.agent));
        });

        btnFlashScan.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting FLASH scan...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/flash_scan`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2), "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SCAN ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        btnRunPs.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting PowerShell execution (TEST)...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/run_ps_script?script=test_script.ps1`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[POWERSHELL]:\n${result.data}`, "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[PS_SCRIPT ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        // Initial health check
        logMessage("PHOENIX V38 Ultimate Frontend Initialized.", "msg-system");
        fetch(`${API_URL}/health_check`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.success) {
                    logMessage("Server connection ESTABLISHED.", "msg-system");
                } else { throw new Error(data.error); }
            })
            .catch(err => logMessage(`[FATAL] Server connection FAILED: ${err.message}.`, "msg-system"));
    </script>
</body>
</html>

# =========================================================
# PHOENIX V39 - ULTIMATE MONOLITHIC SETUP (SYNTAX ERROR FIXED)
# =========================================================
# This script creates ONE server file (all DNA embedded) and
# ONE frontend file, then runs the server in this window.

# --- 1. CONFIGURATION ---
$RootDir = "C:\Users\mrmic\Desktop\NET-Ai-Eco-System-CommandStation"
$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $RootDir "scripts"
$ServerFile = "agent_server_V39.js"
$FrontendFile = "AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html"
$PORT = 4200

Write-Host "=== PHOENIX V39: MONOLITHIC SETUP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Target Directory: $RootDir"

# --- 2. CREATE DIRECTORIES ---

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ScriptsDir -Force | Out-Null

# --- 3. WRITE THE ULTIMATE (FIXED) MONOLITHIC NODE SERVER ---
Write-Host "[1/3] Writing $ServerFile (with all DNA embedded)..."
$ServerContent = @"
// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V39 - ULTIMATE AGENT SERVER (MONOLITHIC)
// =========================================================
// Contains Stage 1, 2, 3 DNA + API Server in one file.

const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- STAGE 1: BOOTSTRAPPER ---
(function () {
    const isNode = true;
    const CommandStation = {
        env: { mode: "development", platform: "node", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        config: { version: "1.0.0-STAGE1", initialized: true, allowDebug: true },
        log(msg, ...rest) { if (this.config.allowDebug) { console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest); } },
        stage2: { loaded: false, init: () => { throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet."); } },
        stage3: { loaded: false, init: () => { throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet."); } }
    };
    global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// --- STAGE 2: LOADER ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") { throw new Error("Stage 1 must be loaded."); }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode = true;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) { if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) { try { console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args); } catch (e) {} } }
  
  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
  }
  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (typeof base[k] === "object" && base[k] !== null && !Array.isArray(base[k]) && typeof overlay[k] === "object" && overlay[k] !== null && !Array.isArray(overlay[k])) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }
  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = "node";
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork) throw new Error("Network access disabled.");
      const fs = require("fs");
      return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") { code = src.value; }
      else if (src.type === "path") { code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value); }
      else {
        // --- THIS LINE IS FIXED ---
        throw new Error('Unknown stage3Source.type: ' + src.type);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) { throw new Error(`Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch!`); }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
  cs.stage2.init(); // Auto-init Stage 2
})();

// --- STAGE 3: RUNTIME ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") { throw new Error("Stage 1/2 must be loaded."); }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) { if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) { try { console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args); } catch (e) {} } }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) { if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = []; Bus.listeners[event].push(fn); return () => Bus.off(event, fn); },
    off(event, fn) { if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return; Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn); },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) { try { fn(payload); } catch (err) { safeLog("Bus listener error:", err); } }
    }
  };
  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) { if (Commands.registry[name]) { safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`); } Commands.registry[name] = fn; return fn; },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };
  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) { safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`); clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler); }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try { Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() }); await fn(); } catch (err) { Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() }); }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };
  
  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => { return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config; });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => { cs.config[key] = value; return true; });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => { return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env; });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();

// --- V39 API COMMANDS ---
const cs = global.CommandStation;

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- V39 HTTP SERVER (CORS FIXED) ---
const PORT = $PORT;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1'; // Explicitly listen on localhost (IPv4)
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '$FrontendFile');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    // Set CORS headers
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html. Make sure it is in the same folder.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V39 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        // Execute via CommandStation
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V39 Ultimate Server (Monolithic) running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $ServerFile) -Value $ServerContent -Encoding UTF8

# --- 4. WRITE THE ULTIMATE FRONTEND ---
Write-Host "[2/3] Writing $FrontendFile..."
$FrontendContent = @"
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>PHOENIX V39 - Ultimate CommandStation</title>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; background: #121212; color: #EAEAEA; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
        header { background: #000; color: #00D8FF; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid #00D8FF; }
        .container { display: flex; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }
        #sidebar { width: 200px; background: #1E1E1E; border-right: 1px solid #333; padding: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        #sidebar h3 { margin-top: 0; color: #00D8FF; }
        #sidebar button { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #333; color: #EAEAEA; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
        #sidebar button:hover { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; }
        #agentList button { background: #2A2A2A; }
        #agentList button.active { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; font-weight: bold; }
        .content-area { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        #output { flex: 1; padding: 15px; overflow-y: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace; line-height: 1.6; }
        .msg { margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .msg-user { color: #00FF88; }
        .msg-agent { color: #FFA500; }
        .msg-system { color: #888; font-style: italic; }
        footer { border-top: 1px solid #333; background: #1E1E1E; padding: 10px 15px; display: flex; }
        #userInput { flex: 1; background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px; font-size: 1rem; }
        #sendButton { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; border: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <header>PHOENIX V39 - Ultimate CommandStation</header>
    <div class="container">
        <div id="sidebar">
            <h3>System Commands</h3>
            <button id="btn-flash-scan">Run FLASH Scan</button>
            <button id="btn-run-ps">Run PS Script (Test)</button>
            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">
            <h3>Agents</h3>
            <div id="agentList">
                <button class="tab active" data-agent="System">System Log</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Gemini">Gemini</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="GPT">GPT</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Claude">Claude</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Perplex">Perplex</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Grok">Grok</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="content-area">
            <div id="output"></div>
            <footer>
                <input id="userInput" type="text" placeholder="Enter command or message for active agent...">
                <button id="sendButton">Execute</button>
            </footer>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
        const API_URL = 'http://localhost:$PORT';
        let activeAgent = "System";
        const chatHistory = {
            "System": [], "Gemini": [], "GPT": [], "Claude": [], "Perplex": [], "Grok": []
        };

        const output = document.getElementById('output');
        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
        const agentList = document.getElementById('agentList');
        const btnFlashScan = document.getElementById('btn-flash-scan');
        const btnRunPs = document.getElementById('btn-run-ps');

        function logMessage(message, type = "msg-system") {
            chatHistory[activeAgent].push({ type, message });

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage1_bootstrapper.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
    const isNode =
        typeof process !== "undefined" &&
        process.release &&
        process.release.name === "node";
    const CommandStation = {
        env: {
            mode: "development",
            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        config: {
            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",
            initialized: true,
            allowDebug: true
        },
        log(msg, ...rest) {
            if (this.config.allowDebug) {
                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);
            }
        },
        stage2: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");
            }
        },
        stage3: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");
            }
        }
    };
    if (isNode) {
        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    } else {
        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    }
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage2_loader.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 2.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode =
    typeof process !== "undefined" &&
    process.release &&
    process.release.name === "node";
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();

  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
    if (isNode) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";
      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {
        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");
        return Stage2;
      }
      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;
      Stage2.allowNetwork =
        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"
          ? options.allowNetwork
          : true;
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {
        try {
          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");
      return Stage2;
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)
        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");
      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);
      if (isNode && !isURL) {
        const fs = require("fs");
        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
      }
      const response = await fetch(ref);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);
      return await response.text();
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") {
        code = src.value;
      }
      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {
        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {
          throw new Error(
            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`
          );
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
})();

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage3_runtime.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];
      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);
      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);
    },
    off(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);
    },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {
        try {
          fn(payload);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) {
      if (Commands.registry[name]) {
        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);
      }
      Commands.registry[name] = fn;
      return fn;
    },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };

  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {
        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);
        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");

// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V40 - STABLE AGENT SERVER (server.js)
// =========================================================
// This server loads the DNA and hosts the frontend.

const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---
try {
    // Load the *separate* DNA file. This is cleaner.
    require('./commandstation_dna.js');
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load commandstation_dna.js.", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V40 Server is booting...");

// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); // Fake network delay
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1'; // Explicitly listen on localhost (IPv4)
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html. Make sure it is in the same folder.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V40 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        // Execute via CommandStation
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V40 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

<body>
    <header>PHOENIX V40 - Ultimate CommandStation</header>
    <div class="container">
        <div id="sidebar">
            <h3>System Commands</h3>

            <h3>Agents</h3>

                <button class="tab active" data-agent="System">System Log</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Gemini">Gemini</button>

        </div>
        <div class="content-area">
            <div id="output"></div>

            </footer>

    <script>
        const API_URL = 'http://localhost:4200';
        let activeAgent = "System";
        const chatHistory = {
            "System": [], "Gemini": [], "GPT": [], "Claude": [], "Perplex": [], "Grok": []
        };

        const output = document.getElementById('output');
        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
        const agentList = document.getElementById('agentList');
        const btnFlashScan = document.getElementById('btn-flash-scan');
        const btnRunPs = document.getElementById('btn-run-ps');

        function logMessage(message, type = "msg-system") {
            chatHistory[activeAgent].push({ type, message });
            const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
            msgDiv.className = `msg ${type}`;
            msgDiv.textContent = message;
            output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
        }

        function switchAgent(agentName) {
            activeAgent = agentName;
            agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
                tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.agent === agentName);
            });
            output.innerHTML = '';
            chatHistory[activeAgent].forEach(item => {
                const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
                msgDiv.className = `msg ${item.type}`;
                msgDiv.textContent = item.message;
                output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            });
            logMessage(`Active agent switched to ${agentName}.`, 'msg-system');
        }

        async function handleInput() {
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (!text) return;
            logMessage(`[User]: ${text}`, 'msg-user');
            input.value = '';

            try {
                let endpoint, result;
                if (activeAgent === "System") {
                    logMessage("System commands not yet implemented in UI. Use sidebar.", "msg-system");
                    return;
                } else {
                    endpoint = `${API_URL}/api/chat?agent=${activeAgent}&msg=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
                    const response = await fetch(endpoint);
                    result = await response.json();
                }

                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[${activeAgent}]: ${result.data}`, 'msg-agent');

            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SERVER ERROR]: ${err.message}`, 'msg-system');
            }
        }
        
        sendButton.addEventListener('click', handleInput);
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleInput();
        });

        agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchAgent(tab.dataset.agent));
        });

        btnFlashScan.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting FLASH scan...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/flash_scan`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2), "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SCAN ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        btnRunPs.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            logMessage("Requesting PowerShell execution (TEST)...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/run_ps_script?script=test_script.ps1`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[POWERSHELL]:\n${result.data}`, "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[PS_SCRIPT ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        // Initial health check
        logMessage("PHOENIX V40 Ultimate Frontend Initialized.", "msg-system");
        fetch(`${API_URL}/health_check`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.success) {
                    logMessage("Server connection ESTABLISHED.", "msg-system");
                } else { throw new Error(data.error); }
            })
            .catch(err => logMessage(`[FATAL] Server connection FAILED: ${err.message}.`, "msg-system"));
    </script>
</body>

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage1_bootstrapper.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
    const isNode =
        typeof process !== "undefined" &&
        process.release &&
        process.release.name === "node";
    const CommandStation = {
        env: {
            mode: "development",
            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        config: {
            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",
            initialized: true,
            allowDebug: true
        },
        log(msg, ...rest) {
            if (this.config.allowDebug) {
                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);
            }
        },
        stage2: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");
            }
        },
        stage3: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");
            }
        }
    };
    if (isNode) {
        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    } else {
        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    }
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage2_loader.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 2.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode =
    typeof process !== "undefined" &&
    process.release &&
    process.release.name === "node";
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();

  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
    if (isNode) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";
      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {
        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");
        return Stage2;
      }
      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;
      Stage2.allowNetwork =
        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"
          ? options.allowNetwork
          : true;
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {
        try {
          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");
      return Stage2;
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)
        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");
      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);
      if (isNode && !isURL) {
        const fs = require("fs");
        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
      }
      const response = await fetch(ref);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);
      return await response.text();
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") {
        code = src.value;
      }
      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {
        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {
          throw new Error(
            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`
          );
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
})();

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage3_runtime.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];
      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);
      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);
    },
    off(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);
    },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {
        try {
          fn(payload);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) {
      if (Commands.registry[name]) {
        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);
      }
      Commands.registry[name] = fn;
      return fn;
    },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };

  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {
        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);
        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);

        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
