// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html. Make sure it is in the same folder.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V40 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        // Execute via CommandStation
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {

const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');

// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); // Fake network delay
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = $PORT;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1'; // Explicitly listen on localhost (IPv4)
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '$FrontendFile');

    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html. Make sure it is in the same folder.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V40 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        // Execute via CommandStation
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);

### Solution 1: API Input Sanitization

```javascript

// File: middleware/sanitizer.js

const sanitizeInput = (req, res, next) => {

  try {

    // Sanitize query parameters

    if (req.query.msg) {

      req.query.msg = req.query.msg

        .toString()

        .trim()

        .replace(/[<>\"\']/g, '') // Remove HTML/script tags

        .substring(0, 1000); // Limit length

    }

    if (req.query.agent) {

      req.query.agent = req.query.agent

        .toString()

        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '')

        .substring(0, 50);

    }

    

    // Sanitize URL path to prevent directory traversal

    if (req.params.file) {

      req.params.file = req.params.file.replace(/\.\./g, '');

    }

    

    next();

  } catch (error) {

    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid input parameters' }));

  }

};



// In server.js - Apply globally

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {

  // Create fake request context for middleware

  const reqContext = { query: {}, params: {} };

  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:4200`);

  url.searchParams.forEach((value, key) => {

    reqContext.query[key] = value;

  });

  

  sanitizeInput(reqContext, res, () => {

    req.query = reqContext.query;

    // Continue with normal request handling

  });

});

```

    $BackupRoot = $Config.backupRoot

}

function Invoke-RestMethodWithRetry {

    param(

        [string]$Uri,

        [int]$TimeoutSec = 5,

        [int]$MaxRetries = 3

    )

    

    for ($i = 1; $i -le $MaxRetries; $i++) {

        try {

            $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $Uri `

                -TimeoutSec $TimeoutSec `

                -ErrorAction Stop

            return $response

        } catch {

            Write-Host "[!] Attempt $i/$MaxRetries failed: $_"

            if ($i -eq $MaxRetries) {

                throw "Failed to connect after $MaxRetries attempts"

            }

            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

        }

    }

}



# Usage

$healthCheck = Invoke-RestMethodWithRetry -Uri "http://localhost:$PORT/health_check"

### Solution 7: CORS Origin Validation

```javascript

// File: middleware/cors.js

const allowedOrigins = [

  'http://localhost:4200',

  'http://127.0.0.1:4200',

  'file://', // For local HTML files

  'null' // For file:// protocol

];



function setCorsHeaders(req, res) {

  const origin = req.headers.origin || req.headers.referer || 'null';

  

  // Check if origin is allowed

  const isAllowed = allowedOrigins.some(allowed => {

    if (allowed === 'file://' && origin.startsWith('file://')) return true;

    return origin === allowed || origin.startsWith(allowed);

  });

  

  if (isAllowed) {

    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);

  } else {

    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', 'null');

  }

  

  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');

  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'true');

  

  // Handle preflight

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {

    res.writeHead(204);

    res.end();

    return true; // Indicates preflight handled

  }

  

  return false;

}



// In server.js

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {

  if (setCorsHeaders(req, res)) return; // Preflight handled

  // ... rest of request handling

});

```

// File: utils/hash-verifier.js

const fs = require('fs');

const { execSync } = require('child_process');



function verifyHashFile(hashFile) {

  const signatureFile = `${hashFile}.asc`;

  

  if (!fs.existsSync(signatureFile)) {

    throw new Error(`Signature file not found: ${signatureFile}`);

  }

  

  try {

    execSync(`gpg --verify ${signatureFile} ${hashFile}`, {

      stdio: 'pipe'

    });

    console.log('✅ Hash file signature valid');

    return true;

  } catch (error) {

    console.error('❌ Hash file signature INVALID or GPG not installed');

    throw new Error('Hash verification failed');

  }

}



module.exports = { verifyHashFile };

# File: PHOENIX_V39_Setup.ps1

function Wait-ForServerReady {

    param(

        [string]$Url,

        [int]$MaxAttempts = 30,

        [int]$DelaySeconds = 1

    )

    

    Write-Host "[*] Waiting for server at $Url..."

    

    for ($i = 1; $i -le $MaxAttempts; $i++) {

        try {

            $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $Url -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction Stop

            if ($response.success -or $response.status -eq "ok") {

                Write-Host "✅ Server is ready! (Attempt $i)"

                return $true

            }

        } catch {

            Write-Host "." -NoNewline

        }

        Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds

    }

    

    Write-Host ""

    Write-Host "❌ Server did not respond after $MaxAttempts attempts"

    return $false

}



# Usage

    Write-Host "[*] Proceeding with operations..."

} else {

}

### Solution 12: Incremental Backup Strategy

```powershell

# File: scripts/smart-backup.ps1

param(

    [string]$SourceDir = ".",

    [string]$BackupRoot = "C:\Backups\PHOENIX",

    [switch]$Incremental

)



$timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd_HHmmss"

$BackupDir = Join-Path $BackupRoot "Backup_$timestamp"



# Ensure backup directory exists

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null



# Excluded patterns

$excludePatterns = @(

    "node_modules",

    "*.log",

    "*.pid",

    ".git",

    "Backups",

    "db.json"

)



Write-Host "[*] Creating backup: $BackupDir"



if ($Incremental) {

    # Find the last backup

    $lastBackup = Get-ChildItem -Path $BackupRoot -Directory | 

        Sort-Object Name -Descending | 

        Select-Object -First 1

    

    if ($lastBackup) {

        Write-Host "[*] Incremental backup from: $($lastBackup.Name)"

        

        # Use Robocopy for incremental backup (much faster)

        $excludeArgs = $excludePatterns | ForEach-Object { "/XD $_" }

        robocopy $SourceDir $BackupDir /MIR /XO /R:2 /W:1 $excludeArgs /LOG:"$BackupDir\backup.log"

    }

} else {

    # Full backup

    Get-ChildItem -Path $SourceDir -Recurse | ForEach-Object {

        $shouldExclude = $false

        foreach ($pattern in $excludePatterns) {

            if ($_.FullName -like "*$pattern*") {

                $shouldExclude = $true

                break

            }

        }

        

        if (-not $shouldExclude) {

            $relativePath = $_.FullName.Substring($SourceDir.Length)

            $destPath = Join-Path $BackupDir $relativePath

            

            if ($_.PSIsContainer) {

                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destPath -Force | Out-Null

            } else {

                Copy-Item -Path $_.FullName -Destination $destPath -Force

            }

        }

    }

}



Write-Host "✅ Backup complete: $BackupDir"



# Clean up old backups (keep last 10)

$allBackups = Get-ChildItem -Path $BackupRoot -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending

if ($allBackups.Count -gt 10) {

    $allBackups | Select-Object -Skip 10 | ForEach-Object {

        Write-Host "[*] Removing old backup: $($_.Name)"

        Remove-Item -Path $_.FullName -Recurse -Force

    }

}

```



### Solution 13: Persistent Chat History with LowDB

```javascript

// File: db/chatHistory.js

// npm install lowdb@3.0.0



const { Low } = require('lowdb');

const { JSONFile } = require('lowdb/node');

const path = require('path');



class ChatHistoryDB {

  constructor(dbPath = './data/chatHistory.json') {

    this.dbPath = dbPath;

    this.db = null;

  }

  

  async init() {

    // Ensure data directory exists

    const dir = path.dirname(this.dbPath);

    const fs = require('fs');

    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {

      fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });

    }

    

    const adapter = new JSONFile(this.dbPath);

    this.db = new Low(adapter, { chatHistory: {} });

    

    await this.db.read();

    

    // Initialize structure if empty

    this.db.data = this.db.data || { chatHistory: {} };

    

    console.log(`[DB] Chat history loaded from ${this.dbPath}`);

  }

  

  async addMessage(agent, role, content) {

    if (!this.db.data.chatHistory[agent]) {

      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = [];

    }

    

    this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].push({

      role,

      content,

      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

    });

    

    // Limit history per agent to 100 messages

    if (this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].length > 100) {

      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = this.db.data.chatHistory[agent].slice(-100);

    }

    

    await this.db.write();

  }

  

  async getHistory(agent, limit = null) {

    const history = this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] || [];

    return limit ? history.slice(-limit) : history;

  }

  

  async clearHistory(agent) {

    if (agent) {

      this.db.data.chatHistory[agent] = [];

    } else {

      this.db.data.chatHistory = {};

    }

    await this.db.write();

  }

  

  async getAllAgents() {

    return Object.keys(this.db.data.chatHistory);

  }

}



module.exports = ChatHistoryDB;



// Usage in server.js

const ChatHistoryDB = require('./db/chatHistory');

const chatDB = new ChatHistoryDB();



(async () => {

  await chatDB.init();

  

  // In API handlers:

  // await chatDB.addMessage('agent1', 'user', 'Hello');

  // const history = await chatDB.getHistory('agent1', 10);

})();

```



### Solution 14: Optimized Hash Verification

```powershell

# File: scripts/verify-hashes.ps1

param(

    [string]$HashFile = "MASTER_HASHES.csv",

    [string]$BatchFolder = ".\MASTER_BATCHES"

)



Write-Host "[*] Loading hash database..."



# Load all hashes into memory once

$hashDatabase = @{}

Import-Csv $HashFile | ForEach-Object {

    $hashDatabase[$_.FileName] = $_.Hash

}



Write-Host "[*] Verifying $($hashDatabase.Count) files..."



$failures = @()

$verified = 0



Get-ChildItem -Path $BatchFolder -Filter "*.txt" | ForEach-Object {

    $expectedHash = $hashDatabase[$_.Name]

    

    if ($null -eq $expectedHash) {

        $failures += "Missing hash for: $($_.Name)"

        return

    }

    

    $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Path $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash

    

    if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) {

        $failures += "Hash mismatch: $($_.Name)"

    } else {

        $verified++

    }

}



Write-Host "✅ Verified: $verified files"



if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {

    Write-Host "❌ Failures: $($failures.Count)"

    $failures | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "   $_" }

    exit 1

}

```



### Solution 15: Paginated History Endpoint

```javascript

// File: routes/history.js

async function handleHistoryRequest(req, res, chatDB) {

  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost`);

  const agent = url.searchParams.get('agent');

  const limit = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('limit')) || 50;

  const offset = parseInt(url.searchParams.get('offset')) || 0;

  

  if (!agent) {

    res.writeHead(400, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Agent parameter required' }));

    return;

  }

  

  try {

    const fullHistory = await chatDB.getHistory(agent);

    const total = fullHistory.length;

    const paginatedHistory = fullHistory.slice(offset, offset + limit);

    

    res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

    res.end(JSON.stringify({

      agent,

      messages: paginatedHistory,

      pagination: {

        total,

        limit,

        offset,

        hasMore: (offset + limit) < total

      }

    }));

  } catch (error) {

    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

    res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Failed to retrieve history' }));

  }

}



module.exports = { handleHistoryRequest };

```

// File: routes/analysis.js

const { Worker } = require('worker_threads');

const path = require('path');



async function runProAnalysis(data) {

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

    const worker = new Worker(

      path.join(__dirname, '../workers/pro-analysis-worker.js'),

      { workerData: data }

    );

    

    worker.on('message', resolve);

    worker.on('error', reject);

    worker.on('exit', (code) => {

      if (code !== 0) {

        reject(new Error(`Worker stopped with exit code ${code}`));

      }

    });

    

    // Timeout after 30 seconds

    setTimeout(() => {

      worker.terminate();

      reject(new Error('Analysis timeout'));

    }, 30000);

  });

}



module.exports = { runProAnalysis };

```

    [string]$ServerUrl = "http://localhost:4200",

    [switch]$Wait

)



function Start-AsyncScan {

    param([string]$ScanType, [string]$Url)

    

    $job = Start-Job -ScriptBlock {

        param($type, $url)

        try {

            $result = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$url/api/$type" -TimeoutSec 60

            return @{ Success = $true; Type = $type; Result = $result }

        } catch {

            return @{ Success = $false; Type = $type; Error = $_.Exception.Message }

        }

    } -ArgumentList $ScanType, $Url

    

    return $job

if ($Wait) {

    Write-Host "[*] Waiting for scans to complete..."

    

    $flashResult = Receive-Job -Job $flashJob -Wait

    $proResult = Receive-Job -Job $proJob -Wait

    

    Remove-Job -Job $flashJob, $proJob

    

    Write-Host "✅ FLASH Scan: $(if($flashResult.Success){'Success'}else{'Failed'})"

    Write-Host "✅ PRO Analysis: $(if($proResult.Success){'Success'}else{'Failed'})"

    

    return @($flashResult, $proResult)

} else {

### Solution 19: Cached Asset List

```javascript

// File: cache/assetCache.js

class AssetCache {

  constructor(ttlSeconds = 300) {

    this.cache = null;

    this.lastUpdate = null;

    this.ttl = ttlSeconds * 1000; // Convert to milliseconds

  }

  

  isValid() {

    if (!this.cache || !this.lastUpdate) return false;

    return (Date.now() - this.lastUpdate) < this.ttl;

  }

  

  get(runtime) {

    if (this.isValid()) {

      return this.cache;

    }

    

    // Refresh cache

    this.cache = Object.keys(runtime.getAssetList());

    this.lastUpdate = Date.now();

    console.log(`[CACHE] Asset list refreshed (${this.cache.length} assets)`);

    

    return this.cache;

  }

  

  invalidate() {

    this.cache = null;

    this.lastUpdate = null;

  }

}



module.exports = AssetCache;



// Usage in server.js

const AssetCache = require('./cache/assetCache');

const assetCache = new AssetCache(300); // 5 minute TTL



// In /assets endpoint

if (url.pathname === '/assets') {

  const assets = assetCache.get(cs.runtime);

  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

  res.end(JSON.stringify({ assets, cached: true }));

  return;

}

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage1_bootstrapper.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
    const isNode =
        typeof process !== "undefined" &&
        process.release &&
        process.release.name === "node";
    const CommandStation = {
        env: {
            mode: "development",
            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        config: {
            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",
            initialized: true,
            allowDebug: true
        },
        log(msg, ...rest) {
            if (this.config.allowDebug) {
                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);
            }
        },
        stage2: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");
            }
        },
        stage3: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");
            }
        }
    };
    if (isNode) {
        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    } else {
        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    }
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage2_loader.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 2.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode =
    typeof process !== "undefined" &&
    process.release &&
    process.release.name === "node";
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();

  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
    if (isNode) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";
      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {
        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");
        return Stage2;
      }
      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;
      Stage2.allowNetwork =
        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"
          ? options.allowNetwork
          : true;
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {
        try {
          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");
      return Stage2;
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)
        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");
      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);
      if (isNode && !isURL) {
        const fs = require("fs");
        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
      }
      const response = await fetch(ref);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);
      return await response.text();
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") {
        code = src.value;
      }
      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {
        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {
          throw new Error(
            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`
          );
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
})();

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage3_runtime.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];
      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);
      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);
    },
    off(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);
    },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {
        try {
          fn(payload);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) {
      if (Commands.registry[name]) {
        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);
      }
      Commands.registry[name] = fn;
      return fn;
    },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };

  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {
        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);
        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {

            { file: "MASTER_LOG_14.txt", line: 102, finding: "'fs.writeFileSync' call" }
        ]
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        // --- 1. SERVE THE FRONTEND HTML ---
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html. Make sure it is in the same folder.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        // --- 2. HANDLE API ROUTES ---
        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V40 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        // Execute via CommandStation
        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V40 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

(function () {
    const isNode =
        typeof process !== "undefined" &&
        process.release &&
        process.release.name === "node";
    const CommandStation = {
        env: {
            mode: "development",
            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        config: {
            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",
            initialized: true,
            allowDebug: true
        },
        log(msg, ...rest) {
            if (this.config.allowDebug) {
                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);
            }
        },
        stage2: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");
            }
        },
        stage3: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");
            }
        }
    };
    if (isNode) {
        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    } else {
        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    }
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

(function () {

      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";
      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {
        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");
        return Stage2;
      }
      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;
      Stage2.allowNetwork =
        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"
          ? options.allowNetwork
          : true;
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {
        try {
          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");
      return Stage2;
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)
        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");
      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);
      if (isNode && !isURL) {
        const fs = require("fs");
        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
      }
      const response = await fetch(ref);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);
      return await response.text();
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") {
        code = src.value;
      }
      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {
        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);
      } else {
        // --- THIS LINE IS FIXED ---
        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {
          // --- THIS LINE IS FIXED ---
          throw new Error(
            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`
          );
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
})();

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (stage3_runtime.js)
// =======================================
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];
      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);
      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);
    },
    off(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);
    },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {
        try {
          fn(payload);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) {
      if (Commands.registry[name]) {
        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);
      }
      Commands.registry[name] = fn;
      return fn;
    },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };

  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {
        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);
        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();

      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

    require('./commandstation_dna.js');
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load commandstation_dna.js.", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V40 Server is booting...");

// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        let command, args;
        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V40 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V40 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (V42 - SYNTAX FIXED)
// =======================================

// --- STAGE 1: BOOTSTRAPPER ---
(function () {
    const isNode =
        typeof process !== "undefined" &&
        process.release &&
        process.release.name === "node";
    const CommandStation = {
        env: {
            mode: "development",
            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        config: {
            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",
            initialized: true,
            allowDebug: true
        },
        log(msg, ...rest) {
            if (this.config.allowDebug) {
                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);
            }
        },
        stage2: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");
            }
        },
        stage3: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");
            }
        }
    };
    if (isNode) {
        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    } else {
        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    }
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// --- STAGE 2: LOADER ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 2.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode =
    typeof process !== "undefined" &&
    process.release &&
    process.release.name === "node";
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();

  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
    if (isNode) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      // Browser crypto logic (from log)
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";
      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {
        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");
        return Stage2;
      }
      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;
      Stage2.allowNetwork =
        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"
          ? options.allowNetwork
          : true;
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {
        try {
          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");
      return Stage2;
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)
        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");
      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);
      if (isNode && !isURL) {
        const fs = require("fs");
        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
      }
      // Assuming 'fetch' is available in Node.js v22
      const response = await fetch(ref); 
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);
      return await response.text();
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") {
        code = src.value;
      }
      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {
        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);
      } else {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        // Added backticks (`) for proper string interpolation
        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {
          // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
          // Added backticks (`) for proper string interpolation
          throw new Error(
            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`
          );
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
})();

// --- STAGE 3: RUNTIME ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];
      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);
      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);
    },
    off(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);
    },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {
        try {
          fn(payload);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) {
      if (Commands.registry[name]) {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);
      }
      Commands.registry[name] = fn;
      return fn;
    },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };

  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);
        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();
2. The Server File: server.js

JavaScript
// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V40 - STABLE AGENT SERVER (server.js)
// =========================================================
const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---
try {
    require('./commandstation_dna.js');
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load commandstation_dna.js.", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V40 Server is booting...");

// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        let command, args;
        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V40 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V40 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V40 - STABLE AGENT SERVER (server.js)
// =========================================================
const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---
try {
    require('./commandstation_dna.js');
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load commandstation_dna.js.", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V40 Server is booting...");

// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        let command, args;
        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V40 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V40 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        let command, args;
        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V40 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V40 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

# =========================================================
# PHOENIX V50 - ULTIMATE STABLE SETUP SCRIPT
# =========================================================
# This script creates THREE separate, clean files (DNA, Server, Frontend)
# to prevent all syntax errors and connection failures.

# --- 1. CONFIGURATION ---
$RootDir = "C:\Users\mrmic\Desktop\NET-Ai-Eco-System-CommandStation"
$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $RootDir "scripts"
$DnaFile = "commandstation_dna_V50.js"

# --- 2. CREATE DIRECTORIES ---
