$DnaContent = @"
// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (V50 - SYNTAX FIXED)
// =======================================

// --- STAGE 1: BOOTSTRAPPER ---
(function () {
    const isNode =
        typeof process !== "undefined" &&
        process.release &&
        process.release.name === "node";
    const CommandStation = {
        env: {
            mode: "development",
            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        config: {
            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",
            initialized: true,
            allowDebug: true
        },
        log(msg, ...rest) {
            if (this.config.allowDebug) {
                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);
            }
        },
        stage2: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");
            }
        },
        stage3: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");
            }
        }
    };
    if (isNode) {
        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    } else {
        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    }
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// --- STAGE 2: LOADER ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 2.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode =
    typeof process !== "undefined" &&
    process.release &&
    process.release.name === "node";
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();

  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
    if (isNode) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      // Browser crypto logic (from log)
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";
      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {
        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");
        return Stage2;
      }
      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;
      Stage2.allowNetwork =
        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"
          ? options.allowNetwork
          : true;
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {
        try {
          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");
      return Stage2;
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)
        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");
      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);
      if (isNode && !isURL) {
        const fs = require("fs");
        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
      }
      // Assuming 'fetch' is available in Node.js v22
      const response = await fetch(ref); 
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);
      return await response.text();
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") {
        code = src.value;
      }
      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {
        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);
      } else {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        // Added backticks (`) for proper string interpolation
        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {
          // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
          // Added backticks (`) for proper string interpolation
          throw new Error(
            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`
          );
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
})();

// --- STAGE 3: RUNTIME ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];
      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);
      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);
    },
    off(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);
    },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {
        try {
          fn(payload);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) {
      if (Commands.registry[name]) {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);
      }
      Commands.registry[name] = fn;
      return fn;
    },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };

  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);
        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $DnaFile) -Value $DnaContent -Encoding UTF8

# --- 4. WRITE THE (CLEAN) NODE SERVER ---
Write-Host "[2/4] Writing $ServerFile..."
$ServerContent = @"
// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V50 - STABLE AGENT SERVER (server.js)
// =========================================================
const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---
try {
    require('./commandstation_dna_V50.js');
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load commandstation_dna_V50.js.", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V50 Server is booting...");

// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = $PORT;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '$FrontendFile');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA_V50.html.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        let command, args;
        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V50 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V50 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $ServerFile) -Value $ServerContent -Encoding UTF8

# --- 5. WRITE THE ULTIMATE FRONTEND (with Audit Tracker) ---
Write-Host "[3/4] Writing $FrontendFile..."
$FrontendContent = @"
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>PHOENIX V50 - Ultimate CommandStation</title>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; background: #121212; color: #EAEAEA; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
        header { background: #000; color: #00D8FF; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid #00D8FF; }
        .container { display: flex; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }
        #sidebar { width: 200px; background: #1E1E1E; border-right: 1px solid #333; padding: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow-y: auto; }
        #sidebar h3 { margin-top: 0; color: #00D8FF; }
        #sidebar button { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #333; color: #EAEAEA; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
        #sidebar button:hover { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; }
        #agentList button { background: #2A2A2A; }
        #agentList button.active, #sidebar button.tab-view.active { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; font-weight: bold; }
        .content-area { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        .view { flex: 1; display: none; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
        .view.active { display: flex; }
        #output { flex: 1; padding: 15px; overflow-y: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace; line-height: 1.6; }
        .msg { margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .msg-user { color: #00FF88; }
        .msg-agent { color: #FFA500; }
        .msg-system { color: #888; font-style: italic; }
        footer { border-top: 1px solid #333; background: #1E1E1E; padding: 10px 15px; display: flex; }
        #userInput { flex: 1; background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px; font-size: 1rem; }
        #sendButton { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; border: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
        /* Audit Tracker Styles */
        #audit-tracker { padding: 15px; overflow-y: auto; }
        #audit-tracker table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }

        #audit-tracker select { background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #555; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <header>PHOENIX V50 - Ultimate CommandStation</header>
    <div class="container">
        <div id="sidebar">
            <h3>System Commands</h3>
            <button id="btn-flash-scan">Run FLASH Scan</button>
            <button id="btn-run-ps">Run PS Script (Test)</button>
            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">
            <h3>Agents</h3>
            <div id="agentList">
                <button class="tab active" data-agent="System">System Log</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Gemini">Gemini</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="GPT">GPT</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Claude">Claude</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Perplex">Perplex</button>
                <button class="tab" data-agent="Grok">Grok</button>
            </div>
            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">
            <h3>Dashboard</h3>
            <button id="btn-main-chat" class="tab-view active" data-view="main-chat-view">Main Chat</button>
            <button id="btn-audit-tracker" class="tab-view" data-view="audit-tracker-view">Audit Tracker</button>
        </div>

        <div class="content-area">
            <div id="main-chat-view" class="view active">
                <div id="output"></div>
                <footer>
                    <input id="userInput" type="text" placeholder="Enter command or message for active agent...">
                    <button id="sendButton">Execute</button>
                </footer>
            </div>
            <div id="audit-tracker-view" class="view">
                <div id="audit-tracker">
                    <h2>PHOENIX V35.5 - 50-Point Audit Tracker</h2>
                    <table>
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th>ID</th>
                                <th>Finding</th>
                                <th>Category</th>
                                <th>Status</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody id="audit-tbody">
                            </tbody>
                    </table>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // --- CONFIG ---
        const API_URL = 'http://localhost:$PORT';
        
        // --- 50-POINT AUDIT DATA (from Claude/Gemini) ---
        const PHOENIX_TOP_50_SOLUTIONS = [
            { "id": 1, "finding": "API endpoints lack input sanitization.", "category": "Security" },
            { "id": 2, "finding": "Git repo URL is hardcoded in PowerShell script.", "category": "Security" },
            { "id": 3, "finding": "Node server is running with 'node' command, no process manager.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 4, "finding": "PowerShell 'Invoke-RestMethod' does not have a timeout.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 5, "finding": "Dependencies are not audited.", "category": "Security" },
            { "id": 6, "finding": "Server port '4200' is hardcoded.", "category": "Config" },
            { "id": 7, "finding": "No 'Origin' check on API endpoints.", "category": "Security" },
            { "id": 8, "finding": "PowerShell 'Start-Process' for Node server is fire-and-forget.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 9, "finding": "MASTER_HASHES file is a single point of failure.", "category": "Security" },
            { "id": 10, "finding": "HTTP server is used, not HTTPS.", "category": "Security" },
            { "id": 11, "finding": "PowerShell script waits a static 5 seconds ('Start-Sleep -Seconds 5').", "category": "Performance" },
            { "id": 12, "finding": "Full 'Copy-Item' for backup is slow.", "category": "Performance" },
            { "id": 13, "finding": "'chatHistory' is an in-memory array.", "category": "Architecture" },
            { "id": 14, "finding": "Inefficient PowerShell hash loop.", "category": "Performance" },
            { "id": 15, "finding": "'/history' endpoint sends the entire chat history every time.", "category": "Performance" },
            { "id": 16, "finding": "Node server is single-threaded.", "category": "Performance" },
            { "id": 17, "finding": "PowerShell 'git add .' stages all files, including backups and logs.", "category": "VCS" },
            { "id": 18, "finding": "FLASH/PRO scans are synchronous 'Invoke-RestMethod' calls.", "category": "Performance" },
            { "id": 19, "finding": "Asset list is regenerated on every request to '/assets'.", "category": "Performance" },
            { "id": 20, "finding": "'gemini_pro_audit.js' writes the 50-point JSON file synchronously.", "category": "Performance" },
            { "id": 21, "finding": "No 'try/catch' in 'http.createServer' request handler.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 22, "finding": "PowerShell script does not check if 'node' command succeeded.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 23, "finding": "'requestJSON' function rejects on JSON.parse error.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 24, "finding": "PowerShell 'git push --force' is dangerous.", "category": "VCS" },
            { "id": 25, "finding": "Hash mismatch in PowerShell script only writes an error, it doesn't stop.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 26, "finding": "No 'server.on('error', ...)' handler for the Node.js server.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 27, "finding": "PowerShell 'Copy-Item' does not check if '$BackupRoot' exists.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 28, "finding": "No 404 handler for '/send' if 'msg' parameter is missing.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 29, "finding": "Git commands assume 'git' is in the system PATH.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 30, "finding": "Backup operation (Copy-Item) is not in a 'try/catch' block.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 31, "finding": "Node server 'console.log' is unstructured.", "category": "Logging" },
            { "id": 32, "finding": "No '/health' endpoint for monitoring.", "category": "Logging" },
            { "id": 33, "finding": "PowerShell 'Write-Host' logs are ephemeral.", "category": "Logging" },
            { "id": 34, "finding": "Node server doesn't log incoming requests.", "category": "Logging" },
            { "id": 35, "finding": "'FINAL_MAJOR_CONTRIBUTION.json' is overwritten on each run.", "category": "Logging" },
            { "id": 36, "finding": "No central configuration for file paths.", "category": "Config" },
            { "id": 37, "finding": "Error messages from Node server are generic.", "category": "Logging" },
            { "id": 38, "finding": "No log rotation for 'MASTER_LOG_*.txt' files.", "category": "Logging" },
            { "id": 39, "finding": "Git commit message is generic.", "category": "VCS" },
            { "id": 40, "finding": "No metrics endpoint.", "category": "Logging" },
            { "id": 41, "finding": "The system relies on 'fs.existsSync'.", "category": "Architecture" },
            { "id": 42, "finding": "No 'main' branch in Git logic.", "category": "VCS" },
            { "id": 43, "finding": "PHOENIX runtime is imported with a hardcoded, versioned path.", "category": "Architecture" },
            { "id": 44, "finding": "PowerShell script has no parameters.", "category": "Architecture" },
            { "id": 45, "finding": "No unit tests for Node.js server logic.", "category": "Reliability" },
            { "id": 46, "finding": "PowerShell script requires manual execution.", "category": "DevOps" },
            { "id": 47, "finding": "No linter for JavaScript or PowerShell.", "category": "DevOps" },
            { "id": 48, "finding": "No 'package.json' 'scripts' section.", "category": "DevOps" },
            { "id": 49, "finding": "'gemini_pro_audit.js' hardcodes 'localhost:4200'.", "category": "Config" },
            { "id": 50, "finding": "Entire system is in one massive Node.js file.", "category": "Architecture" }
        ];

        // --- STATE ---
        let activeAgent = "System";
        const chatHistory = {
            "System": [], "Gemini": [], "GPT": [], "Claude": [], "Perplex": [], "Grok": []
        };

        // --- DOM ELEMENTS ---
        const output = document.getElementById('output');
        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');
        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');
        const agentList = document.getElementById('agentList');
        const btnFlashScan = document.getElementById('btn-flash-scan');
        const btnRunPs = document.getElementById('btn-run-ps');
        const btnMainChat = document.getElementById('btn-main-chat');
        const btnAuditTracker = document.getElementById('btn-audit-tracker');
        const mainChatView = document.getElementById('main-chat-view');
        const auditTrackerView = document.getElementById('audit-tracker-view');
        const auditTbody = document.getElementById('audit-tbody');

        // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---
        function logMessage(message, type = "msg-system") {
            chatHistory[activeAgent].push({ type, message });
            const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
            msgDiv.className = `msg ${type}`;
            msgDiv.textContent = message;
            output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
        }

        function switchAgent(agentName) {
            activeAgent = agentName;
            agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
                tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.agent === agentName);
            });
            output.innerHTML = '';
            chatHistory[activeAgent].forEach(item => {
                const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
                msgDiv.className = `msg ${item.type}`;
                msgDiv.textContent = item.message;
                output.appendChild(msgDiv);
            });
            logMessage(`Active agent switched to ${agentName}.`, 'msg-system');
        }

        function switchView(viewId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.style.display = 'none');
            document.getElementById(viewId).style.display = 'flex';
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-view').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.view === viewId);
            });
        }

        async function handleInput() {
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (!text) return;
            logMessage(`[User]: ${text}`, 'msg-user');
            input.value = '';
            try {
                let endpoint, result;
                if (activeAgent === "System") {
                    logMessage("System commands are run from the sidebar.", "msg-system");
                    return;
                } else {
                    endpoint = `${API_URL}/api/chat?agent=${activeAgent}&msg=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
                    const response = await fetch(endpoint);
                    result = await response.json();
                }
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[${activeAgent}]: ${result.data}`, 'msg-agent');
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SERVER ERROR]: ${err.message}`, 'msg-system');
            }
        }
        
        // --- AUDIT TRACKER FUNCTIONS ---
        function loadAuditTracker() {
            auditTbody.innerHTML = '';
            PHOENIX_TOP_50_SOLUTIONS.forEach(item => {
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                row.innerHTML = `
                    <td>${item.id}</td>
                    <td>${item.finding}</td>
                    <td>${item.category || 'N/A'}</td>
                    <td>
                        <select data-id="${item.id}">
                            <option value="Pending">Pending</option>
                            <option value="In Progress">In Progress</option>
                            <option value="Fixed">Fixed</option>
                            <option value="Skipped">Skipped</option>
                        </select>
                    </td>
                `;
                auditTbody.appendChild(row);
            });
        }

        // --- EVENT LISTENERS ---
        sendButton.addEventListener('click', handleInput);
        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleInput();
        });

        agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
            tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchAgent(tab.dataset.agent));
        });

        // View switching
        btnMainChat.addEventListener('click', () => switchView('main-chat-view'));
        btnAuditTracker.addEventListener('click', () => switchView('audit-tracker-view'));

        // System Commands
        btnFlashScan.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            switchView('main-chat-view');
            logMessage("Requesting FLASH scan...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/flash_scan`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2), "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[SCAN ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        btnRunPs.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            switchAgent("System");
            switchView('main-chat-view');
            logMessage("Requesting PowerShell execution (TEST)...", "msg-system");
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/run_ps_script?script=test_script.ps1`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);
                logMessage(`[POWERSHELL]:\n${result.data}`, "msg-system");
            } catch (err) {
                logMessage(`[PS_SCRIPT ERROR]: ${err.message}`, "msg-system");
            }
        });

        // --- INITIALIZATION ---
        logMessage("PHOENIX V50 Ultimate Frontend Initialized.", "msg-system");
        loadAuditTracker(); // Load the audit tracker data
        
        // Initial health check
        fetch(`${API_URL}/health_check`)
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => {
                if(data.success) {
                    logMessage("Server connection ESTABLISHED.", "msg-system");
                } else { throw new Error(data.error); }
            })
            .catch(err => logMessage(`[FATAL] Server connection FAILED: ${err.message}.`, "msg-system"));
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"@
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $FrontendFile) -Value $FrontendContent -Encoding UTF8

# --- 6. START THE SERVER & OPEN BROWSER ---
Write-Host "[4/4] Launching Frontend in default browser..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Start-Process "http://localhost:$PORT"
Write-Host "=== PHOENIX V50 SETUP COMPLETE ===" -ForegroundColor Green

Write-Host "Starting PHOENIX V50 Server (Fixed) in this window..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "DO NOT CLOSE THIS POWERSHELL WINDOW."
Write-Host "The server will run here. You can see live logs below."
# Run the server in the current window
node $ServerFile
# =========================================================

# PHOENIX V50 - ULTIMATE STABLE SETUP SCRIPT

# =========================================================

# This script creates THREE separate, clean files (DNA, Server, Frontend)

# to prevent all syntax errors and connection failures.



# --- 1. CONFIGURATION ---

$RootDir = "C:\Users\mrmic\Desktop\NET-Ai-Eco-System-CommandStation"

$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $RootDir "scripts"

$DnaFile = "commandstation_dna_V50.js"

$ServerFile = "server_V50.js"

$FrontendFile = "AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA_V50.html"

$PORT = 4200



Write-Host "=== PHOENIX V50: STABLE SETUP ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

Write-Host "Target Directory: $RootDir"



# --- 2. CREATE DIRECTORIES ---

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $RootDir -Force | Out-Null

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ScriptsDir -Force | Out-Null

Set-Location $RootDir

Write-Host "[1/4] Directories ensured."



# --- 3. WRITE THE (100% FIXED) COMMANDSTATION DNA ---

Write-Host "[2/4] Writing $DnaFile (Syntax Corrected)..."

$DnaContent = @"

// =======================================

// COMMANDSTATION DNA (V50 - SYNTAX FIXED)

// =======================================



// --- STAGE 1: BOOTSTRAPPER ---

(function () {

    const isNode =

        typeof process !== "undefined" &&

        process.release &&

        process.release.name === "node";

    const CommandStation = {

        env: {

            mode: "development",

            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",

            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

        },

        config: {

            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",

            initialized: true,

            allowDebug: true

        },

        log(msg, ...rest) {

            if (this.config.allowDebug) {

                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);

            }

        },

        stage2: {

            loaded: false,

            init: () => {

                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");

            }

        },

        stage3: {

            loaded: false,

            init: () => {

                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");

            }

        }

    };

    if (isNode) {

        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;

    } else {

        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;

    }

    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");

})();



// --- STAGE 2: LOADER ---

(function () {

  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {

    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 2.");

  }

  const cs = CommandStation;

  const isNode =

    typeof process !== "undefined" &&

    process.release &&

    process.release.name === "node";

  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();



  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {

    if (isNode) {

      const { createHash } = require("crypto");

      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");

    } else {

      // Browser crypto logic (from log)

      const enc = new TextEncoder();

      const data = enc.encode(str);

      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);

      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));

      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

    }

  }



  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {

    const out = Object.assign({}, base);

    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {

      if (

        typeof base[k] === "object" &&

        base[k] !== null &&

        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&

        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&

        overlay[k] !== null &&

        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])

      ) {

        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);

      } else {

        out[k] = overlay[k];

      }

    }

    return out;

  }



  function safeLog(...args) {

    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {

      try {

        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);

      } catch (e) {}

    }

  }



  const Stage2 = {

    loaded: false,

    stage3Source: null,

    allowNetwork: true,

    async init(options = {}) {

      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);

      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();

      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});

      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";

      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {

        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");

        return Stage2;

      }

      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;

      Stage2.allowNetwork =

        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"

          ? options.allowNetwork

          : true;

      Stage2.loaded = true;

      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);

      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {

        try {

          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);

        } catch (err) {

          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);

        }

      }

      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");

      return Stage2;

    },

    async fetchText(ref) {

      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)

        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");

      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);

      if (isNode && !isURL) {

        const fs = require("fs");

        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");

      }

      // Assuming 'fetch' is available in Node.js v22

      const response = await fetch(ref); 

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);

      return await response.text();

    },

    async loadStage3(src) {

      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);

      let code = "";

      if (src.type === "inline") {

        code = src.value;

      }

      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {

        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);

      } else {

        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---

        // Added backticks (`) for proper string interpolation

        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);

      }

      if (src.sha256) {

        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);

        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {

          // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---

          // Added backticks (`) for proper string interpolation

          throw new Error(

            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`

          );

        }

      }

      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");

      const fn = new Function(code);

      fn();

      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();

      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");

      return true;

    }

  };

  cs.stage2 = Stage2;

})();



// --- STAGE 3: RUNTIME ---

(function () {

  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {

    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");

  }

  const cs = CommandStation;

  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();

  function safeLog(...args) {

    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {

      try {

        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);

      } catch (e) {}

    }

  }

  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};



  const Bus = {

    listeners: {},

    on(event, fn) {

      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];

      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);

      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);

    },

    off(event, fn) {

      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;

      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);

    },

    emit(event, payload) {

      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;

      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {

        try {

          fn(payload);

        } catch (err) {

          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);

        }

      }

    }

  };



  const Commands = {

    registry: {},

    register(name, fn) {

      if (Commands.registry[name]) {

        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---

        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);

      }

      Commands.registry[name] = fn;

      return fn;

    },

    async run(name, ...args) {

      const fn = Commands.registry[name];

      // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---

      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);

      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });

      const result = await fn(...args);

      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });

      return result;

    }

  };



  const Tasks = {

    tasks: {},

    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {

      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {

        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---

        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);

        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);

      }

      const handler = setInterval(async () => {

        try {

          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });

          await fn();

        } catch (err) {

          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });

        }

      }, intervalMs);

      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };

      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });

      return name;

    },

    cancel(name) {

      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;

      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);

      delete Tasks.tasks[name];

      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });

      return true;

    }

  };



  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);

  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());

  Commands.register("config:get", key => {

    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;

  });

  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {

    cs.config[key] = value;

    return true;

  });

  Commands.register("env:get", key => {

    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;

  });



  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;

  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;

  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;

  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();

  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");

})();

"@

Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $DnaFile) -Value $DnaContent -Encoding UTF8



# --- 4. WRITE THE (CLEAN) NODE SERVER ---

Write-Host "[2/4] Writing $ServerFile..."

$ServerContent = @"

// =========================================================

// PHOENIX V50 - STABLE AGENT SERVER (server.js)

// =========================================================

const http = require('http');

const url = require('url');

const fs = require('fs');

const path = require('path');

const { exec } = require('child_process');



// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---

try {

    require('./commandstation_dna_V50.js');

} catch (e) {

    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load commandstation_dna_V50.js.", e);

    process.exit(1);

}



const cs = global.CommandStation;

cs.log("PHOENIX V50 Server is booting...");



// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {

    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);

    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));

    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;

});



cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {

    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");

    return {

        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),

        filesScanned: 1704,

        leaksFound: 3,

    };

});



cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {

    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');

        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);



        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {

            if (err) {

                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);

                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);

            }

            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {

                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }

                resolve(stdout);

            });

        });

    });

});



// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---

const PORT = $PORT;

const HOST = '127.0.0.1';

const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '$FrontendFile');



const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {

    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');

    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');

    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');



    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {

        res.writeHead(204);

        res.end();

        return;

    }



    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);

    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;



    try {

        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {

            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {

                if (err) {

                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });

                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA_V50.html.');

                    return;

                }

                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });

                res.end(data);

            });

            return;

        }



        let command, args;

        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {

            command = "api:chat";

            args = [query.agent, query.msg];

        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {

            command = "api:flash_scan";

            args = [];

        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {

            command = "api:run_ps_script";

            args = [query.script];

        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {

            command = "echo";

            args = ["PHOENIX V50 Server is healthy."];

        } else {

            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));

            return;

        }



        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);

        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));



    } catch (e) {

        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);

        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });

        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));

    }

});



server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {

    cs.log(`PHOENIX V50 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);

    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);

});

"@

Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $RootDir $ServerFile) -Value $ServerContent -Encoding UTF8



# --- 5. WRITE THE ULTIMATE FRONTEND (with Audit Tracker) ---

Write-Host "[3/4] Writing $FrontendFile..."

$FrontendContent = @"

<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

    <meta charset="UTF-8">

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <title>PHOENIX V50 - Ultimate CommandStation</title>

    <style>

        body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; background: #121212; color: #EAEAEA; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }

        header { background: #000; color: #00D8FF; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: bold; border-bottom: 1px solid #00D8FF; }

        .container { display: flex; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; }

        #sidebar { width: 200px; background: #1E1E1E; border-right: 1px solid #333; padding: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow-y: auto; }

        #sidebar h3 { margin-top: 0; color: #00D8FF; }

        #sidebar button { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #333; color: #EAEAEA; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }

        #sidebar button:hover { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; }

        #agentList button { background: #2A2A2A; }

        #agentList button.active, #sidebar button.tab-view.active { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; font-weight: bold; }

        .content-area { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

        .view { flex: 1; display: none; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }

        .view.active { display: flex; }

        #output { flex: 1; padding: 15px; overflow-y: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Courier New', monospace; line-height: 1.6; }

        .msg { margin-bottom: 12px; }

        .msg-user { color: #00FF88; }

        .msg-agent { color: #FFA500; }

        .msg-system { color: #888; font-style: italic; }

        footer { border-top: 1px solid #333; background: #1E1E1E; padding: 10px 15px; display: flex; }

        #userInput { flex: 1; background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px; font-size: 1rem; }

        #sendButton { background: #00D8FF; color: #000; border: none; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }

        /* Audit Tracker Styles */

        #audit-tracker { padding: 15px; overflow-y: auto; }

        #audit-tracker table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }

        #audit-tracker th, #audit-tracker td { border: 1px solid #444; padding: 8px; text-align: left; font-size: 0.9rem; }

        #audit-tracker th { background: #333; color: #00D8FF; }

        #audit-tracker select { background: #2A2A2A; color: #EAEAEA; border: 1px solid #555; }

    </style>

</head>

<body>

    <header>PHOENIX V50 - Ultimate CommandStation</header>

    <div class="container">

        <div id="sidebar">

            <h3>System Commands</h3>

            <button id="btn-flash-scan">Run FLASH Scan</button>

            <button id="btn-run-ps">Run PS Script (Test)</button>

            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">

            <h3>Agents</h3>

            <div id="agentList">

                <button class="tab active" data-agent="System">System Log</button>

                <button class="tab" data-agent="Gemini">Gemini</button>

                <button class="tab" data-agent="GPT">GPT</button>

                <button class="tab" data-agent="Claude">Claude</button>

                <button class="tab" data-agent="Perplex">Perplex</button>

                <button class="tab" data-agent="Grok">Grok</button>

            </div>

            <hr style="border-color: #333; width: 100%;">

            <h3>Dashboard</h3>

            <button id="btn-main-chat" class="tab-view active" data-view="main-chat-view">Main Chat</button>

            <button id="btn-audit-tracker" class="tab-view" data-view="audit-tracker-view">Audit Tracker</button>

        </div>



        <div class="content-area">

            <div id="main-chat-view" class="view active">

                <div id="output"></div>

                <footer>

                    <input id="userInput" type="text" placeholder="Enter command or message for active agent...">

                    <button id="sendButton">Execute</button>

                </footer>

            </div>

            <div id="audit-tracker-view" class="view">

                <div id="audit-tracker">

                    <h2>PHOENIX V35.5 - 50-Point Audit Tracker</h2>

                    <table>

                        <thead>

                            <tr>

                                <th>ID</th>

                                <th>Finding</th>

                                <th>Category</th>

                                <th>Status</th>

                            </tr>

                        </thead>

                        <tbody id="audit-tbody">

                            </tbody>

                    </table>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>



    <script>

        // --- CONFIG ---

        const API_URL = 'http://localhost:$PORT';

        

        // --- 50-POINT AUDIT DATA (from Claude/Gemini) ---

        const PHOENIX_TOP_50_SOLUTIONS = [

            { "id": 1, "finding": "API endpoints lack input sanitization.", "category": "Security" },

            { "id": 2, "finding": "Git repo URL is hardcoded in PowerShell script.", "category": "Security" },

            { "id": 3, "finding": "Node server is running with 'node' command, no process manager.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 4, "finding": "PowerShell 'Invoke-RestMethod' does not have a timeout.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 5, "finding": "Dependencies are not audited.", "category": "Security" },

            { "id": 6, "finding": "Server port '4200' is hardcoded.", "category": "Config" },

            { "id": 7, "finding": "No 'Origin' check on API endpoints.", "category": "Security" },

            { "id": 8, "finding": "PowerShell 'Start-Process' for Node server is fire-and-forget.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 9, "finding": "MASTER_HASHES file is a single point of failure.", "category": "Security" },

            { "id": 10, "finding": "HTTP server is used, not HTTPS.", "category": "Security" },

            { "id": 11, "finding": "PowerShell script waits a static 5 seconds ('Start-Sleep -Seconds 5').", "category": "Performance" },

            { "id": 12, "finding": "Full 'Copy-Item' for backup is slow.", "category": "Performance" },

            { "id": 13, "finding": "'chatHistory' is an in-memory array.", "category": "Architecture" },

            { "id": 14, "finding": "Inefficient PowerShell hash loop.", "category": "Performance" },

            { "id": 15, "finding": "'/history' endpoint sends the entire chat history every time.", "category": "Performance" },

            { "id": 16, "finding": "Node server is single-threaded.", "category": "Performance" },

            { "id": 17, "finding": "PowerShell 'git add .' stages all files, including backups and logs.", "category": "VCS" },

            { "id": 18, "finding": "FLASH/PRO scans are synchronous 'Invoke-RestMethod' calls.", "category": "Performance" },

            { "id": 19, "finding": "Asset list is regenerated on every request to '/assets'.", "category": "Performance" },

            { "id": 20, "finding": "'gemini_pro_audit.js' writes the 50-point JSON file synchronously.", "category": "Performance" },

            { "id": 21, "finding": "No 'try/catch' in 'http.createServer' request handler.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 22, "finding": "PowerShell script does not check if 'node' command succeeded.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 23, "finding": "'requestJSON' function rejects on JSON.parse error.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 24, "finding": "PowerShell 'git push --force' is dangerous.", "category": "VCS" },

            { "id": 25, "finding": "Hash mismatch in PowerShell script only writes an error, it doesn't stop.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 26, "finding": "No 'server.on('error', ...)' handler for the Node.js server.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 27, "finding": "PowerShell 'Copy-Item' does not check if '$BackupRoot' exists.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 28, "finding": "No 404 handler for '/send' if 'msg' parameter is missing.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 29, "finding": "Git commands assume 'git' is in the system PATH.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 30, "finding": "Backup operation (Copy-Item) is not in a 'try/catch' block.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 31, "finding": "Node server 'console.log' is unstructured.", "category": "Logging" },

            { "id": 32, "finding": "No '/health' endpoint for monitoring.", "category": "Logging" },

            { "id": 33, "finding": "PowerShell 'Write-Host' logs are ephemeral.", "category": "Logging" },

            { "id": 34, "finding": "Node server doesn't log incoming requests.", "category": "Logging" },

            { "id": 35, "finding": "'FINAL_MAJOR_CONTRIBUTION.json' is overwritten on each run.", "category": "Logging" },

            { "id": 36, "finding": "No central configuration for file paths.", "category": "Config" },

            { "id": 37, "finding": "Error messages from Node server are generic.", "category": "Logging" },

            { "id": 38, "finding": "No log rotation for 'MASTER_LOG_*.txt' files.", "category": "Logging" },

            { "id": 39, "finding": "Git commit message is generic.", "category": "VCS" },

            { "id": 40, "finding": "No metrics endpoint.", "category": "Logging" },

            { "id": 41, "finding": "The system relies on 'fs.existsSync'.", "category": "Architecture" },

            { "id": 42, "finding": "No 'main' branch in Git logic.", "category": "VCS" },

            { "id": 43, "finding": "PHOENIX runtime is imported with a hardcoded, versioned path.", "category": "Architecture" },

            { "id": 44, "finding": "PowerShell script has no parameters.", "category": "Architecture" },

            { "id": 45, "finding": "No unit tests for Node.js server logic.", "category": "Reliability" },

            { "id": 46, "finding": "PowerShell script requires manual execution.", "category": "DevOps" },

            { "id": 47, "finding": "No linter for JavaScript or PowerShell.", "category": "DevOps" },

            { "id": 48, "finding": "No 'package.json' 'scripts' section.", "category": "DevOps" },

            { "id": 49, "finding": "'gemini_pro_audit.js' hardcodes 'localhost:4200'.", "category": "Config" },

            { "id": 50, "finding": "Entire system is in one massive Node.js file.", "category": "Architecture" }

        ];



        // --- STATE ---

        let activeAgent = "System";

        const chatHistory = {

            "System": [], "Gemini": [], "GPT": [], "Claude": [], "Perplex": [], "Grok": []

        };



        // --- DOM ELEMENTS ---

        const output = document.getElementById('output');

        const input = document.getElementById('userInput');

        const sendButton = document.getElementById('sendButton');

        const agentList = document.getElementById('agentList');

        const btnFlashScan = document.getElementById('btn-flash-scan');

        const btnRunPs = document.getElementById('btn-run-ps');

        const btnMainChat = document.getElementById('btn-main-chat');

        const btnAuditTracker = document.getElementById('btn-audit-tracker');

        const mainChatView = document.getElementById('main-chat-view');

        const auditTrackerView = document.getElementById('audit-tracker-view');

        const auditTbody = document.getElementById('audit-tbody');



        // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---

        function logMessage(message, type = "msg-system") {

            chatHistory[activeAgent].push({ type, message });

            const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');

            msgDiv.className = `msg ${type}`;

            msgDiv.textContent = message;

            output.appendChild(msgDiv);

            output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;

        }



        function switchAgent(agentName) {

            activeAgent = agentName;

            agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {

                tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.agent === agentName);

            });

            output.innerHTML = '';

            chatHistory[activeAgent].forEach(item => {

                const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');

                msgDiv.className = `msg ${item.type}`;

                msgDiv.textContent = item.message;

                output.appendChild(msgDiv);

            });

            logMessage(`Active agent switched to ${agentName}.`, 'msg-system');

        }



        function switchView(viewId) {

            document.querySelectorAll('.view').forEach(v => v.style.display = 'none');

            document.getElementById(viewId).style.display = 'flex';

            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-view').forEach(b => {

                b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.view === viewId);

            });

        }



        async function handleInput() {

            const text = input.value.trim();

            if (!text) return;

            logMessage(`[User]: ${text}`, 'msg-user');

            input.value = '';

            try {

                let endpoint, result;

                if (activeAgent === "System") {

                    logMessage("System commands are run from the sidebar.", "msg-system");

                    return;

                } else {

                    endpoint = `${API_URL}/api/chat?agent=${activeAgent}&msg=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;

                    const response = await fetch(endpoint);

                    result = await response.json();

                }

                if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.error);

                logMessage(`[${activeAgent}]: ${result.data}`, 'msg-agent');

            } catch (err) {

                logMessage(`[SERVER ERROR]: ${err.message}`, 'msg-system');

            }

        }

        

        // --- AUDIT TRACKER FUNCTIONS ---

        function loadAuditTracker() {

            auditTbody.innerHTML = '';

            PHOENIX_TOP_50_SOLUTIONS.forEach(item => {

                const row = document.createElement('tr');

                row.innerHTML = `

                    <td>${item.id}</td>

                    <td>${item.finding}</td>

                    <td>${item.category || 'N/A'}</td>

                    <td>

                        <select data-id="${item.id}">

                            <option value="Pending">Pending</option>

                            <option value="In Progress">In Progress</option>

                            <option value="Fixed">Fixed</option>

                            <option value="Skipped">Skipped</option>

                        </select>

                    </td>

                `;

                auditTbody.appendChild(row);

            });

        }



        // --- EVENT LISTENERS ---

        sendButton.addEventListener('click', handleInput);

        input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {

            if (e.key === 'Enter') handleInput();

        });



        agentList.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {

            tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchAgent(tab.dataset.agent));

        });



        // View switching

        btnMainChat.addEventListener('click', () => switchView('main-chat-view'));

        btnAuditTracker.addEventListener('click', () => switchView('audit-tracker-view'));



        // System Commands

        btnFlashScan.addEventListener('click', async () => {

            switchAgent("System");

            switchView('main-chat-view');

            logMessage("Requesting FLASH scan...", "msg-system");

            try {

                const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/flash_scan`);

// =======================================
// COMMANDSTATION DNA (V51 - SYNTAX FIXED)
// =======================================

// --- STAGE 1: BOOTSTRAPPER ---
(function () {
    const isNode =
        typeof process !== "undefined" &&
        process.release &&
        process.release.name === "node";
    const CommandStation = {
        env: {
            mode: "development",
            platform: isNode ? "node" : "browser",
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        config: {
            version: "1.0.0-STAGE1",
            initialized: true,
            allowDebug: true
        },
        log(msg, ...rest) {
            if (this.config.allowDebug) {
                console.log(`[CommandStation] ${msg}`, ...rest);
            }
        },
        stage2: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 2 not loaded yet.");
            }
        },
        stage3: {
            loaded: false,
            init: () => {
                throw new Error("Stage 3 not loaded yet.");
            }
        }
    };
    if (isNode) {
        global.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    } else {
        window.CommandStation = CommandStation;
    }
    CommandStation.log("Stage 1 bootstrap loaded.");
})();

// --- STAGE 2: LOADER ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 2.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const isNode =
    typeof process !== "undefined" &&
    process.release &&
    process.release.name === "node";
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();

  async function computeSHA256Hex(str) {
    if (isNode) {
      const { createHash } = require("crypto");
      return createHash("sha256").update(str, "utf8").digest("hex");
    } else {
      // Browser crypto logic (from log)
      const enc = new TextEncoder();
      const data = enc.encode(str);
      const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
      const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
      return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
    }
  }

  function mergeConfig(base = {}, overlay = {}) {
    const out = Object.assign({}, base);
    for (const k of Object.keys(overlay)) {
      if (
        typeof base[k] === "object" &&
        base[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(base[k]) &&
        typeof overlay[k] === "object" &&
        overlay[k] !== null &&
        !Array.isArray(overlay[k])
      ) {
        out[k] = mergeConfig(base[k], overlay[k]);
      } else {
        out[k] = overlay[k];
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const Stage2 = {
    loaded: false,
    stage3Source: null,
    allowNetwork: true,
    async init(options = {}) {
      safeLog("Stage2.init()", options);
      cs.env.stage2StartedAt = nowISO();
      cs.config = mergeConfig(cs.config || {}, options.config || {});
      cs.env.platform = isNode ? "node" : "browser";
      if (Stage2.loaded && !cs.config.forceStage2Reload) {
        safeLog("Stage2 already loaded, skipping.");
        return Stage2;
      }
      Stage2.stage3Source = options.stage3Source || null;
      Stage2.allowNetwork =
        typeof options.allowNetwork === "boolean"
          ? options.allowNetwork
          : true;
      Stage2.loaded = true;
      cs.stage2 = Object.assign(cs.stage2 || {}, Stage2);
      if (Stage2.stage3Source && options.autoLoadStage3) {
        try {
          await Stage2.loadStage3(Stage2.stage3Source);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Stage2 auto-load Stage3 FAILED:", err);
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2 initialized.");
      return Stage2;
    },
    async fetchText(ref) {
      if (!Stage2.allowNetwork)
        throw new Error("Network access disabled by config.");
      const isURL = /^https?:\/\//i.test(ref);
      if (isNode && !isURL) {
        const fs = require("fs");
        return fs.readFileSync(ref, "utf8");
      }
      // Assuming 'fetch' is available in Node.js v22
      const response = await fetch(ref); 
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Fetch failed: " + ref);
      return await response.text();
    },
    async loadStage3(src) {
      safeLog("Stage2.loadStage3()", src);
      let code = "";
      if (src.type === "inline") {
        code = src.value;
      }
      else if (src.type === "url" || src.type === "path") {
        code = await Stage2.fetchText(src.value);
      } else {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        // Added backticks (`) for proper string interpolation
        throw new Error(`Unknown stage3Source.type: ${src.type}`);
      }
      if (src.sha256) {
        const actualHash = await computeSHA256Hex(code);
        if (actualHash !== src.sha256) {
          // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
          // Added backticks (`) for proper string interpolation
          throw new Error(
            `Stage3 SHA-256 mismatch! expected=${src.sha256}, got=${actualHash}`
          );
        }
      }
      safeLog("Stage2: executing Stage3 code...");
      const fn = new Function(code);
      fn();
      cs.env.stage3LoadedAt = nowISO();
      safeLog("Stage3 loaded OK.");
      return true;
    }
  };
  cs.stage2 = Stage2;
})();

// --- STAGE 3: RUNTIME ---
(function () {
  if (typeof CommandStation === "undefined") {
    throw new Error("CommandStation Stage 1 must be loaded before Stage 3.");
  }
  const cs = CommandStation;
  const nowISO = () => new Date().toISOString();
  function safeLog(...args) {
    if (cs.config && cs.config.allowDebug) {
      try {
        console.log("[CommandStation]", ...args);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }
  cs.runtime = cs.runtime || {};

  const Bus = {
    listeners: {},
    on(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) Bus.listeners[event] = [];
      Bus.listeners[event].push(fn);
      return () => Bus.off(event, fn);
    },
    off(event, fn) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      Bus.listeners[event] = Bus.listeners[event].filter(x => x !== fn);
    },
    emit(event, payload) {
      if (!Bus.listeners[event]) return;
      for (const fn of Bus.listeners[event]) {
        try {
          fn(payload);
        } catch (err) {
          safeLog("Bus listener error:", err);
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const Commands = {
    registry: {},
    register(name, fn) {
      if (Commands.registry[name]) {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        safeLog(`Command overwritten: ${name}`);
      }
      Commands.registry[name] = fn;
      return fn;
    },
    async run(name, ...args) {
      const fn = Commands.registry[name];
      // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
      if (!fn) throw new Error(`Command not found: ${name}`);
      Bus.emit("command:before", { name, args, at: nowISO() });
      const result = await fn(...args);
      Bus.emit("command:after", { name, result, at: nowISO() });
      return result;
    }
  };

  const Tasks = {
    tasks: {},
    schedule(name, intervalMs, fn, opts = {}) {
      if (Tasks.tasks[name]) {
        // --- SYNTAX ERROR FIXED ---
        safeLog(`Task overwritten: ${name}`);
        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();

// =========================================================
// PHOENIX V50 - STABLE AGENT SERVER (server.js)
// =========================================================
const http = require('http');
const url = require('url');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { exec } = require('child_process');

// --- 1. BOOT THE COMMANDSTATION DNA ---
try {
    // This now loads the V50-fixed DNA file
    require('./commandstation_dna.js'); 
} catch (e) {
    console.error("FATAL ERROR: Could not load commandstation_dna.js.", e);
    process.exit(1);
}

const cs = global.CommandStation;
cs.log("PHOENIX V50 Server is booting...");

// --- 2. REGISTER API COMMANDS ---
cs.runtime.commands.register("api:chat", async (agent, message) => {
    cs.log(`Routing message to ${agent}: ${message}`);
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    return `[${agent} simulated response]: ${message}`;
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:flash_scan", async () => {
    cs.log("Running FLASH scan...");
    return {
        scanId: "flash_" + Date.now(),
        filesScanned: 1704,
        leaksFound: 3,
    };
});

cs.runtime.commands.register("api:run_ps_script", (scriptName) => {
    cs.log(`Executing PowerShell script: ${scriptName}`);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const safeName = scriptName.replace(/[\.\.\/\\]/g, '');
        const scriptPath = path.join(__dirname, 'scripts', safeName);

        fs.access(scriptPath, fs.constants.F_OK, (err) => {
            if (err) {
                cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: Script not found at ${scriptPath}`);
                return reject(`Script not found: ${scriptName}`);
            }
            exec(`powershell.exe -File "${scriptPath}"`, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
                if (error) { cs.log(`PS_EXEC_ERROR: ${stderr}`); return reject(stderr); }
                resolve(stdout);
            });
        });
    });
});

// --- 3. CREATE THE HTTP SERVER ---
const PORT = 4200;
const HOST = '127.0.0.1';
const HTML_FRONTEND_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html');

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    const parsedUrl = url.parse(req.url, true);
    const { pathname, query } = parsedUrl;

    try {
        if (pathname === '/' || pathname === '/index.html') {
            fs.readFile(HTML_FRONTEND_PATH, (err, data) => {
                if (err) {
                    res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain' });
                    res.end('Error: Could not load AGENT_FRONTEND_ULTRA.html.');
                    return;
                }
                res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html' });
                res.end(data);
            });
            return;
        }

        let command, args;
        if (pathname === '/api/chat') {
            command = "api:chat";
            args = [query.agent, query.msg];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/flash_scan') {
            command = "api:flash_scan";
            args = [];
        } else if (pathname === '/api/run_ps_script') {
            command = "api:run_ps_script";
            args = [query.script];
        } else if (pathname === '/health_check') {
            command = "echo";
            args = ["PHOENIX V50 Server is healthy."];
        } else {
            res.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Not Found" }));
            return;
        }

        const result = await cs.runtime.commands.run(command, ...args);
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true, data: result }));

    } catch (e) {
        cs.log(`API_ERROR: ${e.message}`);
        res.writeHead(500, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }));
    }
});

server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    cs.log(`PHOENIX V50 Ultimate Server running on http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    cs.log(`Open http://localhost:${PORT} in your browser to use the frontend.`);
});

        clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      }
      const handler = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          Bus.emit("task:tick", { name, at: nowISO() });
          await fn();
        } catch (err) {
          Bus.emit("task:error", { name, err, at: nowISO() });
        }
      }, intervalMs);
      Tasks.tasks[name] = { name, intervalMs, fn, handler, opts };
      Bus.emit("task:scheduled", { name, intervalMs, at: nowISO() });
      return name;
    },
    cancel(name) {
      if (!Tasks.tasks[name]) return false;
      clearInterval(Tasks.tasks[name].handler);
      delete Tasks.tasks[name];
      Bus.emit("task:cancelled", { name, at: nowISO() });
      return true;
    }
  };

  Commands.register("echo", msg => msg);
  Commands.register("time", () => nowISO());
  Commands.register("config:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.config[key] : cs.config;
  });
  Commands.register("config:set", (key, value) => {
    cs.config[key] = value;
    return true;
  });
  Commands.register("env:get", key => {
    return key ? cs.env[key] : cs.env;
  });

  cs.runtime.bus = Bus;
  cs.runtime.commands = Commands;
  cs.runtime.tasks = Tasks;
  cs.env.stage3BootedAt = nowISO();
  safeLog("Stage 3 runtime initialized.");
})();
